dab babyu gnyas pa' dkar chag :rgyud/ (shi (23)0416 dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i gter zhes bya ba/ 3mkhas pa dza ya se tsā'i gsung dpal dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(87) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(107)0417 rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa bsgyur ba'i bstod pa bzhugs so 108shrī dza ya se nā dang / dpal dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(110) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(110)0418 gtor ma'i cho ga rin chen asma gar+bha bzhugs so// 1111

mkhas pa dza ya se tsā'i gsung dpal ye shes rdo rjes bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(115) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(115)0419 bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal ba(1gas so// 116mkhas pa dza ya se na'i gsung dpal ye shes rdo rjes bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(119) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(119)0420 dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 120slob dpon mi tri pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(122) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(122)0421 dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mash+ka mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bzhugs so// 123/sngocad /sa thabastestecad ngas/re ཿdza pa/ 123lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga 126dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ༷ 146mkhas pa ra po dza ya se na'i gsung dpal ye shes rdo rjes bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(191) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(197)0422 dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga bzhugs/ 198phyi'i sbyin sreg gi rab tu byed pa/ 198dang po/ thab kyi rab tu byed pa/ 198gnyis pa/ rdzas kyi rab tu byed pa/ 2༷1gsum pa/ bud shing gi rab tu byed pa/ 2032

bzhi pa/ dgang gzar blugs gzar gyi rab tu byed pa/ 204lnga pa/ sgrub pa po'i rab tu bye)da pa/ 205drug pa/ mchod yon gyi rab tu byed pa/ 206bdun pa/ dgod pa'i rab tu byed pa/ 207basbyo1pa/ nga / 336) zabab /1 bye)tshod nga / 208dgu pa/ lha tshim par byed pa'i rab tu byed pa/ 208nang gi sbyin sreg gi rab tu byed pa/ 219mkhas pa dza ya se na'i gsung dpal ye shes rdo rjes bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(222) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(224)0423 rang byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag gi sgrub thabs/ 225rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ku mā ra shrīs mdzad/bsdur mchan/(228) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(229)0424 dpal gsang ba rin po che yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ 230dpal nā ro pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī nā ro pa chen po dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gos kyis zhus te bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(240) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(240)0425 rngonabasapang /ba 1sdecad 11 byebye/ 2zhe 1slob dpon mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad/paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(243) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(243)

0426 bdud rtsi 'od zer can zhes bya ba/ 244rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug r+sā po rat+na shrī tshwa na'i zhal snga nas gtan la phab pa/ mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(2gye) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(2gye)0427 dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro lus med pa'i chos zhes bya ba/ 2narje te lo chen pos na ro pa la gsungs/bsdur mchan/(252) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(252)0428 dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma lta sgom spyod gsum gyi brda bstan pa 253basbur mchan/(254) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(254)0429 dpal sdom pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ ༷ ༷ 255mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(262) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(263)0430 dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba 264paṇ+ḍi ta shu re ka la shas mdzad/zhus phi gyi lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(270) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(270)

0431 dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ 2rte/1kha che'i mkhas pa ra po bram ze rin r+ṣa rdo rjes mdzad/bsdur mchan/(275) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(275)0432 dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la bstod pa/ 276kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta r+sā po bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā 1 na dang bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(279) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(279)0433 dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa bzhugs so// 280slob dpon mi — pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(282) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(282)༷434 dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyun bshags rgyas pa bzhugs so 283slob dpon bhu ri bas mdzad/jo bo rje dang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(288) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(289)0435 lam gyi rab tu bya ba bzhugs so// 290bsnyen pa'i cho ga 2905

sta gon gyi cho ga rten/ //tshod/kye(ba parakhoshā /bye ces 2na 297ཿdathabapa tshob/sazab /ba/re ces than 298dpal 'jigs byed lha'i zhal snga nas bstan—/rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid kyi spyan sngar bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong grags 'byor shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(305) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(306)04na6 dbang gi cho ga'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ 307bde rgyal pos bris/kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī'i zhabs kyi pad+mo la gtugs pa paṇ+ḍi ta shrī pa ra te ta dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong shes rab rgyal ma— gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(323) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(324)0437 dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ 325paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ma na ka shrīs mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa su ma ti'i ༅ sngar dge slong pradz+nyā tīrtis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(334) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(335)0438 dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 336grub pa'i slob dpon r+ṣa po nag po zhabs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dharma shrī bha dra dang /zhu r+sā gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rig pa

gzhon nus bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(350) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(351)0439 dpal 'khor lo bde mchog 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i dkyil sherakhoshā pa gyi cho can 352slob dpon dbu ba blo ldan pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(433) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(438)0440 lhan cig skyes pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum gsal bar byed pa /zhe/ma /byu /ba zhes 39mkhas pa ra po tshwa na shrīs mdzad/bod kyi rgyal po pho brang zhi ba 'od kyisagasol ba btab nas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(4na) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(4go)0441 sgon ma bzhi'i ṭī kā zhes bya ba/ 450dang po/ sngags kyi sgron ma bshad pa/ 450las kyi rdo rjes mdzad/gnyis pa/ rgyud kyi sgon ma bshad pa/ 492las kyi rdo rjes mdzad/gsum pa/ ye shes kyi sgon ma bshad pa/ 498las kyi rdo rjes mdzad/bzhi pa/ gsang ba'i sgon ma bshad pa/ 499slob dpon nag pos mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po ra po shrī dha ra nyid kyi zhabs kyi zhal snga nas kyis bsgyur 7

cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(515) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(519)0442 nga)nga/'ab jordo —— 'a ba/ chos:re (1ngas thangabab 520ā tsar+ya pra1 bha dras mdzad/bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti krirte dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(522) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(523)0443 jordo byedro 'a bka ces (1ngab ngas6) thabapa/bas 524mkhas pa chen po a ba sgru tī pa gnyis su med pa'i rdo rjes mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ba mtshur ston dbang nges bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(528) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(528)0444 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la mchod pa mdor bsdus pa bzhugs/ 529rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇi'i zhal snga nas dang / lo tsā ba mtshur gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(533) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(532)0445 dpal rdo rje phag ces sgrub pa'i thabs 534byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po seng ge'i gdong can khyab 'jug spangs pas sbyar/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal a wa byu tī pa chen po/ rgyal po'i sras 'jigs med lha'i zhal sngar shākya'i dge slong rje btsun

pratshwa tīrtis bsgyur /bsdur mchan/(550) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(552)0446 grub pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs 553slob dpon chen po in+d+ra byu tis mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal na len+d+ra pa dang /lo tsā ba dge slong prarnye tīrtis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(558) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(559)04gye dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ 560slob dpon in+d+ra byu tis mdzad/lo tsā ba ye shes rdo rjes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(568) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(569)044 rna'ab sha dresazab mthalnga/ (1ba pasnore thabs 570dpal lha lcam lathā ka ras mdzad/bsdur mchan/(573) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(573)04go rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ 574dpal ri khrod dbang phyug gis bstan/bsdur mchan/(576) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(576)0450 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ 577rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis mdzad/bla ma be+e ro tsa nas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(579) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(579)

0451 dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ 580rgya gar gyi mkhan po bsod nams 'byung gnas bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba rma ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(585) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(586)0452 dpal de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa/ 587/phyo )((ba zugaḥdzatshod pa:re ཿdza ga ༷ 587/ba1sgo(ma thab/re ces can ga 89phan yon dang slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga 591/sngathab/bas /ba/khye /ba/re ཿdza thab/ 593mkhas pa chen po ting nge 'dzin rdo rje'i zhabs rdul la reg pa paṇ+ḍi ta stong nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad/bal po'i ā tsār+ya bha ren+d+ra ru tsi dang / lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(595) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(596)0453 don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ 597slob dpon mkhas pa grub pa brnyes pa a ba — tī pas mdzad/bal po'i ā tsār+ya bha ren+d+ra ru tsi dang / lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(599) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(600)0454 ye shes 'pho ba zhes bya ba/ 601/ba/sgo(ma tshopa/re ces can ༷ ( 0110

1sgob skyab :ngebasdo sdos par:rdo zug nga :re ཿdza ba/ 60'ju/phyo 1— (5 zugaḥdzatshod tsho /re ces pa/ / 0zhesaphan mdun (sgror ba dang bcas pa'i cho ga 605dpal stong nyid ting 'dzin gyis mdzad/bal po'i ā tsār+ya bha ren+d+ra ru tsi dang / lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(607) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(608)༷455 rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs/ 609lha mo dpal gyi blo gros mas mdzad/bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsār+ya bha ren+d+ra ru tsi dang /lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(612) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(612)0456 dbu bcad ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 613slob dpon chen po birba pas mdzad/bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bha ren+d+ra ru tsi dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba rma chos 'bar gyis bsgyur zhing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(619) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(620)0457 dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 621slob dpon chen po bsod snyoms pa'i slob ma rgyal bas byin gyi tsha bo sangs rgyas byin gyis mdzad/bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bha ren+d+ra ru tsi dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(623) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(623)11

0458 rigs ldan ma'i de kho na nyid nges pa zhes bya ba/ 624u rgyan du grub pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po dri paṃ ka ra'i zhal snga nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(638) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(639)0459 rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 640rgya gar gyi mkhan po badz+ra pā ṇa'i zhal snga nas/ lo tsā ba mtshur gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(644) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(646)0460 ngesab sngaga'ab shanang/sa spu) sbyo/ba ngasaḍire thabab/ 647grub thob rngon pa'i gdams pa/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta a nan+da ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang / dpal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(6go) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(648)0461 phag ces thugs spyo) (1ba thabs ba(1gas/ 649kurma pā da zhes bya ba'i gdams pa/paṇ+ḍi ta ltanardo ka ra'i zhal snga nas dpyal lo tsā ba dpal chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(651) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(651)0462 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ 65212

grub thob rngon pa'i zhal snga nas kyis mdzad/bla ma rdo rje gdan pa niṣ+ka liṅka'i zhal snga nas/ datshi lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(654) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(654)0463 slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 6551sngocad /ga tshobartestecad nga / 655/):re maḥdzad pa:re ཿdza ga 656bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga 657ye shes 'bebs pa'i cho ga 657tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga 659gzhon nu ma mchod pa'i cho ga 661gtor ma:re (bas /) byodza ga 662/byecad rjesasgyun 1go ces rngon 66tsamasrung ba'i 'khor lo'i cho ga 666grub thob sha ba ri pā das mdzad/yul ma ga dhā'i paṇ+ḍi ta go ta ma bha dra'i zhal snga nas legs par mnyan te/ lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal mawo dpal bzang pos legs par bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(667) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(668)0464 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dbang mdor bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ 669grub pa thob pa sha ba ri zhabs kyis mdzad/rgya gar gyi yul ma ga dhā'i paṇ+ḍi ta go ta ma bha dra'i zhal snga nas mnyan te/ lo tsā ba shākye dge slong nyi ma rgyal ma— dpal 13

bzang pos legs par bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(674) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(675)0465 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 676grub pa thob pa sha ba ri zhabs kyis mdzad/yul ma ga d+ma'i paṇ+ḍi ta go ta ma bha dra'i zhal snga nas legs par mnyan te/ lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong nyi ma rgyal ma— dpal bzang pos legs par bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(680) bsnyur 'bras re'u mig(680)0466 rnal 'byor gyi rjes su 'brang ba zhes bya ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'asdesal /ba/ (3med1rnal 'dresar khru) rjes su 'brang ba/ 681byesabs bste::re cabaḥdzaspyad pa:re shesteg pa/ 70zhesagrub thob chen po dā ri ka pas mdzad/rgya gar shar phyogs dza ga ta la'i paṇ+ḍi ta dpal mkhas pa chen po dā na bhā las lha'i skad las bod kyi skad du 'khrul ba med pa rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(711) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(714)0467 snying po'i don bsdus pa bstan pa/ 715paṇ+ḍi ta klu'i sbyin pa'i rnal 'byor kyis mdzad/rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta ra po dā na shī las lha'i skad las bod kyi skad du rang 'gyur du mdzad/14

bsdur mchan/(717) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(717)0468 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mchod pa'i cho ga 718slob dpon ra po dā ri ka pas mdzad/rgya gar shar phyogs dza ga ta la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dā na shī las rang 'gyur du mdzad/bsdur mchan/(722) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(722)0469 keng rus tā ra na'i sgrub thabs/ 723slob dpon ra po dā ri ka pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(727) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(728)0gye0 keng rus tā ra na'i sgrub thabs kyi 'grel pa gzhan la phan /pa zhe/ma bya /ba 7)rten9mang du thos pa'i slob dpon ku mā ra bo dhis mdzad/bsnyur mchan/(742) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(743)0gye1 rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 744slob dpon chen po dzā larnya ra pas mdzad/bsdur mchan/(751) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(752)0472 jordo 1jo phabaka 346) (1ba thababs/ 753slob dpon mkhas pa chen po rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad/rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ma ti tīrti dang /bod kyi lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po mar pa chos 15

༄/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'gor gyi 'khor lo'i grub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i gter zhes bya ba/1༄4/ / rgya gar skad du/ shrī ḍā kār+ṇa ba tan+t+ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra 6 sā dha na rat+na pad+ma rā ga ni dhi nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs pad+ma rā ga'i gter zhes bya ba/ dpal bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs rjes kun bsdus ngo bo'i sku/ /dngos kun gcig bsdus rang bzhin te/ /rgyud kyi phyag can lhan skyes zhal/ /gnyis med shes rab phag mo dang / /lhan cig bzhugs pa de la 'dud/ /mkhyen pa'i gsung gi 'od zer gyes/ /snod ldan blo mun sel mdzad cing / /don gyi bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa/ /mtsho skyes la sogs bla ma'i tshogs/ /zla ba lta bu rnams la 'dud/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho yi/ /bla ma'i man ngag mngon rtogs rim/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa'i nus med kyang / /bdag nyid dran 12—3

phyir bri bar bya/ /de la thog mar dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur ba'i rim pas dag par byas pa zab pa dang rgya che ba la lhag par mos pas rgyud kyi don khong 1du chud pa'i sgrub pa pos/ skye bo med pa'i sa phyogs dang / ri bo dang /ri'i phug dang / bya skyibs dang / rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram dang / gdod ma nas grub pa'i dur khrod dang / gang du yid dga' ba'i gnas su yang rung ste/bcom ldan 'das kyi ras ris dang / gtor ma dang / mchod yon la sogs pa'i nye bar spyad pa rnams dang ldan pa'i bsam gtan gyi gnas bstar ba/bdud rtsis gtor zhing / me tog gcal dze+edu bkram pas dga' bar byas par/tho rangs sad pa dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis glu dang cang te'u'i sgras bskul bar bsams te/ gdong gi gtsang sbra la sogs byas nas/ ro dngos kyi steng ngam mi'i pags pa la ngasna tshogs rdo rje bris pa'i steng du/ gcer bu khar bdud rtsi'i ri lu bcug pa lhor mngon par phyogs pas/ rdo rje'i skyil krung ltal sogs pas 'dug ste/ lag pa g.yon pa'i dbus 6dang mthe'u chung nas bzung ba'i sor mo rnams kyi rtsa ba la/ dpa' mo'i go cha rnams kyis sbyang ba dang /bcom ldan 'das kyi go cha yang dbus dang sor mo rnams kyi rtse mo la dgod do/ /de nas pad+ma'i snod du ༷myos byed bzang pos bkang la lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du bzhag ste g.yon pa'i srin lag gis chos 'byung gi ri mo bya zhing / yi ge gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir bsams te/ de nyid kyi mthe bong dang srin lag sbyar bas chang gtor te yan lag lnga la khrus dang / 'thor 'thung dang /mchod pa'i rdzas rnams la bsang gtor yang bya'o/ /de nas rang gi mdun du chang de nyid dang / dri zhim po bsres pas maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi par byugs te me tog 12—4

sil mas gtor la rdo rje'i phyag rgyas reg cing bhur ju wa swaḥzhes brjod pas sa 'og dang / sa steng dang / mtho ris kyi rang bzhin du byen gyis brlab po/ /de nas oṃ āḥs+thā māṃ me rak+ṣa hūṃ zhes brjod cing me tog gcig rang gi 'og tu bzhag pas gnas bsrung bar bya'o/ /a tu āḥ.ān+d+ra māṃ me rak+ṣa hūṃ zhes bya ba dang / me tog gcig rang gi mgo bor bzhag ste bdag nyid bsrung bar bya'o/ /'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang oṃ āḥyo tsā rmyeme rak+ṣa hūṃ zhes bya bas rnal 'byor bsrung bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes su sems can 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor bying ba rnams phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang la gzhag kyepa'i phyir bdag gis ④dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bsgom par bya'o zhes sems bskyed do/ /de nas tha mal pa'i lus nyid la/dpa' bo'i go cha'i sngags brjod cing gnas de dang der rdo rje'i phyag rgya reg pas go cha bya'o/ /de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los yesgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum ste/ /'go ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'go ma/ /rnam par rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor yongs byeng ba/ /yang shidag yongs su sgol mkhas pa'i/ /bla ma dam pa'i drin gang gis/ /bdag la ye shes 'di skyed 7/'dud/ /ces bya bas mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams yid kyis gsal bar byas la me tog gtor zhing phyag bya'o/ /de nas cho ga nas bshad pa bzhin du bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa la gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas bdag nyid skad cig gis bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa sgu mdog sngon po phag mo 12—5

dang bcas pa bsgom pa ni lus dag par byed pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar paṃ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ ⑫yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i steng du yi ge hūṃ sakha dog nag po ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro bzhin pa bsams la/ngag tu thog mar oṃ dang mthar hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa dang ldan pa'i ā li kā li brjod pas t+t+waṃ gi nā da las yi ge'i phreng ba kha dog sna tshogs 'phro bzhin pa bton te g.yon gyi lus kyi stod du sngon po dang bar du dmar po dang / smad du dkar po'i phreng bas dkris te de dag las khams gsum gyi rigs su gtogs pa'i lha'i tshogs rim pa bzhin du stod dang / bar dang / smad rnams las gzugs med pa dang gzugs dang 'dod pa'i khams kyi ris rnams spros te khams gsum gyi bgegs rnams med par byas nas/ rang rang gi gnas su bsdu ba ni/ ngag dag par byed pa'o/ /de nas spyi bo dang / dpral ba dang / mgrin pa dang /snying ga'i thad kyi nam mkha' la shrī te ru ka'i yi ge bzhi kha dog sngon po bsams la de rnams kyi don dran par bya ste/ de yang shrī yig 'byung ba kun gyi don/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid 'dod/ /'di dag kun rdzob gzugs dang ni/ /'jug med bde ba'i mtha' can gang / /e waṃ la sogs gnyis med pa'ang / /shrī zhes bya ba'i yig des brjod/ /te yig snying ga nas kun du/ /he ru ka sogs rang 'khor 'gro/ /bsgom pa kun gyi 'byung gnas las/ /'dzin pa la sogs rnams bskyed 'gyur/ /da ni rgyu stong bdag nyid de/ /rgyu yi bdag nyid mi rtog pa'o/ /rang bzhin chos bdag med pa nyid/ /de ni stong pa'i rnal 'byor gnas/ /bkod pa gang zag bdag med pa/ /rtog pa'i dra ba chen po ni//12—6

—rgyu yig rkyen gyi 7bdag nyid can/ /de ni bdag gi bkod bral ba'o/ /slar brjod ka ni ma lus pa'i/ /bdag gis gnyis byar med shes gang / /gang phyir ci la'ang mi gnas pa/ /de phyir ka zhes bya bar brjod/ /ces bya ba dang /dngos po mngon sum stong pa min/ /dngos po tsam kyi rang bzhin can/ /dpal he ru ka gnas lha mo/ /snga nas sgo kun 'go ba'o/ /zhes bya ba brjod cing don dran par bya ba ni yid dag par byed pa'o/ /de nas phung po dang khams dang skye mched rnams lha'i nga rgyal bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas gzugs kyi phung po ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /'du byed kyi phung po ni rdo rje rgyal po'o / /rnam par shes pa'i phung po ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig dag ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /nyan pa dag ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna dag ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /kha dag ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /reg ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams ni ltung bar byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams ni gsod gyema'o/ /me'i khams ni 'gugs ma'o/ /rlung gi khams ni gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma 'bar ma'o/ /de rnams kyang slob dpon shes rab bsrungs kyis bkod pa bzhin du rtogs par bya'o/ /de nas g.yon pa'i mdzub mo dang mthe bong brdabs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha kā yi shaṃ t+t+waṃ ④hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛhā phyabā tsi tsā hūṃ dzihūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛ1 pa ya kṛ1 3pa ya tsi tā shaṃ kyetsa ra si oṃ hūṃ ke/hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān 4 snabadz+ra dz+nyā ni ka hūṃ nyunyehūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba brjod pas snying ga'i hūṃ las kha dog nag po 12—7

dang / ljang gu dang / dmar po dang / ser po'i mdog can rnams te tshangs pa'i mtha' nas 'og gser gyi sa bzhi la thug gi bar du sngags kyi gzugs chen po shar dang byang dang nub dang lho'i phyogs rnams su kha phyir phyogs pa rim pas spros pa dgod par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi 'og gi char ram yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūṃ sngon po yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje shin tu chen po gser gyi sa gzhi la thug pa/ hūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs pa bsams la/ de'i 'od zer dang sum̐ bha la sogs pa'i sngags kyi 'od zer rnams kyis rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi ra ba gru bzhi pa kha dog sngar dang mthun pa dang / rdo rje dang hūṃ gi 'od zer rnams kyi steng du rdo rje ste lnga pa ljang gu'i mda'i dra ba dang /de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i gur dang bla re yang bsam par bya'o/ /de nas sum̐ bha la sogs pa'i sngags bzhi las grub pa'i kha'i kyegadong can ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi dang / oṃ dang hūṃ 5hūṃ phaṭa las grub pa'i gshin rje brtan ma la sogs pa bzhi po rnams zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma phyag g.yas pas rdo rje tho ba bsnams shing /g.yon pas rang 'dra ba'i lha mo lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can g.yas na gri gug g.yon na thod pa thogs pa bsnams pa rnams la/ sarba bispyo skya.ā na ya dzaḥzhes bya ba brjod pas/ phyogs mtshams su son pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs rnams ra ba'i phyi rol du bkug pa'i dbus brgyad du/ hūṃ phyogs skyong gi kha dog dang mthun pa bsams te bgegs kyi tshogs rnams hūṃ la bsdus la/ de rnams gyur pa las phyogs skyong brgyad du bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas hūṃ gi sgra drag la ring ba bsgrags pas/ de rnams rang rang gi mdun du me'i dong chen po dmigs te lha mo rnams kyis de rnams su bcug ste phur bus mgo bo nas gdab cing / oṃ gha 72—8

gha lhaghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭha na phaṭa/ kri la ya khri la ya sarba pā grupaṃ phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra shī 3la badz+ra dha ro a dz+nyā pa ④ya ti bispyo rngukā ya bāka tsit+ta badz+ra kri la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ces bya ba lan gsum brjod pas mgrin pa dang snying gar yang gdab po/ /de nas oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra badz+ra tī khā byuko ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa ces bya ba lan gsum brjod pas rdo rje tho bas brdungs te rnam par rtog pa dang bcas pa'i srog dang bral munas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thob par bsam par bya ste/ lha mo rnams ra ba la thim pa dang / phyi nas rim pa bzhin me dang / rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang /'khor lo'i ra ba zlum po ril po gcig pa bsam par bya'o/ /'og gi hūṃ zhu ba las rdo rje phra mo rnams bar med par gtams te/ bdag dang 'go ba thams cad kun nas bgegs dang bral ba'o zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /de nas snying ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis/ bla ma dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te sngar gyi maṇ+ḍal kyi dbus su bzhugs par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes lan gsum brjod pas bsang gtor bya'o/ /oṃ pra ba ra sad kā ra pā bye pra tīts+tsha 〉swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis zhabs la zhabs bsil dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ pra ba ra sad kā ra ar+ghaṃ pra dīts+tsha kyeswā hā zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis lag pa g.yon pa mtha' nas phye ba'i phyag rgya mthe bong dang srin lag gis me tog dung gi chu la btags pa lan gsum gyis zhabs la mchod yon dbul bar bya'o/ /de ltar rang rang gi sngags kyis maṇ+ḍal du me tog dbul bar bya'o—/ /de nas thams cad la oṃ s+dzabadz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ/ oṃ phabadz+ra dhū pe hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dī pe hūṃ/ oṃ s+dzabadz+ra gadhe hūṃ/ oṃ s+dzabadz+ra be+e bi bye hūṃ/ zhes bya ba rnams kyis kyang mchod par bya'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las spros pa'i 12—9

mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug rnams kyis slob dpon shes rab bsrungs stikyi ltar mchod par bya'o/ /de nas rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis a+yobadud rtsi dang bcas pa'i chang dbul bar bya'o/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /'gro don rab tu sgrub pa po/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dir byung ba/ /dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs ye shes chen pos g.yogs/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /thugs rjes khro ba drag chen po/ /dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya bas bstod par bya'o/ /bkyis dang bgyid stsal rjes su yi rangs la sogs sdig pa ma lus pa ni skyon rnams ma lus nges par bcom pa yis/ /mdun du so sor bshags bya slar la yang ni mi byed pa yi sdom pa gzung ba nyid du bya/ /nyan thos dang ni bse ru bla med rgyal ba rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyis bsags pa'i dge ba la/ /rjes su yi ni rang zhing byang chub yang dag yongs su bsngo bar bdag gis bya/ /rgyal ba rin chen la sogs gsum la ji snyed skyabs su 'gre bar bya ba thams cad du ni bsgom/ /byang chub sems ni rnam par gzung ngo bla na med pa'i lam ni de bzhin bsten/ /de nas oṃ āḥbadz+ra muḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod pas gshegs par bya'o/ /de nas snying rje dang byams pa dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms dran par bya'o/ /de'i rjes su oṃ sarba dharmāḥshu n+ya swa bhā wa shu spyozhuhaṃ/ oṃ sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa snishurnyo3haṃ/ oṃ shā n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma kolhahaṃ/ oṃ yo ga shudhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shurnyo3haṃ/ zhes bya ba brjod cing don dran par byas te chos thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sngon gyi smon lam gyis sad pa'i sems nam mkha' la nā da la rim gyis rdzogs pa'i hūṃ blta'o/ /de dang dus mnyam du bsrung ba'i ra 12—10

ba la sogs pa rnams kyang blta bar bya'o/ /de'i nang gi 'og gi rmyechar yo sngon po yongs su gyur pa las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu mtha' gnyis na g.yo bzhin pa'i ba dan yo gis byin kyis brlab po/ /de'i steng du ram̐ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa 'bar bzhin pa'i grwa can re yig gis byin gyis brlabs 37pa'o/ /de'i steng du baṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa dang bcas pa la baṃ yig go/ /de'i steng du lo ser po yongs su gyur pa las/ sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa grwar rdo rje rtse gsum pa dang ldan pa lam̐ yig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de'i steng du yi ge sum̐ kha dog sna tshogs pa yongs su gyur pa las rin po che bzhi'i byerang bzhin gyi ri rab zur bzhi pa rtse mo brgyad dang ldan pa sum̐ yig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de'i steng du paṃ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs pad+ma de'i steng du hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje bsams te/'byung ba rnams zhu zhing sla ba'i rang bzhin du gyur nas gcig tu 'dres pas ri rab 'og tu rtsang bas 'byung ba zhu ba'i gong bu sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du chags pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal med khang sgo rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa ste/dbus su ni chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i nang du'o/ /gnyis pa gru bzhi pa la4 / gsum pa grwa ⑤lnga pa dang / bzhi par zur drug pa'i nang du ste/mdog dmar po steng du bltas pa rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ni rlum po yin la kun gyi phyi ma ni gru bzhi pa ste/ kun kyang gzhal yas khang gi rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa dur khrod dang bcas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor nang ma ni g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi rlung gnyis dbu mar 'dus pa'i rang bzhin gnag pa dang /12—11

sngo ba'i rtsig pa gnyis pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni sku gsung thugs dag pa'i rang bzhin sngo ba dang dmar po dang dkar po'i rtsig pa gsum dang ldan pa'o/ /gsum pa ni dga' ba bzhi dag pa'i rang bzhin sngon po dang ser po dang dmar po dang ljang gu'i ri mo bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /kun gyi phyi rol ni ye shes lnga dag pa ste phyi rol du dkar po dang bcas pa'o/ /kun gyi dkyil 'khor dbus ma'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du 'jigs byed chen po dang dus kyi mtshan mo'o/ /de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo rim pa gsum pa 1snadang ldan pa/ de'i phyi rol bskal pa bzang po'i snam bu dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi ma rnams la yang dus kyi khrupad+ma ma gtogs pa'o/ /pad+ma'i phyi rol nas nang gi phyi ma'i 'khor lo'i bar gyi mtshams rnams kyi phreng ba ni/ rim pa bzhin du gri gug dang rin po che dang rdo rje dang pad+ma dang 'khor lo dang ral gri dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang thod pa dang mgo bo dang keng rus dang zhags pa dang lcags kyu'i phreng ba rnams kyis bskor ba'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams ni sum cu rtsa drug go/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs re re'i steng du'ang ro'i gdan re re'o/ /de bzhin du pad+ma'i 'dab ma lha'i gnas rnams dang sgo dang mtshams rnams su yang ngo / /lha'i gnas ma yin pa mtshams kyi pad+ma rnams la ni rin po che'i bum pa re re'o/ /'khor lo'i kha dog rnams ni 'chad par 'gyur te/ de ltar rten gyi dkyil 'khor dmigs te rgyas par ni 'chad par 'gyur ba rnams kyis kyang shes par bya'o/ /de nas 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan kyi steng gi char ā li nyis 'gyur g.yon skor 1las de'i gzugs brnyan dang ldan pa'i zla ba bsgom pa ni me long lta bu'o/ /de'i steng du kā li ya ra la wa ḍa shwe dang bcas pa nyis 'gyur g.yon skor las de'i 72—12

—gzugs brnyan dang bcas pa'i nyi ma ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ngo bo'o/ /de gnyis kyi dbus su steng gi hūṃ zhugs te ⑫'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha rnams spros te 'gro ba thams cad de'i bdag nyid can du bye /byas nas 'dus te de nyid du zhugs pas rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ lte ba la hūṃ gis byen gyis brlabs pa ni so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin no/ /hūṃ las kyang 'od zer sna tshogs dpag tu med pa byung ste sngar lha nyid du bsgrubs 1pa ma lus pa dang gdod ma nas grub pa thams cad bkug ste/de nyid du gzhug pa 'di ni bya ba grub pa'o/ /de rnams thams cad yongs su gyur pa las rgyu'i he ru ka bskyed pa ni chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo ste de khyayang / sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi pa/ /sbyan gsum phyag ni bcu gnyis pa/ /shes rab kha spyor sbyor bdag nyid/ /byis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /dkar dang ljang gu dmar po thudang / /ser po g.yon nas bskor ba'o/ /zhal gyi ral pa'i cod pan la/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed 'dzin/ /'phrog byed dkar mo mnyam par mnan/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis yang dag bzhugs—/ /rdo rje dril bu glang chen gyi/ /pags pa cang te'u gri gug dang / /dgra sta rtse gsum de bzhin du/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga snod zhags pa dang / /mgo ste g.yon dang g.yas par ro/ /shes rab rang dang 'dra ba la/ /'on kyang bud med mtshan nyid ldan/ /de nas de nyid kyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ gi sa bon blta bar bya ste 'di ni bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas yab kyi gsang ba'i rdo rje mi dmigs pa las tsohūṃ sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'o/ /yi ge bye dmar ser las nor bu ste de nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pas/ bu gar phaṭa ser po mgo phyir bstan pa'o/ /āḥdamar po las yī gyi pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/12—13

t+t+waṃ lkudakar ser las ze 'bru de nyid kyis mtshan pa/ bu gar phaṭa ser po mgo phyir bstan pa'o/ /de nas rig ma la rdo rje phag mo'i snying po dang nye ba'i snying po dang bcom ldan 'das kyi snying po dang nye ba'i snying po rim pa ji lta bus lte ba dang snying ga dang mgrin pa dang 3)dpral bar bkod de tsudza na zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das mas kyang / de nyid kyi snying po dang nye ba'i snying po mgrin pa dang dpral bar bkod de rang nyid kyi lte ba dang snying gar bkod la tsudza na zhes ༄1bya'o/ /de nas yi ge gsum brjod cing dga' ba brtsam par bya ste/snying ga'i sa bon kyi 'od zer dang rdo rje dang pad+ma'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul te/ zhal du zhugs nas lha mo'i pad+mar babs tripa dang gnyis ka bde ba chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor zhu bar gyur pa dngul chu'i rdog ma lta bu ste 'di ni nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas byams pa dang snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi thig le de nyid las 'thon te rang rang gi gnas su pad+ma'i 'dab ma rnams la 'dug nas bskul bar mdzad pa ste/ de yang mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa drug gis mgrin gcig tu/ mnga' bdag nyi ma re rer 'gro ba mgron 'bod na/ /khyod ni ci yi phyir na stong pa nyid du bzhugs/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bdag ni snying rje'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje khya'adzin pa bde chen bdag la 'dod pa mdzod/ /lā ma la sogs pa rnams kyis/gson cig gson cig gzhan gyi dgos pa nub/ /'jig rten phyugs gang shi ba bzhin du gyur/ /bdag gi pad+ma rgyas pa la 'dod mdzod/ /de ltar 'jig rten kun bder gyur par byos/ /dum skyes ma la sogs pas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa 72—14

bdag la rol cig rol/ /lhan skyes rang bzhin brjod du med pa 'thob/ /sems can 'jig rten gzhan ni rmongs gyur pas/ /ji ltar khyod ni stong pa don med gyur/ /gzugs can ma la sogs pas kyang / khrod ni chos rnams kun gyi byed pa ste/ /ci phyir lhan skyes rang bzhin 'gro med bzhugs/ /bdag la mchog gi don gyis 'dod pa mdzod/ /ji ltar khrod ni 'jig rten rnam shestemathun bzhud / /de nas de rnams thig le de nyid la zhugs par blta'o/ /de nas thig le de nyid yongs su gyur pa las hūṃ gi yi ge sngon po'o/ /de las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūṃ ljang sngon dang bcas pa'o/ /de yongs su gyur pa las dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa skad cig gis rdzogs par blta ba ni gsang sngags 'di 'don bzhin pa'o/ /de yang / glu 'dis rjes su bskul ba yis/ /rang nyid he ru kar rab sad/ /oṃ s+dzakā ya bāñtsit+ta badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa hoḥ/ gsang sngags 'di ni 'don pa na/ /skad cig rnam pa'i rnal 'byor ldan/ /skad cig sngags pas byung bdag nyid/ /dpa' bo kun dang rnal 'byor ma'o/ /'jigs byed mtshan mo nag mo dang / /lte ba nyi ma me mchog la/ /gar du mdzad pa yi ni sku//gnag dang ljang gu phyed phyed do/ /bdun cu rtsa drug phyag dang ni/ /zhal bcu bdun la spyan gsum pa/ /dpa' bo ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin/ /sna tshogs rdo rje zla phyed can/ /mche ba chen po gcigs pa'i zhal/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa rtag tu ni/ /ser ba dang ni ljang gur grags/ /nub ni dmar po de bzhin te//lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /mche ba gcigs pa 'jigs par byed/ /rim pa ji lta'i mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /g.yas dang g.yon par shes par bya /glang chen pags pa phyag gnyis kyis/ /skye gnas phyag rgya de bzhin gzhan/ /rdo 12—15

rje ral gri mdung rings dang / /rtse gsum ji lta'i rim pas g.yas/ /dgra sta gri gug mda' dang ni/ /gsal shing phub rngudang tho ba dang / /'khor lo cang te'u chu gri dang / /dbyug to dang ni mtshon rtse gcig /dung dang zangs dung dbyi byugu dang / /rma bya'i mjug ma de bzhin du/ /bya rog sgro dang pir dang ni//me yi thab dang ri bo dang / /dbyeg stipa me long pi wang dang / /rkang mgo lag pa glo ba dang / /rgyu pyam sgra gcan lcags sgrog dang / /gdos dang dum bu sa ⑤nya rgya/ /mgo med 'bar ba'i mar nag dang / /'jigs byed gzugs te rim pas so/ /g.yon par dril bu phub rings mche/ /gtun shing zhags pa thod pa dang / /gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga pu ste'u/ /phub chung yu can sdigs mdzub dang / /g.yer ka'i 3phreng dang lcags sgrog dang / /brag dang dur khrod rdul dang ni/ /sgo kam rnga dang lpags 8rlon dang / /skra yi thag pa 'phyang ba dang / /ro bsreg 1 bskul ba'i shing bu dang / / 'phangs dang phub terings mgo bo dang / /keng rus zor ba de bzhin du/ /mig dang mkha' kyem gnye ma dang / /spen pa dang ni phur bu dang / /sa bon gang ba sog le dang / /kha dang slud bshus ⑫pags pa dang / /sprin char 'bab dang shing lcags kyu/ /phyag gi mtshon cha bdun cu gnyis/ /de lta'i rim pas shes par bya/ /mgo bo lnga yis rgyan tsu/du byas/ /phyag rgya drug dang ldan pas klubs/ /de bzhin mgo brgya'i phreng ba dang / /dpung rgyan zhabs gdub sgra sgrogs dang / /sku la ba spu'i phreng bar ldan/ /sku yi tshigs rnams thams cad la/ /shes rab thabs kyi bde bas brlan/ /sna tshogs te ru ka 'bar bas/ /rnam par 'phros bcas rnam bsgom bya/ /dbu rnams kun la dar dpyangs kyi 5/ /12—16

phreng ba brtul zhugs stican kyis bya/ /zhes bya ba ni gtso bo sgom napa ste 'di ni bsgrub snepa'o// //de yi mdun du lha mo che/ /rdo rje phag mo mdog dmar mo/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis ma ste/ /g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug dang / /sdigs mdzub phyogs rnams kun du ngu mdzad/ /g.yon pas gdug pa'i khrag bkang ba'i/ /thod bcas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud/ /gcer bu spyan gsum skra grol ma/ /spyan gsum drag mo'i gzugs can ma/ /zhal gyi mche ba gcigs ma ste/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba 'dzin pa mo/ /sgeg pa'i rgyan rnams dang ni ldan/ /dbu la thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /yan lag lha rdzas dris nyer byugs/ /zhabs gdub dpung rgyan rnams dang ldan/ /lha rdzas me tog phreng bas klubs/ /rtse phran zlar gnas rdo rje ni/ /dpral bar rtag tu 'dzin pa mo/ /sku la phyag rgya lnga la sogs/ /'jig chodus me lta'i 'od zer can/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs mdun du/ /sku las 'bar ba'i phreng ba spro/ /zhes bya ba ni yum bsgom pa ste/ sgrub pa chen po'o / /dang po gnas dang / bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba la sogs pa nas 'di dag gi bar du ni/ dang po spyor ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin lus kyi rang bzhin can no/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma shar sogs kyi/ /bar bar du ni rnal 'byor ma/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i grangs nyid ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs drug drug go/ /shar la sogs nas byang gi mthar/ /mkha' 'go ma sogs drug de bzhin/ /dang po byang nas nub kyi mthar/ /slar yang lā ma la sogs drug /nub la sogs nas lho yi mthar/ /dum skyes ma la sogs pa'i rigs/ /dang po lho nas shar gyi mthar/ /de nas gzugs can ma 12—17

sogs drug /mkha' mgro ma dang gzugs can nyid/ /'o byed ma dang gzhan bsgyur ma/ /byis bcas ma dang rjes 'jug ma/ /phyed nag phyed sngo can rnams so/ /lā lkum rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang / /bzang 2 mo thod pa can nag mo/ /rgyal po bskor ma phyed ljang gu/ /gang phyir phyed dmar rim pas so/ /dum skyes ma dang dur khrod ma/ /rnam par zhu ma ku ru kul/ /glu ma gar mar grags ma rnams/ /phyed dmar ba la phyed ser mo/ /gzugs can 'jigs byed gtsug phud ma/ /thor tshugs ral pa can drag mo/ /lha mo phyed ser phyed nag mo/ /phyag mtshan la sogs phag mo bzhin/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la ni/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi snod rnams so/ /g.yas brkyang zhabs kyis de bzhin du/ /thod pa'i phreng ba sogs 'dzin ma/ /g.yon skor ne+edu ni shes bya ste/ /ri rab steng gi char skyes ma'o/ /'di ni thig le'i 'khor lo zhes bya'o// //de'i rgyab rdo rje'i 'khor lo ni/ /sngo nag 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams kyis/ /g.yon skor 5rim pas bsam bya ba/ /shes rab thabs dang mnyam spyor ba'o/ /de dag kyang mkha' 'gro ma dang rdo rje rmemakha' 'gro'o/ /lā ma dang sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'o/ /dum skyes ma dang pad+ma tsumakha' 'gro'o/ /gzugs can ma dang rin chen mkha' 'gro'o/ /rab tu gtum mo dang thod pa'i dum bu can no/ /gtum pa'i mig can ma dang keng rus chen po'o/ /'od ldan ma dang keng rus so//sna chen mo dang mche ba rnam par gcigs pa'o/ /dpa' ba'i blo gros ma dang dgra'i lha'o/ /mi'u thung ma dang 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang rdo rje 'od do/ /shing grib ma dang rdo rje'i sku'o/ /sa srung — snam dang 12—18

myu gu can no/ /'jigs byed chen mo tshosnadang / rdo rje naral pa can no/ /rlung gi /shugs can ma dang dpa' bo chen po'o/ /chang za ma dang rdo rje hūṃ mdzad do/ /sngo bsangs lha mo dang shin tu bzang po'o/ /rab tu bzang mo dang rdo rje bzang po'o/ /rta rna ma dang 'jigs byed chen po'o/ /bya gdong ma dang mig mi bzang ngo / /'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang stobs po che'o /dum skyes ma dang rin chen rdo rje'o/ /chang 'tshong ma dang rta mgrin no/ /'khor lo'i go cha ma dang nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /shin tu dpa' mo dang he ru ka'o//stobs chen ma dang pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /'khor los 4sgyur ma dang rnam par snang mdzad do/ /brtson 'grus chen mo dang rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /gshin rje mo'i bu mo dang stobs po che'o/ /gshin rje ma dang ye shes mkha' 'gro'o/ /g.yo byed ma dang blo brtan ma'o/ /skrag byed ma dang brtan pa'o/ /gtum mo dang thar pa'o/ /dbyangs can ma dang ye shes so/ /'dod grub zhem dang thabs so/ /'bar ba chen mo dang thugs kyi rdo rje ste/ kha dog 'khor lo ji lta ba'o / /phyag bzhi ma la zhal gcig ma/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin/ /cang te'u gri gug de bzhin no/ /skra grol phyogs kyi gos can ma/ /sku la phyag rgya lnga sogs te/ /rdo rje'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /yi dwags gdan can drag chen mo/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan pa dang //de bzhin shes rab thabs ldan pa'o/ /thabs rnams dpa' bo'i rgyan ldan zhing / /dpa' mo'i pang na gnas pa'o/ /lhag ma'i ming ni dpa' mo bzhin/ /skyes bu'i rtags rnams su bya'o/ /'khor lo bcu gcig rnams kyis ni/ /sgo la sogs pa'i yang de bzhin no/ /snying po'i pad+ma'i lha mo rnams/ /gtso bos 6 12—19

bdag po bzhin du bya/ /'on kyang bdag po sogs 'khor lor/ /ji ltar bskal bzang rgyal ba ni/ /bzhi yis dman pa'i stong phrag gcig /de rnams thams cad rnam bsgom bya/ /mtshan ni yon tan dbye bas phye/ /sprul pa'i sku can bdag nyid do/ /gang zhig gang gi 'khor lo yi/ /rnal 'byor ma ni thog mar byung / /de yi bcu gnyis shes par bya/ /kun spyod gnas dang nye gnas ma'o/ /lhag ma sa ni bcu gsum pa/ /sgo dang grwa la gnas ma'o/ /mchod dang bstod sogs dus su ni/ /thog mar rdo rje'i ming shes bya/ /dpa' bo rnams la'ang de bzhin no/ /de ltar gzugs med khams dang ni/ /de yang gnas su nges par brjod/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sar grags pa'o/ /slar yang gnas dang nye gnas sogs/ /de ltar sa yi dbus su yang / /sa bcu gnyis su 'dod pa yin/ /de ltar thams cad du shes bya/ /khams gcig 'dir ni thams cad med/ /sum cu rtsa drug bshad pa rnams/ /gtso bo yon tan kun rang bzhin/ /de ltar khams ni dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma yi rang bzhin can/ /khor yug tu ni sems can rnams/ /rdzus skyes rigs kyi rim pas so/ /de yang sum cu rtsa drug gi/ /yul dang yul rim pas phye ba'o/ /zhes bya ba ni rdo rje'i 'khor lo'oshe // //de nas de yi phyi rol 'chad/ /slar yang snying po'i 'khor lo 'di/ /dmar ser kha dog la de bzhin/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi dbus su ni/ /rdo rje 'chang ma mi bskyod ma/ /rnam snang rin chen dbang mo dang / /pad+ma gar dbang don yod ma/ /spyan ma dang ni mā ma shī/ /gos dkar sgrol ma 12—20

gzugs rdo rje/ /sgra dang dri dang ro de bzhin/ /reg dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /sa snying ma dang mkha' snying mo/ /phyag ma 'jig rten mgon po ma/ /sgrib kun sel ma kun bzang mo/ /rin chen sgrol ma bdag med ma / /khro gnyer ri khrod lo ma can/ /gshin mthar byed ma shes mtha' ma / /pad mtha' ma bgegs mthar byed ma/ /mi g.yo ma dang dbyug sngon ma/ /'dod rgyal mo dang stobs chen mo/ /gtsug tor ma dang gnod mdzes malku/ /kha dog 'khor lo ji bzhin te/ /zhal la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid kun/ /lhag ma rdo rje'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /nye ba'i gnas su lha mo rnams/ /rang 'dra'i thabs dang bsam par bya/ /g.yas brkyang ba yi zhabs kyis kyang / /gzugs kyi khams dang sa dri med/ /zla ba'i gling du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes bya ba ni snying po'i 'khor lo ste gnyis ngasashes 2 de nas de'i rgyab yon tan kun/ /zhes bya'i 'khor lo dkar dmar ba/ /rdo rje'i rtsibs kyi dbus sbyin pa/ /pho nya ma mchog sum cu drug /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs moshe/ /dmangs mo gtum mo khye 'tshong ma/ /g.yung mo gar ma thod pa can/ /nya ba mo dang spyig gar ma/ /dung mkhan ma dang tha ga mo/ /khur ba mkhan mo shing bzo ma/ /phreng ba khwa ba tshos ma dang / /srin bal cebyed ma pho nya mo/ /rus bzo thum dang rtsis mkhan ma/ /chang 'tshong ldum ra'i gnyer pa mo/ /rgyal pos bkrabs ma shan pa mo/ /so rtsi 'tshong bar byed ma dang / /gser mgar mo dang lcags mgar mo/ /nor bu brgyud ma nags pa mo/ /kla khro e ḍi tshong ba mo/ /rdo bzo ma dang zhing las ma/ /ko lpags mo ste rnal 12—21

'byor ma/ /'di rnams 'khor lo'i kha dog go/ /lhag ma thams cad snying po yi//'khor lo ji bzhin shes par bya/ /'dir ni zhing du shes bya ste/ /'dod khams rigs kun bdag nyid dang / /dkar po'i gling zhes bya bar bshad/ /rang gi shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /'od ༄1byed pa yi sa de bzhin/ /de yi phyi rol khyams rnams la/ /bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /stong du bzhi yis nyung ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhi po la/ /nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu dgu/ /bskal pa bzang po'i mdo nyid na/ /stong tshang bar 5/bzhugs te / 'khor ba 'jig ༄ dang gser thub dang / 'od srungs rnams ni sngar gshegs pas 'khor du mi 'os pa'i phyir dang / shākya thub pa ni mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho rang nyid yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi po ma gtogs pa'o/ /lha'i snam bu'i shar nas g.yon skor cedu rim pas thams cad kyang pad+ma dang zla ba la bzhugs pa dka' thub kyi cha byad can sgu mdog sna tshogs pa rnams te/ de yang mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po/ byams pa dang / seng ge dang / rab gsal dang /thub pa dang / me tog dang / me tog gnyis pa dang / spyan legs dang /ded dpon dang / lag chen dang / stobs chen dang / rgyu dkar thurgyal po dang / rtsi sman dang / snyan pa'i tog dang / 'od chen dang / grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / nyi ma'i snying bo dang / zla ba dang / 'od 'phro dang / 'od bzangs /5dang / mya ngan med dang / skar rgyal dang / rab gsal dang / phreng thogs dang / yon tan 'od dang /don gzigs dang / mar me dang / mthu ldan dang / sman pa dang / des pa dang / mdzod spu dang / brtan ldan dang / lha'i dpal dang / gdul 12—22

dka' dang / yon tan rgyal mtshan dang / sgra gcan dang / tshogs ldan dang / tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / tshig ldan dang / mi 'gying ba dang /'od mdzad dang / lhun chen dang / rdo rje dang / sdom pa can dang / mi snyems pa dang / rin po che dang / pad+ma'i spyan dang / stobs kyi sde dang /me tog 'od zer dang / ye shes dgyes hūṃdang / gzi chen dang / tshangs pa dang / 'od dpag med dang / klu sbyin dang / brtan gshegs dang /don yod mthong dang / brtson 'grus sbyin dang / bzang skyong dang /dga' bo dang / 'chi med dang / seng ge 7rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal ba dang /chos ldan dang / mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po dang / kha lo sgyur —dang /dgyes gshegs dang / chu lha dang / yon tan lag dang / spos kyi glang po dang / rnam par gzigs dang / 'brug sgra dang / legs sems dang /yid bzangs chodang / dri med dang / zla ba dang / grags chen dang /gtsug na nor bu dang / drag shul dang / seng ge'i stobs dang / ljon pa dang / rnam par rgyal ba chen po dang / shes rab brtsegs pa dang / legs gnas dang / blo gros dang / yan lag skyes dang / blo mtha' yas dang /gzugs bzang dang / mkhyen ldan dang / 'od zer dang / brtul zhugs brtan dang / bkra shis dang / bden pa'i tog dang / pad+ma dang / sred med kyi bu dang / lag bzangs 5dang / ye shes 'byung gnas dang / yon tan 'od 'phro dang / tshangs sbyin dang / rin chen 'byung gnas dang /lha'i me tog dang / don legs sems pa 6dang / chos kyi dbang phyug dang /blo gros grags pa dang / spobs pa brtsegs dang / rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang /12—23

phan par bzhed pa dang / rnam par rol par ldan pa dang / mun pa dang bral ba dang / sgra gcan lha dang / ri bo'i rgyal mtshan dang / tshogs chen 'od dang / rin chen snying po dang / shin tu mthor gshegs dang / skar rgyal dang / ru rings dang / yon tan grags dang / 'od ldan nyi zla dang /nyi ma'i 'od dang / skar mkhan dang / seng ge tog dang / dus mkhyen rgyal po dang / dpal gyi snying po dang / srid mthar gzigs pa dang / glog gi 'od dang / gser kyi ri bo dang / seng ges byin pa dang / gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / mchog dga' grags pa dang / brtson 'grus brtan pa dang / grags rdzogs dang / bsnyengs pa bral dang / mchod 'os lha dang / sgron ma chen po dang / 'jig rten 'od dang / spos dri zhim pa dang / yon mchog 1'dzin dang / mun pa dang bral ba dang / seng ge'i 'gram pa dang / rin chen grags pa dang / skyon rab tu zhi ba dang /bdud rtsi 'chang dang / mi'i zla ba dang / shin tu gzigs dang / rab tu brgyan pa dang / nor bu'i 'od dang / ri bo brtsegs pa'i tog dang / don nges ldan dang / tshe spyin dang / rin chen 'byung gnas dang / skye dbang mtshungs dang / stobs kyis gshegs pa dang / blo gnas pa dang /gdugs mdzes dang / gtso bo dang / shin tu 'phags pa dpal dang /seng ge'i sgra dang / rnam par rol ldan dang / klu'i 'od dang / me tog gi ri bo dang / klu dga' dang / spos kyi dbang phyug dang / shin tu grags pa dang / stobs lha dang / yon tan phreng bar ldan pa dang / klu'i lag pa dang / mig brgyan pa dang / legs par sbyangs pa'i blo dang / zil gyis 12—21

gnon pa'i ye shes dang / mtha' yas spyan dang / bden par gsung ba skyadang / nyi ma'i 'od dang / des rngupa'i blo dang / mtha' yas pa'i gzugs dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / rin chen tog dang / je tshom spangs pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / don yod rnam par gnon pa dang /rtogs mdzad dang / me tog rgyal mtshan dang / ri dbang rgyal po dang /gzi brjid che dang / don mdzad gzigs dang / grags pa mtha' yas dang /rin chen lha dang / don gnas mkhyen dang / dman min grags pa dang /mya ngan med pa dang / dri ma bral ba dang / tshangs lha dang / sa'i dbang phyug dang / me tog spyan dang / rnam par 'byes pa'i sgu dang / chos kyi 'od dang / kun rnam gzigs dang / yon tan 'od gsal dang / zla ba'i zhal dang / rin chen 'od dang / rin chen tog dang / grags pa'i bla ma dang / 'od byed dang / gzi brjid dpag med dang / dus mkhyen dang /seng ge'i sku dang / mkhas blo dang / rgyal bar dka' dang / yon tan phung po dang / zla ba'i tog dang / mthu thob pa dang / mthu rtsal mtha' yas pa dang / zla ba dang / dri ma med pa dang / don rnams thams cad gzigs pa dang / dpa' bo dang / 'byor par ldan pa dang / bsod nams dang /sgron ma dang / yon tan 'phro dang / blo yangs pa dang / legs skyes dang /nor lha dang / yid gnyis spong ba dang / 'dzin pa dpag chomed dang /mchog sred dang / choms med dang / mi gnas pa dang / bder gnas dang / tshogs can gtso bo dang / 'gro ba'i 'od zer dang / phal chen dang /rgyal ba dang / gzi brjid mtha' yas dang / don gyi blo gros dang / sman 12—25

pa'i rgyal po dang / tha ba spangs dang / rims nad med pa dang / legs sbyin dang / grags sbyin tsudang / me tog byin dang / skyes bus byin dang /rdo rje'i sde dang / phal chen byin pa dang / zhi ba'i blo gros dang / spobs pa'i glang po dang / sred med kyi bu dang / des pa dang / mi tshugs pa dang /nyi zla dang / glog gi tog rnams so/ /de yis bye phyi rol zlum por sbyin/ /ri mo gnyis ni gnag dang sngo/ /sgo dang rta babs kha khyer dang / /dra ba dra ba phyed pas mdzes/ /shar gyi sgo yi dbus su yang / /mkha' 'gro ma 'dra'i khwa gdong ma/ /byang du 'ug pa'i gdong can ma/ /nub tu khyi gdong can ma dang //lho ru phag gi gdong can te/ /kha dog lā ma sogs 'dra mchog /me dang bden bral rlung dang ni/ /dbang ldan mtshams na gnas pa mo/ /gshin rje mche ba pho nya mo/ /mche gabyugs 'joms ma ༄ rim ji bzhin/ /kha dog gnyis gnyis mnyam par bya/ /zhal ni rjes su mthun rim pas/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po thams cad kyi/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang ni/ /lho yi sa gzhi rtag pa ru/ /gnag dang sngo dang ljang dang dmar/ /ser po yi ni mdog tu bya/ /lhan skyes dkyil 'khor de bzhin du/ /gang phyir 'khor lo rim pa bzhin/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa/ /mjug tu bya'o rim ji bzhin/ /'khor lo gnyis po ri mo gsum/ /gsum pa la ni ri mo bzhi/ /bzhi par ri mo lnga'i bdag nyid / /dur khrod kun nas rim pas te/ /phyi rol la sogs sa gzhi ni/ /zlum po'i dbyibs su bya bar 'dod/ /'khor lo rim pa lnga'i bdag nyid/ /grwa bzhi pa la kun du 'bar/ /'dod pa yi yon 4/snam bu la/ /brgyad gnyis lha mo 5mchod byed pa/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi po rnams la'o/ /de la 12—26

lhan skyes 'khor lo yi/ /dur khrod gnas rnams bshad bya ste/ /gtum drag tshang tshing de bzhin du/ /'bar bas 'khrigs pa keng rus can/ /'jigs sde shar la sogs pa yi/ /phyogs su g.yon skor 2yongs su gnas/ /a ⑤ḍa ḍa rgod dbang ldan du/ /dpal gyi nags ni sreg zar te/ /mun pa drag po bden bral du/ /rlung du ki li ki li sgrogs/ /dur khrod drag bo'i gzugs rnams ni/ /ro langs 'byung po ce spyang sgra/ /rim pa 'di yis gnas pa ste/ /dur khrod brgyad po rnams su yang / /shing dang phyogs skyong klu dbang ste/ / shing ṣa khyab gnas kang ke li/ /tsu ④ti'i shing dang n+ya rngugro dha/ /de bzhin ka rañdza ka nyid/ /la ta par+ṣa pār tha pitre/ /dbang po nor sbyin de bzhin du/ /klu dbang dang ni gshin rje'i bdag /dbang ldan de nas sreg za dang / /srin po'i dbang po rlung bdag bo/ /nor rgyas 'jog po de bzhin du/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang pad+ma nyid/ /pad chen hu lu hu lu dang / /rigs ldan dang ni dung skyong dang / /sgrogs pa dang ni 'ur sgrogs dang / /drag po 'khyil pa mthug de bzhin/ /gang ba char 'be+ebs gtum po ste/ /'di rnams sprin gyi bdag po'o/ /'dir ni dur khrod thams cad la/ /rdo rje phreng ba rnam par sbyin1sna/ /thams cad kyang 'dir de bzhin bya/ /phyi dang nang du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes bya ba ni gsum pa yon tan gyi 'khor lo'o // // de nas de'i phyi nam mkha' yi nyu1/ /'khor lo 'dam skyes sngon po mtshungs/ /sum cu drug rtsibs dbus su yang / /mkha' spyod rnal 'byor ma 'di rnams/ /mi'am ci mo dri za mo/ / hu ṭu sakā ma pā ḍa ba ma de bzhin du/ /pi wang gling 12—27

bu mu kun+da ma dang / /rdza rnga ma dang nges par gag ri ma dang / /cha lang ma dang shī ledh+ri hūṃki ma/ /glu ma ka ra ḍi khyedang ta ma ḍā ①mchog dang / /gar ma sgeg mo bhāk+ka ma dang ni/ /tā li sha ra ṇa mo rnga chen mo/ /mo dri ma dang rgyud can ma dang mā tu ma/ /nā la bā mo de bzhin byesba ④ki/ /ḍam ru ma dang cheṇa ṭu rboka ma dang de bzhin du/ /zangs dung ma dang rwa dung ma de bzhin/ /bhu ki ma dang dril bu ma dang dril chung ma/ /g.yer ka ma dang de bzhin ḍa ko li ma dang / /dung ma dang ni dbyangs ldan ma de bzhin/ /'khor ma mchog gi dbang phyug ma/ /kha dog sna tshogs bkra ba'am/ /yang na 'khor lo'i kha dog go/ /nye ba'i zhing na gnas pa mo/ /ku sha'i gling na gnas ma mchog /mkha' la spyod pa'i rigs su byon / /gling 'di la ni yang dag gnas/ /sa ni 'od 'phro can de dang / /rang rang gnas sogs zhing can ma'o/ /yang na ḍa ma ru kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'di ni slar yang spangs nas su/ /rang rang mtshan ma so so'i tshul/ /ji ltar 'dod par bya ba'o/ /'khor lo kun gyi cod pan la/ /rang gi bdag pos bya ba yin / /'dir ni shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /rigs ldan bdag nyid rigs can ma'o/ /ji ltar rgyan la sogs mang po/ /lhag ma sngon bzhin bya ba yin/ /dkyil 'khor kun du spyan gsum dang / /phyogs kyi gos 'chang rje 'go ma'o/ /zhes bya ba ni nam mkha'i 'khor lo ste 'khor lo gnyis pa'i dang po'o/ / //de yi phyi rol rlung 'khor lo/ /sngon po sna tshogs pa yi mdog /rdo rje'i rtsibs dbus sbyin bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams rim ji bzhin/ /nam mkha'i snying po las gzhan ming / /blo dang ldan pas shes par bya/ /mkha' lding dang 72—28

mo bkra ba mo/ /bya rog bya dkar sreg pa mo/ /rma bya zangs kyi gtsug phud ma/ /gu da bu li 'jam pa mo/ /phug ron bya rog chen mo ①dang / /ga ḍi nī dang gong snyem sreg /ne+e tso sngags ma bzhad ma dang / /bya rgod 'ug pa mchil ba mo/ /shing bye'u mo dang ngur pa mo/ /bṛk+ṣu kyeri ṭī kak+ka bī④/ /so bya mo dang byi la mo/ /lcug ma'i mgrin dang sā ri mo/ /khra mo gur kum lce can ma/ /bā ḍi rī kā dze+e 3gha mo/ /hor mo kai ṭuka mo de bzhin/ /dad da rī ṣ+ṭamo ri dwags dgra/ /de ltar rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo/ /'khor lo'i sa gzhi gang 'dra'i mdog /yang na rang rang la shes bya/ /phyag sogs de bzhin sngon dang mtshungs/ /thams cad shes rab thabs bdag nyid—/ /'dun pa la ni gnas ma mchog /sbyang dka'i sar ni shes bya ste/ /mi'am ci yi gling mar 'dod/ /'khor lo 'di ni sgong skyes dang / /yon tan gsum gyi dbye ba can/ /gsum gyi bdag nyid gsum pa yi/ /'khor lo drod gsher skyes gzugs can/ /bzhi pa mngal skyes zhes bya ba/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid 'dod/ /ces bya ba ni rlung gi 'khor lo ste/ /'khor lo gnyis pa'i gnyis pa'o// //de nas phyi rol gyi bshad bya/ /'khor lo sa yi ming can mchog /kha dog ser po'i rang bzhin la/ /sum cu drug rtsibs rnams kyis spras/ /rnal 'byor ma ni sum cu drug /sa spyod ma rnams rim ji bzhin/ /seng ge stag mo t+tasnyi ༄nari bong ma/ /glang chen ri dwags byi la mo/ /ba dang ma tsohe mo rnga mo/ /ce spyang mo dang bse mo 'bri/ /byi la bong mo bye ḍi tsom/ /ra mo lug mo rim pa bzhin / /khye mo phag mo dom mo dang / /ḍaṇ+ḍa rī mo dz+nyā 1 ma de bzhin/ /dred ⑫12—29

mo dang ni sgeg mo dang / /nags ma dang ni khyim chen mo/ /bya rog chen mo khwa sgo mayo—/ /sbrul mo bkra mo rnga mo dang / /sre mo rtsangs mo phug pa mo/ /grong na gnas pa ma mchog go/ /de ltar 'khor lo'i mdog bzhin nam/ /yang na rang rang kha dog go/ /lha mo shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /nye ba'i 'dun sar gnas pa mo/ /mngon du gyur pa'i sa nyid dang / /de ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /krung krung gling du gnas pa mo/ /mtshon cha la sogs sngon bzhin no/ /lus ni bud med rnam pa'i gzugs/ /gdong pa rang gi dngos por 'dod/ /de'i phyir 2bskal bzang sangs rgyas rnams/ /sngar gyi rim pas bsam par bya/ /mchod pa dang / dpal sbas dang / ye shes nyi ma dang / don grub dang /lhun po brtsegs pa dang / dgra 'dul dang / pad+ma dang / dgra bcom grags pa dang / ye shes 'gros dang / nyon mongs bral dang / 'dam — /bu dang / spos bzangs dang / yul 'khor rangs dang / lha grags dang /srid mtha' gzigs dang / zla ba dang / sgra gcan dang / rin chen zla ba dang / seng ge'i rgyal mtshan dang / bsam gtan dgyes dang / rdzogs ldan dang / rnam par grol ba dang / yon tan rin chen dang / dgra bcom grags pa dang / pad+ma'i ngos dang / mdzod spu ldan dang / spobs pa grags pa dang / rdo rje nor bu dang / tshe dpag med dang / nor bu bkod pa dang /dbang chen dang / yon tan 'byung gnas dang / lhun po grags dang /'od zer bcu pa dang / ma smad pa dang / glang po'i 'gros dang / yid du 'thad pa dang / rin chen zla ba dang / zhi ba dang / rab gsal rgyal po dang / kha lo sgyur dang / dga' ba'i dbang phyug dang / gtsug ne rin po 12—30

che dang / bsnyengs bral dang / rin chen snying po dang / zla ba'i zhal dang /dri ma med par grags pa dang / zhi ba'i gzi brjed dang / dga' ba'i tog dang / sgra gcan lha dang / na tshod bzang po dang / lha dag dga' dang /rin chen phung po dang / mdzes par gshegs pa dang / seng ge'i phyogs pa dang / shin tu mthor gshegs dang / skye ba'i dbang po dang / blo gros bzang po dang / 'jig rten 'od dang / rin chen gzi brjid dang / skal ldan shing rta dang / kun du rgyal ba dang / dga' ba bkod pa dang /stegs mdzad dang / spos kyi glang po dang / blo gros 'od 'phro dang / ri bo'i rgyal mtshan dang / spos bzangs lkudang / chos brten dang / gzi brjid drag shul can dang / chos kyi nor bu dang / bzang po byin dang /bder ༄ gshegs zla ba dang / tshangs dbyangs dang / seng ge'i zla ba dang /dpal dang / legs par skyes dang / thub pa med pa'i tshogs dang /grags pa'i bshes gnyen dang / bden pa dang / dka' thub chen po dang /ldun po'i 'od zer dang / yon tan brtsegs pa dang / mchod pa grags pa dang / chos grags pa dang / sbyin pa'i 'od dang / glog 'byin dang /bden par gsung dang / 'tsho byed dang / na tshod bzang po dang / legs pa'i tshogs can dang / rnam par nges pa'i blo gros dang / srid mtha' nor bu'i spos dang / rgyal bas dgyes dang / seng ge'i 'od zer dang / rnam par snang mdzad dang / grags mchog dang / thugs rab gzhungs dang /nor bu zla ba dang / drag shul 'od zer dang / brtul zhugs thub med dang /'gro bas mchod pa dang / nor bu'i tshogs dang / 'jig rten bla ma dang /12—31

glang chen dang / seng ge dang / zla ba dang / rin chen 'od zer dang /sgra gcan sbed dang / yon tan rgya mtsho dang / 'od zer ldan pa dang /rab tu zhi ba'i stobs dang / 'jig rten bzang po dang / mya ngan med pa dang / shugs bcu pa dang / stobs la dgyes pa dang / mthu'i dpal dang /mthu thob pa snadang / mthu chen dang / yon tan snying po dang / bden par spyod pa dang / dge mchog rgyal po dang / skar rgyal dang / 'od zer chen po dang / glog gi 'od dang / yon tan rgya chen dang / rin bo che dang /dpal 'od dang / bdud 'dul ba dang / go cha bgos pa dang / seng ge'i phyag dang / me tog bzang po dang / rin chen mthon po dang / rgya mtsho dang / sa 'dzin dang / don gye blo mnga' ba dang / yon tan brtsegs pa dang / yon tan gyi tshogs dang / rin po che'i me dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / 'jig rten gyi zla ba dang / dbyangs snyan dang /tshangs pa'i tog dang / tshogs chen gtso bo dang / seng ge'i stobs dang /drag can gyi byin pa dang / chos kyi dbang phyug dang / gzi brjid 'od dang /'od zer chen po dang / rin chen grags pa dang / tshogs can gsal ba dang /grags pa mtha' yas pa dang / 'od zer don yod pa dang / lha'i drang srong dang / skye ba'i dbang po dang / dge 'dun brtan pa dang / phyogs bzangs 4dang / rtog dang / yul 'khor me tog dang / chos kyi blo gros dang / rlung gi shugs ltar gshegs pa dang / legs pa'i grags pa dang /snang ldan dang / lha'i tshogs dang / yon tan srung 5dang / don gyi blo gros dang / bsnyengs pa med pa dang / grags pa brtan pa dang / 'od gnas 12—32

mtshungs pa dang / nor bu'i zhabs dang / thar pa'i gzi brjid dang /ngos bzangs hudang / blo bzangs dang / kun du gzi brjid dang / ye shes mchog dang / tshangs par gnas dang / bden par gsung bye dang / blo bzangs 1dang / stobs byin dang / seng ge'i stabs dang / me tog gi tog dang / ye shes 'byung gnas dang / me tog byin dang / yon tan snying po dang / rin chen grags pa dang / grags pa rmad du byung ba dang / mi tshugs pa dang / bsnyengs pa med pa dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang / tshangs par gshegs pa dang / lha'i mthu rtsal dang / ye shes dgyes dang / lha'i bden pa dang / nor bu'i snying po dang / yon tan grags pa dang / ye shes dpal dang / bcing ba rtemed pa dang / brtul zhugs brtan pa dang /lha'i gzi brjid dang / tshangs thub dang / brtul zhugs dka' thub dang /'od zer phung po dang / gzi brjid che ba /tsudang / tsam pa ka dang / dga' mdzad dang / tshogs can bzang po dang / dbang po'i rgyal mtshan dang /dgyes pa chen po dang / sna ma'i me tog 'od dang / tshogs can 'od dang /skrun mdzad dang / mdangs 'gro dang / don legs nges pa dang / khyu mchog dang / lag bzangs 6dang / 'od zer chen po dang / bsam pas byin pa ke dang / bsod nams 'od dang / rin chen dbyangs dang / rdo rje'i sde dang / 'byor ldan dang / seng ge'i stobs dang / dri med spyan dang /'od srungs dang / blo gsal dang / ye shes 'gros dang / gzi brjid drag shul can dang / 'od zer chen po dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang / dri ma med pa'i 'od dang / gzi brjid rnam par 'byed pa dang / khengs pa med pa dang /12—33

sbrang rtsi zhal dang / zla ba'i 'od dang / glog 'byin dang / rab tu zhi bar gshegs pa dang / mi 'khrugs pa dang / dgra bcom grags pa dang / chos kyi yon tan dang / zhing bzang po dang / bkod pa'i rgyal po dang /mngon par 'phags pa dang / sbyin sreg 'od 'phro dang / pad+ma'i dpal dang / rin chen bkod pa dang / shin tu bzang po dang / rin chen mchog dang / thugs shin tu gzhungs 7snadang / rgya mtshos byin dang /tshangs pa'i tog rnams so/ /shar dang byang dang nub dang ni/ /lho yi sgo ru shes bya ba/ /tshangs pa dbang phyug chen po ma/ /gzhon nu khyab 'jug ma de bzhin/ /phag mo dbang mo kye gtum mo dang / /dpal chen mo ni grwa rnams su/ /sgo ru gzugs dang mtshan ma ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhin du grags/ /grwa ru brtan ma la sogs bzhin/ /shes bya 'dir ni ri mo gsum/ /sku gsung thugs kyi chos rnams so/ /chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu mdzes/ /dur khrod rnams ni brjod bya ste/ /me yi 'khor lo'i dbus su ni / /gsod dang kun du skrag byed dang / /'jigs pa che dang 'jigs byed de/ /drag po'i dur khrod de bzhin du/ /g.yon skor 1du ni rnam par dgod—/ /skrag byed dang ni sdang byed dang / /lkugs byed dang ni rengs byed slar/ /dbang ldan la sogs grwa la'o/ /shing ni rim pas sbyin bya ste/ /go yu star ka nā li ra/ /se 'bru bil ba'i shing de nas/ /skyu ru bi dzha rag sha'i shing / /rim pa ji bzhin rnam par dgod/ /dbang mo gshin rje ma chu mo/ /gnod sbyin 'byung mo drang srong ma/ /srin mo rlung gi chung ma ste/ /'jig rten skyong ma sbyin par bya cho/ /klu mo srin mo thams cad ni/ /'dir 12—34

ni rnam pa kun du sbyin/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor 'khor bshad la/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad spyin/ /las kyi rjes mthun sku mdog can/ /der ni gtso bo bsgom par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni 'khor lo gsum pa'i dkyil 'khor la rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa'o// //de nas phyi rol slar yang 'dir/ /me yi 'khor lo bdag 3gis bshad/ /kha dog dmar po 'bar chen po/ /sum cu drug rtsibs rnams mchog la/ /rnal 'byor ma slar dgod bya ba/ /lha sogs rigs las byung ma ste/ /lha mo klu mo gnod sbyin mo/ /'byung po ngo bo tsam po'o/ /de kun gsungs pa 'di ni ci/ /lha yi rigs 'byung bshad par bya/ /ma dang chung ma sring mo dang / /bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang / /pha yi sring mo de dang ni/ /zhang po yi ni chung ma dang / /chung ma'i srun zla ma dang ni/ / chung ma yi ni ma dang ni/ /khyede nyid kyi ni pha yi ma/ /chung ma yi ni phyi mo snyedang / /ma yi ma dang gnyen mo dang / /ma yi thuspun zla'i bu mo dang / /rang gi phyi mo'i spun zla dang / /spun zla'i bu mo de'i bu mo/ /pha yi ma dang phyi mo dang / /khu bo yi ni chung ma dang / /bu mo'i bu yi chung ma dang / /slar yang chung ma'i spun zla dang / /rang pha'i sring mo'i 5bu mo dang / /de nyid kyi treni rang rigs skyes/ /srun zla'i chung ma bu mo dang / /bu nyid kyi ni bu mo dang / /bu de yi ni 7chung ma dang / /bu mo'i khyo yi ma yi ni/ /bu nyid kyi ni sgyug mo dang / /bu mo'i bu mor yang dag bshad/ /pho nya sum cu drug rnams so/ /kha dog dmar por yang dag grags / /mtshon cha la sogs sngar dang mtshungs/ /sa ni ring du spong nyid dang / / dgra bo'i 8gling du gnas pa mo/ /'du bar rtag tu shes bya 12—35

ste—/ /shes rab thabs bdag ngo bo can/ /nus pa'i 'khor lor nyu'adir rtag tu/ /shes bya rang 'dra'i mdzes pa mo/ /kun du rdo rje'i phreng la sogs/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog pa yis/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag pa yis / /'dir ni mchod pa byebyed pa yin/ /phyugs rnams kyi ni sha thams cad/ /kun du son nas dbul bar bya/ /btung ba rnam pa sna tshogs dbul/ /bldag bya sna tshogs nyid de bzhin/ /rang rang stan las langs 1nas ni/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa mchod/ /slar yang 'ongs nas 'khor lo yi/ /mchod pa bcu gnyis rnams la'o/ /zhes bya ba ni longs ④ rdzogs pa'i me'i 'khor lo ste dang po'o// //de nas de yi phyi rol bshad/ /chu yi 'khor lo rdzu 'phrul che/ /mdog dkar sum cu drug rtsibs la/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rim pas bsgom/ /ma ka ra mo rus 5sbal nya/ /sbal mo rus gyesbal chu sram spyomo/ /sdig nag gagir ma shi khru —ma / /chu yi phug ma srin bu'i gdong ma dang / /cha ga ba mo karka ṭī mo sru yī she7mo / /chu byi mo dang grog mo'i gdong ma dang / /chu yi mi mo dang ni rgod ma dang / /glang chen mo dang stag mo ce spyang mo/ /chu sbrul mo dang dung mo 'gron 1rtebu mo/ /nya phyis ma dang nor bu dzi gu ri / ma dang / /lbo sī rke mo dang dud du ri ma sgokartoḍa/ /pha ḍa ka mo dā ba khri ma kri m+bi chemo/ /dzu ṣ+pe snyem dang sha sbrang 7ka khā ma/ /lha yi gtso mo mchog rnams so/ /de ltar kha dog rang bzhin ni/ /dkar mo'am rang rang rigs skyes pa'o/ /gdong pa rang rang gzugs kyis te/ /rnal 'byor ma'i rim ji bzhin no/ /nye ba'i 'du ba nyid dang ni/ /sa ni mi g.yo ba mchog go/ /'dzam bu'i gling du gnas 12—36

par ni/ /shes bya mtshon cha sngon bzhin no/ /yang na gang ba'i rigs sogs kyis/ /mi rnams sum cu drug blta'o 1/ /gnas sogs rim pa de rnams su/ /mi mo dngos su yang dag bya/ /'dzam bu ༄snyegling 'di de yis ni/ /dum bu bcu gnyis kyis brgyan pa'o/ /ba tsha kyezhes bya'i rgya mtshor ni/ /de ru gtogs pa'i skye bo rnams/ /drod gsher skyes dang 'du 'phrod ④/las/ /skyes pa mngal nas skye bar bsam/ /'khor lo 'di ni drod gsher skyes/ /me yi 'khor lo mngal skyes so/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /shes rab thabs bdag nyid rang ngo / /zhes bya ba ni chu'i 'khor lo 3ste gnyis pa'o de nas de yi phyi rol 'chad/ /kun nas ye shes 'khor lo'o/ /sum cu drug rtsibs sna tshogs mdog /lha min mo'i rigs rim pa dang / /til mchog ma dang phul du bde/ /lha yi bu mo dga' chen mo/ /dga' dang dgar grags pad chen ma/ /dung trecan sna tshogs glang chen ma/ /gzugs chen mo kyedang gzugs mdzes ma/ /'dod chags rnam sgeg bde ba mo/ /me tog 'dod ma at+pal dkar/ /at+pal sngo dang mdzes ma dang / /'dod chags ma dang 'dod chags che/ /rol grags ma dang rol chen ma/ /myos ma dang ni myos dga' ma/ /'dod pa mo dang 'dod 9chen mo/ /bde dzolas byung dang bde ldan mahuX/ /mthun mchog ma dang byams pa mo/ /skal bzangs 7ldan ma skal bzangs snyemo /dma' ba mo dang zhum pa mo/ /skyes gzugs mar ni grags pa ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gtso mo mchog /thams cad shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ /rnam pa sna tshogs mdog de bzhin/ /phyag dang mtshon cha sngon bzhin shes/ /legs 12—37

pa'i blo gros sa de bzhin/ /dur khrod rin po cher snang ba/ /rang byung sna7bde ba byed pa po/ /de phyir longs spyod rdzogs sku'o/ /de nas de yi phyi rol du/ /zla gdugs dang / 'od 'phro ba dang / dri med rgyal po dang / ye shes grags pa dang / kun du rgyal ba dang / yon tan 'od dang / sgra grags dang / zla ba rgyas pa dang / pad+ma'i 'od zer dang / brtul zhugs bzang po dang / sgon ma'i rgyal po dang / glog gi tog dang / 'od zer rgyal po dang /skar mkhan dang / grags pa rdzogs ldan dang / pad+ma'i snying po dang / rgyal dang / spyan mdzes dang / rnyog pa med pa'i don dang / drag shul bde ba dang / bsod nams gzi brjid dang / mthu rtsal can dang / thogs pa med pa'i blo dang / sgra gcan lha dang / ye shes dung byepo dang / kha lo sgyur dang / skye dbang mtshungs dang / me tog gi tog dang / sgra gcan 'dzin dang / rtsi sman chen po dang / rgyu skar rgyal po dang / sman pa'i rgyal po dang /bsod nams glang po dang / gcod par mdzad pa dang / rnam par grags pa'i rgyal po dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer dang / chos kyi mdzod dang / blo gros bzang po dang / yon tan dbang mtshungs dang / rdo rje'i sde dang / shes rab brtsegs dang / legs par gnas pa dang / blo sbyangs dang / tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / yon tan mchog dang / 'brug sgra dbyangs dang /mngon par shes pa'i tog dang / tog gi 'od dang / dge ba dang / tshangs pa dang / skyes mchog dang / spyan sdug pa dang / klus byin pa dang /bden pa'i tog dang / brgyan 4pa dang / zhum pa med pa'i dbyangs dang /rin chen 'od dang / dbyangs byin dang / seng ge dang / 'od zer sna 12—38

tshogs dang / ye shes dpa' bo dang / pad+ma'i phung po dang / me tog rgyas pa dang / mthu rtsal stabs dang / bsod nams phung po dang / gzugs mchog dang / skar mkhan dang / zla ba'i sgon ma dang / gzi brjid phung po dang / byang chub rgyal po dang / mi zad dzobhepa dang / mngon rtogs spyan dang /yan lag rgyas pa dang / yul 'khor dang / shes rab dang / mchog dang /gzi brjid tshim mdzad dang / shes rab 'byin dang / 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang / chags pa med pa'i mdzod dang / gtso bos byin dang / gtso bo dang /ye shes mthu rtsal dang / 'od 'phro can dang / dbang po dang / shugs 'chang dang / skar rgyal dang / 'od bzangs ri dang / grags pa byin dang /gzugs bzang po dang / rgyal po dang / don grub pa dang / seng ge'i sde dang / nor bu'i lha dang / grags pa dang / rgyal ba dang / rgyal chen snying po dang / bsod nams 'od zer dang / smrang 'don — pa dang / sgron ma'i rgyal po dang / ye shes brtsegs pa dang / lha mchog dang / sa bdag dang / rnam grol brnyes dang / gtsug gi gser dang / sgra gcan bzang po dang / thub dka' dang / thub gsal dang / zla ba'i 'od zer dang /gser gyi 'od krudang / legs byin dang / lha'i yon tan dbang po dang /chos kyi gdugs dang / bsod nams lag 5dang / chags med dang / ye shes gya nom dang / blo zhib mo dang / gzi byin thams cad dang / rtsi sman dang / rnam grol tog dang / 'od kyi mdzod dang / ye shes rgyal po dang /'jigs mdzad dang / chu bo spong ba dang / thogs med grags pa dang /bden pa'i phung po dang / dbyangs snyan dang / ri dbang mtshungs dang /12—39

chos brtsegs ri1dang / thar pa'i gzi byin dang / legs 'dzin dang / rab tu zhi ba'i sku dang / yid du 'ong ba'i gsung dang / blo sbyangs pa dang / chu lha dang / 'go bas mchod dang / seng ge'i logs dang / chos kyi mthu rtsal dang / skal 3pa bzang po dang / mi 'khrugs pa'i mdog dang / gzi brjid rgyal po dang / rtogs mdzad dang / spyan legs pa dang / don la gnas pa'i blo mnga' ba dang / snang ba'i 'od zer dang / spos kyi gzi brjid dang / kun du dga' bar mdzad pa dang / don yod par gshegs pa dang /khro ba bcom dang / gzugs mchog dang / legs gshegs dang / rab tu sbyin par grags dang / 'od gtsang dang / lha'i nyi ma dang / shes rab byin pa dang / mnyam par gzhag d+ngha pa'i bdag nyid dang / gzi mdangs dang /rgyal rigs dang / skal ldan shing rta dang / gser mchog dang / rnam par grol ba'i gtsug lag dang / chos ldan dang / spos gnas dang / dregs spangs dang / ye shes mdzod dang / tshangs par gshegs dang / tsan+dan dang / mya ngan med dang / seng ge'i 'od zer dang / yul 'khor tog dang /pad+ma'i snying po dang / gzi brjid mtha' yas dang / lha'i 'od zer dang /shes rab tog dang / mkhas pa dang / ye shes 'byor ldan dang / tshangs pa'i dbyig dang / phyag na rin chen dang / dbang ldan dang / rdzogs par gsungs dang / mchog tu gsungs dang / mchod 'os dang / skar rgyal dang / nyi ma dang / 'dam las rgal ba dang / ye shes brnyes pa dang /grub pa dang / rma bya dang / chos byin dang / phan par bzhed pa dang /ye shes ldan pa dang / grags pa dang / 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / rnam par 72—40

bcom pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya'i snying po dang / me tog dang / lha'i rgyal po dang /zla ba dang / dran pa'i 'od dang / dge ba'i 'od dang / yon tan mchog ma kun kyi 'od dang / rin po che'i dpal dang / skyes bu zla ba dang / sgra gcan dang / bdud rtsi'i 'od dang / 'jig rten gyi mchog dang / skar ma'i 'od dang / zhi ba'i stobs dang / ye shes rgya mtsho dang / ri bo'i dbang po dang / rab tu zhi ba dang / yon tan mtha' yas pa'i stobs dang /lha'i dbang po dang / dbyangs snyan dang / ngos bzangs 3dang / don la gnas pa dang / yon tan gzi brjid dpal dang / mkhyen ldan zla med dang /nga ro dpag med dang / 'od bzangs 3dang / shin tu thugs gzhungs dang /don dgongs gti mug bral ba dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag khyad 'phags dang /mchog tu mdzes par gshegs /chi dang / zhi ba'i don dang / skyon med dang /blo sbyangs dge ba dang / pad+ma'i mdzod dang / 'od zer bzang po dang /spobs pa'i mdog dang / stegs bzang po dang / tshogs kyi dbang po dang /bsnyengs pa dang bral ba dang / ye shes bzhed pa dang / spobs pa'i spyan dang /blo'i mchog dang / zla ba dang / rin chen zla 'od dang / bsnyengs pa med pa dang / gzigs pa med pa dang / tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / dbyangs bzang po dang / shes rab chen po'i stegs dang / blo gros zla med dang /rdo rje mkhregs pa 4dang / byang chub blo gros dang / ljon shing dbang po dang /gdangs snyan pa dang / bsod nams kyi stobs dang / mthu'i dpal rnams so//shar la sogs pa'i sgo bzhi ru/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams rim bzhin du/ /dkar mo sachom rkun ro langs ma/ /za phod ma yang rnam par dgod/ /grwa la gnas 12—41

pa'i lha mo bzhi/ /spos mo ri khrod ma de bzhin/ /gtum mo dang ni g.yung mo ste/ /rim pas sngon bzhin brtag ces bya/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gsum pa la/ /dga' ba bzhi ni dag pa yis/ /kun nas ri mo bzhi ①/can no / /phyi rol dur khrod 'khor lo ni/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor dbus su ste/ /byis pa gsod dang lhag ma za/ /g.yul drag kyepo dang mche ba kun/ /shar la sogs pa g.yon skor du/ /de ltar brtse ba chen pos bsam/ /du ba mun nag nang gi me/ /hā hā'i sgra dang sgra chen no/ /shing ni tsan+dan ga pur dang / /dzā ti pha la dang e la/ /nā ga ge sar tsam pa dang / /kun du ru dang lha yi shing / /phyogs skyong rnams ni mtshon bya ba/ /nyi ma bsil ba sa yi bu/ /ri bong can skyes bla ma nyid/ /ngan spong nyi ma'i bu de bzhin/ /lha min mgo bor shes bya ste/ /drag po'i gdong rnams su bya'o/ /'bar ba ral gri chu gri dang / /mdung rings sru gri brag de bzhin/ /glog dang sna tshogs mtshon 'bebs par/ /dur khrod kyi kyeni dbus su bya/ /ral gri mig sman ri lu dang / /rkang pa byug dang bcud len dang / /mchil lham dngul chu sa 'og gi/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa mkhas par 4bya/ /zhes bya ba ni ye shes kyi 'khor lo ste/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid do// //de nas de yi phyi rol 'chad/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo 'di gsal ba'o/ /mdog rnams sum cu rtsa drug rtsibs/ /thams cad rang bzhin skyes pa mchog /klu mo gnod sbyin mo 'byung mo/ /yi dwags dmyal mo mnar med ma5/ /ltung ba mo dang bar med ma/ /bum mo gshin rje ma de bzhin/ /thig nag ma dang me 72—42

mdag mo skye/ /tsha ba mo dang rab tsha mo/ /ngu 'bod ma dang ngu 'bod che/ /mar nag du 'tshed sneri gnyis 'tshir/ /sdang ma rmongs ma phrag dog ma/ /chags myos ser sna skud pa ma/ /grang ma ral gri'i nags ma nyid/ /rngu ③ma dang ni mu ge ma/ /nad dgon ma dang mtshon gyi dang / /chu yi dgon pa ma dang ni/ /ral gri sen mo rab med ma/ /sru gri'i so ma 'khor lo ma/ /grul bum mo ste lha mo che/ /mdog ni 'khor lo ji 'dra ba'o/ /phyag na mtshon cha sngon bzhin du/ /shes bya rang gi gzugs can no/ /de la nye ba'i dur khrod dang / /de nas sa ni chos kyi sprin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dag pa nyid/ /kun 'gro 'khor lo can du 'dod/ /rang bzhin spangs pas bdag med pa/ /'khor lo can sar bzhugs thupa'o/ /'khor lo rnams ni rim ji bzhin/ /thams cad de ltar shes par bya/ /gnas bzhi rnams la bcu gnyis so/ /de ltar bcu drug ces bya ba/ /stong pa nyid du mkhas pa yi/ /ye shes rnam shes ngo bo'i phyir/ /dur khrod bcom ldan 'das rang nyid/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'di la ni/ /gsum gyi bdag nyid ming gis so/ /phyi nas gzhan ni thams cad ni/ /'khor lo gnyis su shes par bya/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i 3dang po'o// //de nas phyi rol du gzhan pa/ /gsung gi 'khor lo de bshad pathu / /dmar po btsod kyi kha dog ste/ /sum cu drug rtsibs bdag nyid gtso/ /mchod pa za ma gnyis ma dang / /le lo ma chos sems sgom mo/ /khyim sems bud med sems ma dang / /don sems ma dang spyor bral ma/ /bu sems rnams dang mya ngan ma/ /bsam gtan ma dang sngags zlos ma/ /ngo tsha nga rgyal gdungs pa mo/ /12—43

sems can don byed brtson ma dang / /rgyal po sems ma gzhan gnod ma/ /ye shes thob ma dka' thub ma/ /rgas ma 'chi ba'i bsam can malha/ / /bde ma rkesdug ma mi dge ma/ /yod dang med dang gnyis dang ni/ /bla ma sems ma 'gro ba mo/ /bzod ma mi bzod ma ngal ma/ /ngal sos ma dang bkres pa mchog /las ni thams cad byed lha mo/ /rang bzhin 'khor lo 'di che ba'o / /kha dog rang bzhin 'khor lor grags/ /lhag ma 'dir ni sngon bzhin no/ /shes rab thabs bdag nyid lha mo/ /rang bzhin gyis ni dkyil 'khor 'di/ /gdan bzhi pa'i rgyud stong phrag ni/ /bcu gnyis pa las bshad pa ste/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyi/ /mchod sogs lha mor 'dod pa yin/ /grong mtha'i gnas ni 'di lta bu/ /kun du je'od kyi sa yin no/ /de ltar ye shes sogs sku'i mtha'/ /rlung me chu dang nam mkha' yisacho/ /bskor ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya bas5/ /rdo rje mchog mang shes par bya/ /zhes bya ba ni gsung gi 'khor lo'i gnyis pa sprul pa'i 'khor lo'o/ / //de nas sku yi 'khor lo bshad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi kha dog can/ /sum cu rtsa drug dbyibs 'dra ba/ /rnal 'byor ma 'khor sgyur ma'o/ /rgyal chen bzhi yi rigs ma dang / /sum cu rtsa gsum 'khor sgyur ma/ /'thab bral dga' ldan 'khor sgyur ma/ /'phrul dga' ma dang de bzhin du/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ma dang ni/ /tshangs ris ma yi 'khor lo ma/ /tshangs pa mdun 'don ma de bzhin/ /tshangs pa chen po 'khor sgyur ma/ /'od chung tshad med 'od ma dang / /'od gsal ma dang dge chung ma/ /tshad med dge ba'i 12—711

'khor sgyur ma/ /dge rgyas ma dang sprin med ma/ /bsod nams skyes pa'i 'khor lo dang / /'bras bu che ba'i sti'akhor sgyur ma/ /mi che mi gdung 'khor sgyur ma/ /shin tu mthong ②ma bzang snang ma/ /'og min ma yi 'khor sgyur ma/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched ma/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched ma/ /ci'ang med skye mched ma de nas/ /'du shes zu/'du shes med min ma/ /dmyal mo yi dwags ma de bzhin/ /dud 'gro mi mo lha min mo/ /gzhal med mkha' spyod ma de bzhin/ /zla mo nyi mo gshin rje mo/ /dbang mo 'khor sgyur mar shes bya—/ /rang gi 'khor lo'i mdog bzhin bya/ /phyag dang mtshon cha sngar bzhin no / /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin te/ /nye ba'i grong mthar yang dag gnas—/ /sa ni mos pas spyod pa'o/ /de nas de yi phyi khyams la/ /'phags pa dgyes pa dang / mthu stobs dang / skar ma la dgyes pa dang / sprin gyi rnga sgra dang / spyan sdug zhal dang / ye shes bzang ldan dang / 'byor ldan dang / yon tan phung po dang / gsal ba dang / chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /ye shes nga ro dang / nam mkha' dang / mchod sbyin nga ro dang / shes rab rnam dgod nga ro dang / yon tan 'od zer gzi brjid dang / drang srong dbang po dang / blo ldan dang / stobs thupa'i tshogs dang / mchod sbyin bzang po dang / zla ba'i zhal dang / shin tu gzigs dang / rdul bral dang /yon tan tshogs dang / tog ldan dang / bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang /yul 'khor spobs pa dang / rin chen rab sbyin dang / zla dgyes dang /seng ge'i stobs dang / dbang sgyur rgyal po dang / bdud rtsi gsal ba dang /bsam gtan snyoms dang / 'khrul pa med pa dang / dri ma rab tu zhi ba dang /12—45
