nas / /sngags rig pa yi phyi rol du/ /stobs po che yi 'gying bas sam/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'byor ldan pas/ /ral gri de yis sprin la sogs/ /rlung la mngon par phyogs pas ni/ /phaṭa ces bya ba brjod bzhin du/ /lan cig khro bo'i lus kyis 1ni/ /mtshon cha'i tshul du mngon par bya/ /sangs rgyas yin yang nyams par byed/ /'jug pa dang ni 'byung ba na/ /gtor ma byen la bcag par bya/ /de nas mtshon gyi phye ma ni/ /gnas min pa ru thong ba rnams//ras la sogs pas phyis nas ni/ /yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa yi2/ /dri zhim chu yis dbang ldan nas/ / brtsam la phyi nas bsang gtor bya/ /de nas tshon gyi lhag ma rnams/ /ye shes pa gshegs gzhan du gzhag4 /de nas dkyil 'khor kun 'khor bar/ /bdug spos rnam pa mang po dang / /mar me'i phreng dang mchod pa gzhan/ /sna tshogs me tog phreng ba rnams/ /bla re'i steng nas dpyad par 5bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /lag g.yon yang dag reg byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po'i gsang sngags kyis/ /lan bdun du ni bzlas par bya/ /nyi ma dgongs ka de nyid la/ /rang nyid lha bsgom sngon song bas/ /gar shes bud med rnam ldan pa'i/ /glu dang sgra la sogs kun gyis//sangs rgyas zhing du rnam gnas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun dang 'khor thams cad/ /nam mkha'i 6phyogs su bzhugs rnams dang / /dkyil 'khor pa rnams legs mchod de/ /'di ltar bskul zhing spyan drang 7bya/ /phyogs ma lus kun rnams bzhugs pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje che ༄ bdag che ge mo/ /dkyil 'khor bdag gi brtag par bya/ /de phyir sangs rgyas kun gshegs la/ /deng bdag dngos grub rab tu gsol/ /de ltar brjod nas 12—/51

phyag byas te/ /thugs ka'i ye shes rdor hūṃ las/ /lcags kyu'i rnam pa'i 'od tshogs kyis/ /bcom ldan dpa' bo'i gtso bo ni/ /sprul pa gzugs kyis bzhugs pa la/ /kha sbyar gyur pa yang dag gnas/ /de phyir yang dag bskul bkug la/ /hūṃ gi yi ge la gzhug 3bya/ /nam mkhar gnas rnams dang lhan cig /dkyil 'khor pa kun rnam ——bsams nas/ /ji lta'i gnas su gcig byas pa/ /hūṃ gis byas par lan cig bsgom/ /ri mo la sogs rnams bkod la//de ltar rang gi dkyil 'khor gzhug /dkyil 'khor dgod pa'i rim pa ni/ /mngon rtogs las ni shes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bkod nas su/ /sngags 'di dag ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e gā kra ma hūṃ/ yang na yi ge gsum dran bya/ /gal te rdul tshon ma nus na/ /dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni/ /sngar nas tshon gyis bri bar bya/ /gal te de yang ma nus na/ /de dang de gnas sngags bsgom bya/ /nges par he ru ka mgon po/ /phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan pa bri/ /cung zhig dkyil 'khor ma rdzogs par/ /de yi dus na yongs rdzogs 'gyur/ /lha yi 'khor lo rnams bkod nas/ /'di ltar spos la sogs pas kyang / /dkyil 'khor pa kun so sor ni/ /mngon du byas nas yang dag mchod/ /gtso bo'i rnal 'byor dmigs byas nas/ /khro bo hūṃ zhes brjod pa yis/ /me tog phreng ba legs bzung nas/ /hūṃ zhes yang dag brjod bzhin du/ /sngags pas dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i spyor ba yis/ /blta zhing dril bu bskyod byas nas/ /lan gsum du ni bskor bar bya/ /bskur 1ba'i me tog phreng blangs nas/ /brtul zhugs can gyis slar la yang / /rang gi mgo la bcing bar bya/ /khro bo'i lta stangs yongs ldan 12—152

pas / /nub la sogs pa'i sgo bzhi ru/ /gnas nas yi ge gsum brjod bya/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo bzhi ni/ /mos pas yid kyis dbye bar bya/ /sgo 'byed pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+rīd 3gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be+e sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas bdud rtsi lnga ldan pa/ /dri yi chu dang yang dag ldan/ /dpal he ru ka'i mdun du ni/ /dung phor bzhag nas de nas yang / /sngags pa rig ma dang bcas pa/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas/ /de nas rjes gnang blangs nas ni/ /rang nyid byin gyis yang dag brlab4/ /rang gi ming ni brjod nas su/ /yang ni spyi bos phyag bya'o/ /'og nas 'byung ba'i cho ga 'dis/ /ji bzhin lha rnams yang dag bskul/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad pa rnams//rang nyid byung ba mtha' yas srid pa'i rang bzhin rnams/ /ma lus pas btud snod kyi snying po rnams/ /sa kun ma lus snying po gcig rnams 'dir spyon cig /de ltar sngags bdag nyid kyis bskul/ /blo dang ldan pas yang dag dgug /hūṃ bzhi pa yi gsang sngags kyis/ /dpa' bo kun gyi sngags kyis kyang / /sngags ni oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ oṃ kṛṇ+ḍa kṛhā5/ oṃ kṛ1 pa ya kṛ1 pa ya hūṃ/oṃ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ sngags pa gsang sngags zlos bzhin pas/ /rang nyid hūṃ las nges 'thon pa'i/ /'od zer rnams kyis bkug pa rnams/ /nam mkha'i phyogs nas byon pa ni/ /de rnams rab tu bzhad zhal rnams/ /rang rang gis dngos 7grub byin nas/ /sems can kun la bde rab gsol/ /'khor lo'i mngon phyogs byon nas ni/ /steng du yang dag bzhugs bsam bya/ /rdo rje dril bu legs blangs nas/ /de nas sngon gsungs bstod pa'o/ /bcom ldan brtan par byon pa ni/ /bshes gnyen 12—153

gyis ni nye bar gnas/ /bsgom pa'i de nas thams cad ni/ /rang rang gzugs la rab gzhug bya/ /phyag rgya bzhis mngon rgyas gdab par/ /lha yi 'khor lo la bya'o/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan zhing / /rang rang mdog dang phyag mtshon cha/ /sprul pa'i sku yi gzugs kyis ni/ /phyag rgya chen por rab tu grags / /de yi dbang ni snyoms 'jug pa/ /sgom 3don de yi bdag nyid can/ /ma mo'i gzugs ni bzung ba yis/ /shes rab dam tshig tu ni dran/ /byang chub sa bon rdzogs pa gang / /zhing dang byed rgyu'i bdag nyid can/ /de bzhin nyid mtha' legs dag pa/ /chos kyi phyag rgya zhes brjod do/ /sems can phung po ma lus pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob byed ma/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i rtse ba yis/ /las kyi phyag rgya zhes grags so/ /'on kyang lha mo rnams de bzhin/ /dga' rol dam tshig tu ni dran/ /rang gis 'bad rtsol skad cig rgya/ /las kyi phyag rgyar de bzhin 'gyur/ /phyag rgya bzhis mngon rgyas btab nas/ /rim pas rgyas btab de bzhin du/ /rang gi lha mos dpa' dbang la/ /dpa' bo rnams la gtso bo yis/ /dbang bskur mngon par sbyin par bya/ /bsam gtan legs mnyam gzhag rnams kyis/ /sems can don byed la brtson pas/ /spros nas de nyid la gzhug bya/ /phan tshun shin tu dbyer med pa'i/ /gzugs ni thams cad du dmigs nas/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po'i gsang sngags ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor grub par ni/ /'gyur ba la ni the tshom med/ /gtso bo'i gsang sngags bzlas pa yi/ /rnam rgyal bum pa de nas ni/ /de nyid kyis 4ni mdun bzhag nas/ /lhag ma sngags kyis bsngags pa rnams/ /de rnams khyer nas 'khor lo yi5/ /mkhas pas tshon gyi 72—154

phyi rol du/ /grwa bzhir ji ltar 'dod pa yis/ /mtshan ma ldan de rnams dgod bya/ /de nas mchod yon sogs byin nas/ /g.yas pa'i pus mos gnas nas ni/ /spos la sogs pas snalegs mchod nas/ /slar yang yig gsum byin brlabs pa'i/ /las kun byed pa'i bum pa yis/ /snod gcig tu ni bsang gtor bya/ /dam tshig btung ba la sogs dang / /bldag dang gzhibs pa'i /zas rnams kyi ༷/ /de nas yi ge gsum gyis ni/ /mngon par bsngags te 'di yis kyang / /oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a brta jeya hoḥzhes bya bas kyang ngo / /dpa' bo rnams la so sor ni/ /bum pa la ni gos zung dbul/ /rnam par bkra ba'i gos zung ni/ /bzang po gtso bo la dbul bya//de nas ji ltar nus pa de/ /lnga las nyung ba mi bya'o/ /sngags pas lha rnams so so la/ /nyer spyod lnga rnams kyis mchod bya/ /de yi sngags ni 'di rnams so/ /oṃ puṣ+pe pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ dhū thupaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ dī paṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ gar+ghaṃ pra tre+e ts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ bhak+to pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ lha dang dbyer med pa gzugs kyis—/ /pi wang ma sogs tshul gyis ni/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod bzhin du—/ /blo dang ldan pas sngon bzhin mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hā su lā myu ra ti kṛ 6ḍā sau khya a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /gal te 'byor na mchod rnams kyis/ /glu dang rol mo gar sogs bcas/ /dgod dang sgeg dga' spro rnams kyis/ /phyi dang gsang ba'i bye brag gam/ /mchod pa'i rigs kyi tshogs rnams kyidz+wa/ /8brtul zhugs can gyis yang dag mchod/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pas natsu/ /'di ni mchog gi mchod pa ste/ /yid kyi dga' bas 'gugs par byed/ /de 12—/55

phyir kun brtags rnal 'byor gyis/ /rang nyid kyang ni mchod par bya/ /zhes so—/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i sngags 'di ni/ /lan gsum du ni mchod de gnas—/ /mchod pa kun gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs bsgom—/ /sngags ni/ oṃ a nut+ta ra pū dza me gha sa mudzha we spa ra nyi baṃ ga ga na khaṃ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas dman dang chad pa yi/ /skyon ni bsal bar bya ba ste/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan bstod byas nas/ /ji ltar de bzhin mkhyen par gsol//chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs 1dang / /dam tshig kyang ni dran pa yis/ /snying rje yis ni sems can don/ /dngos grub thams cad mdzad du gsol/ /zhes so—/ /de yi sgo nas phyir 'thon nas/ /bcom ldan lhan cig 'ongs pa yi/ /phyogs bdag dbang po sogs kun la/ /ngag gis nye bar snyan gsan dbab sna/ /de la ngag ni 'di yin te/ /gang du bcom ldan 'das lhan cig /'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi bdag po rnams/ /gang yang rjes su 'breng bcas 'dir/ /gnas pa de dag 4thams cad rnams/ /bdag ni rjes su gzung 5ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar rig par gyur pa 'di/ /dri dang me tog sogs gtor ma/ /so sor bzhes te sems can la/ /byams pa'i sems dang slob ma la/ /bgegs med par ni mdzad du gsol/ /zhes so/ /de nas der gnas la 'di ltar/ /chu khyor gsum gyis mchod yon sbyin/ /nye bar spyad pa lnga blangs la/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan gtor ma/ /yig gsum mngon par bzlas pa yis/ /de nyid brjod pas sbyin par bya/ /mchod pa sbyin par byas nas ni/ /phyogs kyi gtor ma byen de nas/ /de nas dri zhim yan lag bkrus/ /rnam pa sna tshogs kyis brgyan nas/ /dang po lha rnams tshim bya'i phyir/ /zhi ba yi ni sbyin sreg bya/ /12—/56

de la 'di yi cho ga 'di/ /ji ltar dman 7shes btsun mo blang / /rang gi lha mo'i dbyings su bsam/ /de yi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/ /gnas nas dbang ldan snyoms 'jug nyid/ /snying gar ye shes kyi ni lha/ /gnyis ka la yang legs bsams nas/ /thab khung ha las skyes de bzhin/ /me 'bar lta bu'i dbus su ni/ /lce ni hūṃ las skyes de bzhin/ /rnam par bsams nas mar bsres pa'am/ /mar khu chen pos mchod pa ste/ /bdud rtsi lnga la sogs ldan pa//blo ldan ston mo'i sbyin sreg bza'/ /phan tshun 'khor lo'i thab khung 'dir/ /bde bas ma tshim bar du bsreg /gang gis 'di ltar mi bzod pa/ /de tshe phyi rol sbyin sreg 'dod/ /zhi ba'i spyin sreg cho ga yis/ /byas nas de ni legs par bsdu/ /'on kyang gsang ba'i cho ga yis/ /mthun pas nye bar 'gyur ba yin—/ /de bzhin lha rnams phyi rol gyi 7/ /sbyin sreg gis ni 'gro ba yin/ /de nas phyi dang gsang rnams kyi/ /mchod pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /de nas rang sems brtan bya'i 4phyir/ /dkyil 'khor po 5rnams so so ru/ /bdag la mngon sum du byas nas/ /slob ma rnams la rjes brtse'i phyir/ /thams cad mnyes nas gzigs par bsam/ /de yi rjes su slob dpon ni/ /rang gi rig ma dang bcas drangs6/ /mdor bsdus pa yis melegs blangs te/ /thog mar gsum la skyabs 'gro sogs/ /byang chub sems ni rab bskyed de / /de nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug bya/ /de'i rim ji ltar 9'di shes bya/ /blo ldan bsdus pa'i cho gas so/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /oṃ sarba yo ga kā ya wāka tsit+ta lngamut+pā da ya mi 12—/57

she ṣa na a tshosnab she ṣa satwa dhā tu ti ta su khot+ta ma sidhi ma te shwa rā ya rā dzabye / me tog phreng ba lag shublangs te/ /lag gnyis thal mo sbyar bar bya/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya ste/ /sngags 'di brjod bzhin pa yis so/ /a ④khaṃ bī ra hūṃ ma5/ oṃ badz+ra shrī snohe te ru ru shaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni tsudzā la sasbra nu/ra zhes bya bas so/ /gtso bo'i kyeslob dpon dag gis ni/ /dpa' bo'i dbang phyug gzugs bzung — nas/ /de phyir 'jug pa'i dus su ni/ /de tshe slob mas 'di ltar brjod/ /oṃ pra dṛ 1byu bha ga bān 7ma hā mok+ṣa pu re 5pa ra ma sarba sid+dhi su khaṃ ra sum̐ ྾ba ra ma su sakhot+ta ma sebye tshidzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ musibye r+ya/ gnyis zhugs nas ni phyag byed 8cing / /de yi /rol zhing dga' bas bskor/ /de ltar phyag bya ༄ de nas phyis/ /bskor ba gsum ni bya ba yin/ /slar yang de nas mdun du 'dug 1 /'di yang sngags pas brjod par bya/ /rgyud gzhan las ni rab grags gang / /de nyid bdag de lhan cig brjod 2/ /'dod chags chen po bde ba che/ /rdo rje chen po nor chen po / / ye shes chen po las chen po//rdo rje sems dpa' rab bsgrub /'gyur/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chu 'thungs nas/ /de nas snying ga zla dkyil la/ /āḥyig dmar po bsam byas nas—/ /de rjes byed pa'i 'od rnams kyis/ /yan lag nying lag kun bkang ste / /brtul zhugs can gyis de brjod bzhin/ /dpa' bo'i mudabang phyug rjes zhugs nas/ /dpa' bos yang dag byin gyis brlabs / /rdo rje phag mo de bzhin du/ /btsun mo yang dag byin brlabs par/ /bsams nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes/ /yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ /de nas phyi nas phreng ba dang / /lag gnyis thal sbyar la gnas pas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor du bskur bya/ /12—/58

gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ pa ra ma su khā ya la li ta 1bi lā sa na rimā mi/ bha ga wān a 1khaṃ bī ra hūṃ pra t+t+waṃ ts+tsha ku su māñdza lo nā thā hoḥ4/ phreng ba bcing ba sogs byas nas/ /he ru ka dpal phyag byas te/ /shes rab ye shes dbang la sogs5/ /lung bstan pa yang thams cad du/ /rdo rje'i brtul zhugs mthar thug par6/ /mdor basbus pa yis 7thams cad blangs / /'chad par 'gyur ba'i rim nyid kyis/ /rig dang lhan cig byas nas ni/ /byed 'gyur rjes su gnang byas te/ /rang gi 'dod pas bsgoms de nas/ /rdo rje'i gar dang nyer spyod sogs/ /mchod pas yang dag mchod byas nas/ /dam tshig gsum gyi glu rnams gang / /snyan pa'i sgra rnams 9kyis de bzhin/ /yang dag mchod byas de nas phyis/ /de la glu 'di khobla med pa'o/ /nam mkha' las ni skyes pa'i phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /dam tshig sems dpa' rdo rje che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag 1 grub/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rgyal//mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub 'gyur/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ni/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid grub par mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' tibadag 'grub shog /dngos grub chen po kun kyi mchog /dbang phyug che mchog phyag rgya ldan/ /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje snyems mubadag phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas slob ma 'jug don du/ /mkhas pas 'di ltar mkhyen par gsol/ /bdag ming che ge zhes bya yis/ /te ru ka 12—159

dpal slob dpon che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems kun gyis/ /gsungs pa'i cho ga dag gi ri ni/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i cho ga yis/ /sems can don ni bdag gis bgyi2/ /de la rjes gnang sprul mdzod la/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams kyis/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /de nas de rnams kyis rjes gnang / /bdag gi rjes su bsam par bya/ /tshigs su bcad pa 'di nyid — kyis/ /bden pa'i byin rlabs 4brjod par bya/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /sems can kun gyi yab kyang nyid/ /dam tshig mchog rnams kyi 5sku mchog /byung dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba yi6/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams khyed kyis sgrub / /bden pa 'di yis bdag mgon po/ /'dod pa khyod kyis rdzogs par mdzod/ /bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs phyi nas/ /blo dang ldan pas 'di mchod bya/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / /dam tshig kyang ni dran pa yis/ /brtse bas sems can kun kyi don/ /dngos grub kun phyir mdzad du gsol/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas slob ma dbang bsgur 'os/ /de bzhin rang gi rig dang bcas/ /sngar bshad pa yi sngags nyid kyis9/ /dpal ldan he ru ka gzugs kyi / /yig gsum yang dag byin gyis brlab/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa dang / /rnam par bkra ba'i gos ni gyon/ /de phyir gtsug tor bgos pa can/ /gdong g.yogs ne+e 1 tra sogs byin nas/ /legs pa rtayon ni byin pa yis/ /rang gi rig ma bcas byas nas/ /de yis phyag ni bya ba yin/ /thog mar re zhig shar sgo ru/ /thal mo sbyar ba byas nas su/ /de nas rab tu brkyang byas nas/ /gus pas 'di dag brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo ——pas+thā na ṇayāt+ma rgo 12—/60

byāt+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga tā spyo sgyu bye tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ1/ zhes bya ba'o/ /brjod nas lus ni thams cad kyis/ /de nas rab tu 'dud bya'o/ /bcom ldan snying gar rab zhugs par/ /yid kyis yongs su brtag par bya/ /de bzhin du ni lho yi sgor / /de lta'i thal sbyar snying gar ni/ /byas nas de bzhin gsang ba'i dbang / /rin chen 'di yis brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta 3pū dzā dzha ṣe kā yāt+ma rgo bhāt+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na sam+bha bā bhi ṣaspyo — 7bye tiṣ+ṭha swa rmātwo/zhes bya'o/ /'di ltar brjod cing dpral ba yis/ /blo dang ldan pas phyag bya'o/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rdo rje yis/ /de la dbang bskur rab brtag bya/ /de nas nub kyi sgo ru ni/ /de bzhin thal sbyar spyi bo ru/ /byas nas 'di skad brjod bya ste/ /mchod pa'i chos ni rab bskor ba'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta na ya āt+ma ma rgo nit+yā 5ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a mi tā bha wa 6pra brta ya māṃ zhes so/ /'di skad brjod bzhin kha nyid kyis/ /de nas rab tu 'dud bya'o//'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /de yi mthu stobs gyur brtag bya/ /de bzhin byang gi sgor 'dug nas/ /snying gar thal mo sbyar byas te/ /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa'i/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod par bya'o7/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma be+e āt+ma rgo nīt+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha sit+t+waṃ ku ru māṃ zhes bya'o/ /'di skad brjod cing mgo bo yis/ /blo dang ldan pas phyag bya'o—/ /don yod grub pa gsang ba yi/ /mchod pa'i thugs legs ldan bsam bya/ /bskyod med dngos phyir mi bskyod pa/ /bcom ldan dpa' bo 'dren pa po/ /rin chen kun gyi 'byung gnas phyir/ /de nyid rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /de nas chos ni mtha' yas pa/ /de bzhin 'od dpag med de brjod//12—161

dngos grub thams cad ster ba'i phyir/ /don yod grub pa zhes byar grags/ /de thams cad kyang rig byas pas/ /'on kyang 'di ltar mdor bsdus pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs mchog rnams kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs tshopar bsam byas nas / /me tog bcas lag gis bla mar/ /de yis kyang ni phyag byas te/ /shar sgor mngon phyogs pas gnas nas/ /'di skad gus pas brjod par bya/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa yang ni bdag la stsol3/ /rdo rje'i rigs kun bsdus pa la/ /slob dpon chen po bdag gzhug mdzod/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bsgur ba'i/ / skal ba —chen po bdag la stsol/ /dus gsum bzhugs rnams sangs rgyas kyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub go 'phang mchog /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /mtshan nyid dang ni dpe byad dang / /nam mkha'i 'od sogs yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba/ /mgon po chen bo bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che/ /sems can kun gyi don brtson pas/ /rtag tu bdag ni slob dpon 'gyur/ /de yi sgo la mngon phyogs pas/ /de bzhin slob dpon gyis gnas te/ /gang zhig rig kun mkhyen pa gsol/ /de la rim pa 'di yin te/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis/ /byang chub sems ni yongs bzung dang / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug cing / /dam tshig sdom pa nod par 'tshal/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi dpa' bo la/ /gus pa yis ni gsol btab pa/ /de ltar slob ma la brjod de / /de nas gzhan yang slob ma la/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dge ba/ /gsang chen yongs su bzung ba ru/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /bdag ni 'dod par bya'o zhes/ /de ltar byas nas de nas phyis/ /rigs lnga'i 12—162

dam tshig brjod par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /rin chen gsum gyi dam tshig bsten/ /de ltar sangs rgyas rigs dag la/ /sdom pa brten hūṃpar gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu 3phyag rgya dag /blo gros chen po khyod kyis gzung snye/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do / /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyis/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam—/ /'di ni rdo rje 4rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs—/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag sbyin bya53/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /khyod kyis dam pa'i chos gzung 7bya / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa mchog yin no/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /rang gi de nyid so sor gzung 3/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus gyis/ /gzhan yang bcu bzhir bshad 'di rnams/ /phas pham pa zhes bya bar grags/ /rtsa ba'i ltung bar shes bya ste/ /nyin lan gsum dang mtshan lan gsum/ /nyi ma re rer 17'don par gyis/ /rdo rje'i srun rnams bshes nyid pas/ /rnal 'byor rnams la bsnyen bkur bya/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /ji ltar nus pas yang dag spyad/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /'khor ba yongs su mi spang zhing / /rtag tu myang 'das la mi dga'/ /gsang ba gsum gyi lha rnams la/ /brnyas pa nyid du mi bya'o/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o/ /srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing / /ma byin mi blang nyid du bya/ /'dod log spyad par mi bya zhing / /brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra mi bya/ /12byed163

bya ba ma yin thams cad spongs3/ /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /legs pa yis ni nye bar gnas/ /rnal 'byor gsum la bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi las ni rnam bzhi dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ji ltar nus pas rjes su skyongs/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /khyod kyis da lta nyid nas srungs༄ / /des kyang 'di skad ces bya ste/ /slob dpon 'dir ni bdag la gsol/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar du ni bdag gis bgyi 4/ /de nyid 'di yi phyi nas ni/ /'di nyid rim pas sdom pa sbyin/ /gang yang zhiphyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshes/sa pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po sangs rgyas rnams dang ni/ /de 6sras bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba 'di/ /dus 'di nas ni rab bzung ste/ /byang chub snying po 7mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bkyi/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum / /bdag gis brtan por gzung 8bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /ding 9nas brtsams te gzung 7bar bgyi/ /nam du yang ni mi spang ngo / /rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya dag /yang dag nyid du gzung bgyi zhing / /slob dpon dag kyang gzung 1bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /72—164

dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi dang 1gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bgyi zhing / /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi zhing / /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis — sdom pa ma lus gzung / /ma grol ba ni bdag gis dgrol/ /ma bsgral ba ni bdag gis bsgral/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod4/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta yo ga kā ya bāka tsit+ta 5mut+pā da yā mi shi 6 na pa she ṣa sa tā dhā tu hi ta su khot+ta ma sidhi at+yarnya bha 6wa sirnyi ma he shwat+yā bye ba r+ya 7tsa ya/ zhes bya'o/ /'di yis slob ma byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa bskyed byas nas/ /snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas ni/ /snying po 'di ni brjod par bya/ /su ra ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsibye badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes so/ /'di yis 9slob ma la bskyed pas/ /'dod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ sngags kyis 7ni/ /me tog phreng ba 'bad pas gzung / /de ni slob dpon gyis bcug nas/ /yang ni 'di ltar mkhyen par gsolanyu1/ /bdag ming che ge zhes bya ba'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bya/ /dkyil 'khor snying po 'di nyid du/ /ye shes rdo rje thob bya'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs kun grong khyer du/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /a sakhaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ slob ma rab tu gzhug 72—165

par bya/ /de nas phyi nas 'di skad dag /dam tshig skyong ba can smra bya/ /deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya'o/ /ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos—/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la brjod par ma byed cig dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje ni/ /spyi bor bzhag la 'di skad brjod/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /gal te la lar khyod 'di smra/ /khyod kyi spyi bo 'gas par byed/ /rdo rje snying bzhag 'di 7—brjod bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid ni/ /khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshig 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral nas gshegs/ /de nas bdud rtsi lnga ldan pa'i/ /chu ni thod par gnas pa la/ /snying po lan cig yongs bzlas pas/ /'thung du gzhug par bya ba ste / /badzo da ka zhes bya ba'am/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ngo / /de nas blo ldan gyis 'di brjod/ /'di ni khrod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /rdo rje dril bu 4phyag rgya ni/ /dkyil 'khor med la gal te smra/ /skye bo tshogs nang gnas nas ni/ /ma dad bzhad gad kyis ma yin—/ /deng tshun chad khyod kyi mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di gang kyis shig ces bsgo ba khyod kyis bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig /ya nga ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas dmyal bar rtsang bar gyur ta re/ yang slob mas 'di brjod par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin kyis rlobs la dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bdag la 72—166

dbab tu gsol/ /'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho zhes byar grags / /ye shes rdo rje bla med pa/ /de ring bdag la dbab tu gsol/ /de tshe rdo rje bab ces bya/ /'di skad rtag tu brjod bya'o / /gal te babs par ma gyur na/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /de'i snying 1zla ba kha sbyar la/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /de dag gdab pa las byung bas/ /ā ཿyig dmar po'i 'od rnams kyis/ /de yi lus kun kun nas dgang / /de nyid yang dag brjod pa yis/ /sngar bzhin du ni rjes 'jug bya/ /slob ma rjes su gzung ba de/ /rig dang lhan cig bsam par bya/ /de nas nges par babs pas 4ni/ /yang dag byin brlabs ltasu 'gyur ro/ /de nyid ye shes de nas de'i/ /ye shes su ni yang dag brtsam/ /lce la dmar po'i āḥ yi ge/ /dgod par byas la de nas yang / /smros shig rdo rje zhes smras pas/ /dge dang mi dge nyid 'chad 'gyur/ /de nas yang ni der babs la/ /yi ge brgya phyed pa rnams kyis/ /brtan par byas nas de nas phyis/ /yang dag byin rlabs brtsam par bya/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ 6ḍho me bha wa shā shwa to me bhā wa z-i 7da yo me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha sarba karma su tsa me tsit+t+waṃ gre yaḥku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ/ zhes bya ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ru yang dag par/ /bdag gi slob ma bcug pa la/ /ji lta'i bsod nams de bzhin shog /lha rnams kyi 9ni rigs kyi rim/ /gang gi rigs kyi snod yin pa/ /gang 'dra 'di yi dngos grub 'gyur/ /gang 'dra'i bsod nams rjes mthun pa'i//de 'dra dkyil 'khor 'dir gyur cig /sngags brjod pa yi tshig gis ni/ /me tog phreng ba dor bar bya/ /'phangs pa'i me tog phreng ba ni/ /lha yi gnas la 12—167

babs shes bya/ /oṃ pra bi sh+ya ku lo ma hā ba lo/ /zhes bya 'di yi phreng ba de/ /blangs nas su ni de nas yang / /bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs rte7'di ni/ /sngags pa mkhas pa yis bya'o/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du skye/ /bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzugs brnyan lta bur slob ma ni/ /gsal zhing sdig med mthong bar shog /de nas mig gnyis zla ba la/ /oṃ mo snying gar zla ba las—/ /bdag po yang dag dmigs byas nas/ /de yis mig bltas 'od rnams kyis/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni lha rnams kyi— —/ /spyan dang dbyer med rang bzhin du/ /yang dag dmigs nas de nas phyis/ /mig gnyis la ni legs btus te/ /yang ni 'jug par byas nas ni/ /de yi bcings pa dgrol bar bya/ /mig 'byed pa yi gsang sngags 'di—/ /ji lta ba ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho deng spyod kyi sogs so—/ /4 kār+ṇa bā swā yadhe r+ya5/ tsakyu ruṅgha ṭa 6na tat+pa ra/ uṅgha ṭa 3/ya ti sar+pā k+ko/ badz+ra tsak+ṣu rā nut+ta 9ra/ zhes bya'o/ /gdong bcings pa nyid bkrol byas nas/ /lan cig tu ni dri 11bar bya/ /khyod kyi samig gis ci mthong gyur / /ji lta ba de nges par smros/ /dkar dang ser dang de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dang ni nag po nyid/ /zhes bya'i dngos grub de shes nas/ /dkyil 'khor bstan pa smra bar bya/ /kye rdo rje ltos shig ces bya'o/ /de ltar brjod nas slar 'di brjod/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rigs su skye/ /mthong bas dngos grub thams cad 'ong / /phun sum tshogs 72byed/68

pa mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig bsrungs la dngos grub ste/ /khyod kyis sngags rnams la brtson bya/ /ji ltar bsod nams dag stobs las/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba de nas ni/ /sna tshogs 'od zer 'phros pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor mthong bar the tshom med/ /de nas he ru ka dpal sogs/ /kun nas de yi dkyil 'khor pa/ /bstan nas de nas smra bya ba/ /lha yi de nyid brtsam par bya//gang zhig shrī gang bla med de'i/ /ru nyid kyang ni med pa yin/ /brjod dngos sped las de rnams kun/ /dpal he ru ka zhes byar grags/ /rdor ye shes la dbyer med phyir/ /rtag tu sdig pa las sgrib 3dang / /'dod chags dman pa'i spyor ba gang / /rdo rje sngon song can phag mo/ /mchog tu 'gro ba'i ngang tshul phyir/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /de yi rigs lnga po'ang de 'dra'o / /gang zhig rtag tu gdug za bas/ /lā ma zhes byar de bzhin dran/ /de rigs lnga po yang de 'dra/ /de bzhin shes bya gzhan gnyis kyi'ang / /dum bur byed cing bskyed pas kyang / /dum skyes ma zhes bya bar brjod/ /sna tshogs pa yi gzugs 'dzin phyir/ /gzugs can ma zhes rab tu bshad/ /gzhan yang gtso bo'i rnam dag pa/ /bdun cu rtsa gnyis phyag rnams ni/ /rgyud dag par ni rnam par brjod/ /phyag bzhi rgod pa la sogs pa/ /bzhi po rnams ni dag par 'dod/ /zhal rnams dag pa'i dngos po ni/ /lhan skyes rdzogs byang chub bcu drug /bcu bdun pa yi zhal du bshad/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das zhabs gnyis/ /thams cad rgyan gyis dag pa ni/ /chos dang chos pa'i skye rnams so/ /lhag ma lha rnams thams cad kyi/ /so sor brjod par mi nus pas/ /'khor lo bcu gnyis dag pa yang / /gnas bcu gnyis dang sa 72—/69

bcu gnyis/ /rdo rje 'chang ba sgor gnas rnams/ /de rnam dag pa'i ngo bo yin//ye shes chos dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /sprul pa dag pas dkyil 'khor bzhi/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor mchog yin pa/ /gang phyir dkyil 'khor yang dag bshad/ /ye shes chos dang longs spyod rdzogs/ /kun nas kun du mnyam pa'i phyir/ /zlum po'i dkyil 'khor gsum yin no/ /sprul pa kun du 'phrul rgyas pas/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa gru bzhi pa/ /yang na mtha' bzhi gcod phyir ro/ /rlung gnyis dbu mar 'dus pa las/ /sku gsum dang ni dga' ba bzhi/ /ye shes lnga rnam —1dag pa ni/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi rtsig 7 la rim sbyar/ /bzhi po kun kyi thun mong gi/ /rnam dag rgyas par gsungs bshad bya/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i thig yin phyir/ /mnyam pa'i tshad med pa las so/ /tshul khrims sdom pa bla med pa/ /rgyan gang yin par yang dag bshad/ /dad pa'i dbang po sogs can sems/ /rtsig pa lnga ru byung ba yin/ /rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi/ /gang gis sgor ni yang dag bshad/ /yang dag rab tu spong ba bzhi/ /rta babs kyi 4ni ka bar byung / /dran pa'i ye shes bzhi rnams ni/ /kha khyer bzhi ru dran par bya/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni rkang pa bzhi/ /sgo khyud rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /byang chub yan lag bdun phreng ba/ /ba dan me tog phreng bar ltabarjod/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes ni/ /ting 'dzin gnyis su brtags pa yin/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnga yab tu ni brjod pa yin/ /nyon mongs thams cad zad byed pas/ /de bzhin dra ba zhes brjod do/ /yang dag gcod pa'i rab 'phrog pa/ /tshogs gnyis kyis ni spyor bas te/ /nyon mongs rnams kyis phyed phrog phyir/ /dra ba phyed pa zhes brjod do/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi khang — chen 12—170

rnams—/ /dus thams cad du ka bar byung / /'phags pa'i lam kyi yan lag brgyad—/ /ka ba brgyad ces bya bar dran/ /de yi dbus kyi pad+ma gang / /skyon gyis ma gos par ston to/ /'khor lo bcu gnyis bshad pa rnams/ /sa yi mi mthun phyogs spong ba'o/ /yang dag bshad pa'i rtsibs 'di rnams/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs sel/ /rdo rje la sogs phreng ba gang / /glo du1 bur ba yi dri ma sel/ /cha shas bcu drug rnams kyi bar/ /dur khrod dag par shes par byebya/ /dkyil 'khor dag pa thams cad kyang / /'khor bsdus ston pa po yin no/ /lhag ma 'jig rten khams kyis ni/ /rnam dag gsal dang mi gsal ba'o/ /sangs rgyas yon tan de dag kun/ /dkyil 'khor du ni brjod pa yin/ /sems can kun don brtson rnams kyis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi de nyid bstan/ /de nas bdag po'i spyor ldan pas/ /dbang bskur de nas khu tshur gyis/ /ji lta'i sngags ni klog bzhin du'o/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ badzā bhi ṣiñtsa/de nas de yi mgo bor ni/ /ral pa'i cod pan khyab par bskon/ /gus pas dbu rgyan dbang bskur ba/ /de yis rjes mthun bsam par bya/ /de nas rang gi mtshan ma'i dbang / /lag pa dag tu sbyin par bya/ /sngags pas rang mtshan rjes 'gro ba/ /ji ltar sngags 'di brjod bzhin du'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang / /de ring khyod la bsgur bar bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub phyir na rdo rje la'o/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje/ /de ltar gang gis 'di yi ming / /kye sgra sngon du song bas bya/ /shes rab thabs kyi ting 'dzin yang / /yang dag bstan bya de nas phyis / /phyag rgya bzhi yi man ngag yang / /slob ma yis kyang de nas phyis/ /thal sbyar byas pas slob 12—171

dpon la/ /gus pas phyag byas de nas ni/ /phreng ba bcing sogs kun bzung nas—/ /de nas rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid—/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje brtul zhugs brtan/ /de nas rdo rje bzung lku/nas ni/ /sngags 'di dag ni brjod par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sedhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa two dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi ti hūṃ zhes bya'orte/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 'di brjod nas/ /de nas dril bu'i brtul zhugs sbyin/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /gang gi lha yis kyedabang bskur ba'i/ /gang de'i dngos grub the tshom med/ /gang rnams lha ni mngon byas pa'i/ /las rnams 'bras bu sgrub par byed/ /rig pa'i dbang gi cho gas so4/ /de ltar byas nas de nas phyis/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i rim pa yi5/ /cho ga yis ni yang dag bya/ /gdan ni pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas bdag po'i spyor ldan pa'i/ /nga rgyal de nas byas nas ni/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i cho ga yis/ /slob ma'i gtso bo gus pa yis/ /dbang bsgur don du gsol gdab pa/ /byas nas yang ni de nas rang 6/ /langs nas de nas slob ma des7/ /pad zla la gnas bsam par bya/ /de nas rang lha'i bsam gtan gyis/ /byen gyis brlab cipa la sogs gang / /de bzhin chu yi dbang bskur dang / /sngon du mkhas pa yis bya'o/ /khyad par du yang ji ltar 'dir—/ /gtso bo'i bum pa'i chu rnams kyis/ /de sngags sngon du brjod pa gang / /rgyun mi 'chad par dbang bskur bya/ /ji srid rnam rgyal bum sogs 12—172

kyis—/ /khrag 'thung slob dpon thob bya'i phyir/ /oṃ s+dzahūṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa zhes bya'o / /rang shegis gsang sngags klog bzhin du'o/ /de nas shes rab can gyi de—/ /mgo bor cod pan khrag 'thung ldan/ /rdo rje'i phreng ba'ang rnam bsams nas/ /sngon bzhin du ni dbang bskur bya/ /de nas khro bo'i rdo rje sbyin//rdo rje'i dbang bskur du ni 'dod 3/ /rgyud gzhan las ni rab grags gang / /mkhas pas de kho na 'di brjod/ /rtag tu 'dod chags las byung khro/ /rdo rje me yi phung po'i sku/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor che/ /kun nas mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'o/ /zhes so/ /s+thāḥbadag po yi ni dbang bskur kyang / /dril bu byin nas de dgrol rngute/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ rmezhes bya sogs/ /de nas chos ni rab bstan bya/ /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam spyor ba yis/ /thams cad mchog nyid bsgrub par bya/ /dhīḥyang na srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis /5 srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa'i mchog tu byed par 'gyur/ /de nas de bzhin mang bshad pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba yang byin nas ni/ /rig dang lhan cig tu bzhag nas/ /dam tshig rjes su bsgrags 6par bya/ /shin tu be+e bas bder gyur dang / /sdug bsngal mang po zhi bya'i phyir//shin tu dam pa bde ba'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni bde ba 'gugs/ /'dod pa kun gyi longs spyod kyis/ /ji ltar 'dod pa ster bar bya/ /rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis/ /rang gzhan mchod pa nyid du bya/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas 'dug pa/ /rtul ne+ephod mang por gyur pa yis/ /de srid sems can mnyam med don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' nus par gyis/ /gsang mchog dam tshig gi ni 72—173

thabs / /bsod nams byin rlabs hukyis bsgrubs pas/ /dngos grub kun dbang phyug grub pas/ /sems can don ni rtag 27par gyis/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig mngon par bshad/ /yid kyi sku ni brtan pa'i phyir/ /gang gis thams cad sku brtan pa/ /de yis phyag rgya rab tu grags/ /zhes so/ /de nas de bzhin nyer gnas nyid/ /rig ma slob ma yang dag ldan/ /yid dang rjes mthun zas la sogs/ /sna tshogs btung ba 'thungs nas ni/ /kha ni ga bur dris bsgo bya / /lus la dri zhim po byas nas/ /phan tshun dgod pa la sogs dang / /dga' ro bde ba yang dag ldan/ /dbang gnyis yang dag legs sbyar ba / /de yi dga' ba'i bde shar bas/ /de bzhin gshegs sogs thams cad kyis/ /bkra shis glu la sogs rnams kyis/ /bdag nyid la ni bskul bzhin par4/ /rang gi rnam par bsam par bya/ /dbang bsgur rdo rje chen po ni / /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pas/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya/ /zhes so/ /de ltar brjod nas rdo rje las/ /pad+mar ltung khar legs par gzhug /a ho su khaṃ zhes bya brjod/ /rdo rje ye shes byung gang de/ /des kyang dgug par bya ba yin/ /'di ni shin tu gsang chen don/ /dbang bsgur ba ni rmad byung /ltache/ /rdo rje dang ni dril sgrogs pas/ /mchog tu dga' ba byed rnams kyis/ /de kho na nyid 'di brjod bya / /dbang bskur ba ni rang la sbyin/ /gang de'am dga' ba'i gzugs kyis snying la bde ba byed pa de yang kun du rtog pa tsam/ /gang yang chags bral rgyu yang de gnyis de yi srid pa'i rtse mo'i rgyu/ /ji srid brgya la yid la rnam par rtog pa 'phro ba spangs pa'i gzugs de srid/ /mya ngan 'das pa gzhan na cung 12—/74

zad kyang ni yod min yul ni rnam par rtog pa'i bdag nyid bsam pa'o/ /'di yi de nyid mi shes pa'o 1/ /slob ma rnams la bstan mi bya/ /blo ldan rnam par rtog med la/ /legs par sbas pa 'di sbyin bya/ /de nas de nyid la bzhag nas / /mkha' 'go ma sogs pas mchod de/ /sngon bzhin legs par mnyam gzhag pas/ /de nas rdo rje dril byin te/ /deng nas brtsams nas rnal 'byor pas/ /rgyud kun las gsungs rnams kyi yang / /ma lus lus pa med pa yi/ /cho ga yis ni dkyil 'khor bri/ /ji ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i lha'isnye/ /rang gi 'dod pas 'jug pa nyid/ /rnal 'byor dmigs pa'i dngos grub ni/ /tha ma dang ni mchog dang 'bring / /phra mo yi ni las la sogs/ /ji ltar de rnams sgrub par byed/ /rang gzhan bshad pa'i dngos grub phyir/ /de yis 'grub par the tshom med/ /'di ni rdo rje slob dpon kyi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /de ltar rdzogs pa'i slob ma la/ /rjes gnang dbang bsgur bstan par bya//dkyil 'khor las phyir khru gnyis ni/ /dor gebar de yi phyed can gyi/ /sgo thams cad kyi phyogs su ni/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi can/ /de'i dbus sna tshogs pad+ma ni/ /dkyil 'khor du bri de la ni/ /shin tu 'jam pa'i gnas 'dug ste/ /mkha' 'go rgya mtsho'i dpal gzugs kyis/ /rang bdag pad+ma la gnas par/ /mnyam par gzhag 5pas bsgom par bya/ /de nas slob ma gus chen pos/ /yon gyi mchog ni phul ba yi/ /rang rig de bzhin phul byas nas/ /de las byung ba'i byang chub sems/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis mchod nas/ /de dang lhan cig bza' bar bya/ /slob dpon dbang po gnyis 'dzom la /12—175

phyag 'tshal ba yis gsol ba gdab/ /bdag ming rdo rje che ge mo/ /byang chub sems rnams sgom byed pa/ /slob dpon zhabs kyi chu skyes la/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba 'debs/ /slob dpon go 'phang rmad byung ba/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur rgyal ba rnams kyi ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa/ /gang gis bdag sems can kun gyi/ /rnyog pa med pas don bya'o / /khyod legs brtul zhugs bka' drin gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun don don bya'o/ /de ltar gsol btab kyeblo ldan pas/ /de tshe slob dpon gyis de nas / /yang dag bzhengs nas dbang bskur ba/ /de'i rim 'di yis brtag par bya/ /slob ma rang lha'i rnam pa ru/ /ji ltar sngon bzhin rdzogs byas nas/ /yig gsum byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /pad+ma la gnas rnam par bsam/ /slob dpon nus pa ldan pa'o/ /de yi dbang bskur grub bya'i phyir/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i gsang sngags sam/ /de bzhin du ni yig gsum gyis/ /sngags snyepa'i yungs kar rnams kyis ni/ /gsang sngags lan cig zlos bzhin du/ /lha yi 'khor lo la brdeg bya/ /de nas lha rnams rang nyid ni/ /bkra shis glu yi sngags rnams dang / /dag byed bum pa'i chu rnams kyis/ /rig dang lhan cig langs rnams kyis/ /de yi bla med dbang bskur sbyin/ /med na bdud rtsis gang ba yi sna/ /bum pa la ni de bzhin brdeg /rgyal ba dag gis gsungs pa ltar / /rang nyid la ni dbang bskur te/ /gal te nus pa med gyur na/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rgyal mtshan dang / /pi wang gling bu rnga la sogs/ /sna tshogs gos kyi tshogs rnams dang / /rin chen rgyal mtshan chomachog rnams kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams yang dag ldan/ /nam mkha' gang bar bsgom par bya/ /72—176

de nas de bzhin gshegs kun kyis/ /'dod chags chen po zhu ldan pa'i/ /de bzhin bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs pas bdag nyid/ /yongs su bskor bar rnam par bsam/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i chu/ /bkra shis glu rnams dang bcas pas/ /gsang sngags 'di ni brjod bzhin du/ /slob ma 'di yis dbang bskur bya/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka two a bhi ṣiñtsa mi sarba ta thā ga ta a bye pa ti dz+wa 1na dṛ bye 2me bha ba sibye na ma ste bha ga bān ༄ ma hā badz+ra dha ra su ra ta ste 4a haṃ badz+ra satwa oṃ s+dzahūṃ badz+ra a bye ṣiñtsa zhes bya'ocho/ /dbang bskur nyid na gzhan rnams kyi/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang dpa' rnams kyis/ /lugs 'byung g.yon du bskor ba yis/ /sems can dbang ni bskur bzhin du/ /shis pa brjod pa bsam par bya/ /de nas dbu rgyan dar dpyang sogs/ /gsang ba'i mthar thug thog ma bzhin / /6shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ba/ /mkhas pas sbyin pa nyid du bya/ /stan de la ni rab bzhag nas/ /'di ni phra ba'i smra bas brjod/ /'di ni khyod kyis 7gzungs ma mchog /bsten byar 37sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /'khor lo'i rim pas spyor ba yis/ /bde ba yang dag myong bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan kyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro ba gsum po 'di yis dag /de phyir 'di dang mi 'bral zhing / /khyod kyis nam yang mi gtong ngo / /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med/ /rmongs pas gang zhig 'da' byed na/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod nas ni gtad par bya/ /me tog phreng dri gos brgyan nas/ /gos med pad+ma gsal bstan nas/ /de la 'di skad rim pas / brjod—/ /bu khyod kyang ni 'dod dam ci/ /dri chen dri chu sogs za zhing / /12—177

sha khrag khu ba de bzhin du/ /de bzhin gzhan yang bud med gus/ /bha ga'i pad+mo 'o byed pa/ /bu khyod smros shig ci bde bar/ /zhes so/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi 'dod/ /khrag dang khu ba sogs za zhing / /bud med rnams la bdag gus bgyisanyu/ /bha ga la yang 'o bkyid do༄ bhe/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dga' ste thabs kyi bzhin la blta zhing tsog por 'dug ste pad+ma shin tu gsal bar bstan te/ a ho bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /sangs rgyas kun kyis byin brlabs pas/ /gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na kyibadag gnas so/ /ji ltar pad+ma'i dgos pa nyid/ /yang dag sangs rgyas mnyes byed sogs / /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid la ni yang dag zhugs/ /bhañdza 4mo k+ṣa hoḥzhes brjod par bya'o/ /de 5gnyis gtso bo gtso mo yi/ /rnal 'byor byas nas mkha' gsang ba/ /byin brlabs tsuspa na sogs bya/ /pad+ma'i rtsa btsal sogs byas te/ /lhan skyes bde ba myong bar bya/ /de yang bdag gi bla ma ni/ /bag ma len pa'i rim pas mdzad/ /dga' ba rtogs par shes nas ni/ /bla ma slob mas 'di skad brjod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko36haṃ/ 'di yis 3mngon par dbang bskur bas/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /ji ltar nus pas bde ba bzung / /pad+ma choltung ba bza' bar bya/ /bde ba rtogs pa'i dus su ni/ /slob dpon snyeng ga las byung ba'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs de snying zhugs/ /de ltar byas pas brtan g.yo yi9/ /bde bas slob dpon du 'gyur ro/ /de nas brtsams te 'di de la/ /gsang ba mchog ni bstan par bya/ /rgyud thams cad du gang cung zad/ /rtsas shing bris pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /de nas dbang gnyis spyor ba yis//12—178

de nyid 7gdan la rab bzhag ste/ /phyi dang gsang sogs mchod rnams kyis/ /yang dag mchod nas de nas gzhan/ /gzugs sogs gsang ba'i mchod rnams kyis / /'di ltar rim pas yang dag mchod/ /de nas dga' bzhi'i dbye sogs kyis/ /bzhi par brjod pa brtan —par bya/ /me long de yi — nga rgyal can / /'di ltar legs bstan 'di brjod bya/ /gzugs brnyan rnam par chos thams cad/ /srid mtshor 4de rnams lhag rtog pa/ /chos thams cad ni zhes bya ba/ /gzugs brnyan lta bur dbab byas nas/ /chos thams cad ni zhes bya ba/ /sems can kun la bstan par gyis/ /sgra yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis//de ltar pi wang sgra brjod bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sgra yi rjes su 'gro 5ba yis/ /shes rab mngon du rtogs gyur cig /gang gis 'jig rten thams cad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /kun du sgra brnyan lta bu yithu/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis shaṃ/ /dri yi nga rgyal ldan pa yis/ /snying gar dri bsku 'di skad brjod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /skye med lhag par rtogs gyur cig /gang gis sangs rgyas zhing kun dang / /'jig rten kun du bla med pa'i/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi dri/ /rang gi lus las — spro bar bya'o/ /ro yi nga rgyal ldan de ltar/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni 'dus byas nas/ /yang dag par ni myang byas nas/ /ngag gis 'di skad brjod par bya/ /ro kun gcig gi /rnam par ni/ /rang bzhin med pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /lhag pa ru ni rtogs gyur cig /gang gis sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /srog chags gyur pa thams cad la/ /lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog /sprul nas su ni sbyin par bya'o/ /de ltar reg bya'i nga rgyal ldan/ /12—179

rnal 'byor ma yi spyor brtson pas/ /byas nas rang gi rig ma mchog /reg la mkhas pas 'di skad brjod/ /reg byas rjes su mi gos par/ /de ni lhag par rtogs gyur cig /gang gis reg bya'i khyad par rnams/ /rang gi sems la byung zhes par/ /lhag par mos byas sna tshogs pa'i/ /bla med reg bya'i khyad par rnams/ /rang gi sems ni yongs gyur las/ /lha rnams thams cad gnas rnams dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' sogs kun la/ /kun spyor reg bya'i bde ba ni/ /nges par sbyar bar bya ba yin/ /zhes so/ /legs mchod 'di ltar gser sogs pa'i/ /thur ma mngon par bsngags byas nas/ /oṃ badz+ra ni 1tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa paṃ s+thāḥzhes bya ba'o/ /mnyam par gzhag 2pa'i sems kyis ni/ /mdun du 'dug nas 'di brjod bya/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal bzhin du'o/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas slob ma'i mig dag la/ /mig sman 'byug pa'i tshul byas nas/ /sngags pas me long bstan byas te/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid brjod par bya/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung / /de ltar shes byas chos 'di ni/ /rang bzhin med pa rnyog pa med/ /sems can don ni mnyam med gyis / /skyob pa rnams kyi 4rigs su skye/ /de nas sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ya 5swā hā/ zhes bya ba brjod nas/ hoḥ6zhes bya ba yis ni gzhu7/ /byin nas des kyang brtson pa yis/ /phyogs bzhi rnams su mda' bzhi ni/ /de bzhin du ni 'phang bar bya/ /gcig gi steng dang 'og 12—180

tu yang / /legs mnyam gzhag 1pas drang bar bya/ /badz+ra satwa aḥbarjod bzhin du/ /de nas me long blangs nas ni/ /rnal 'byor lhur len slob dpon gyis / /de la 'di nyid 'di ltar brjod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang bzhin nyid—/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag po gang / /bu yi snying la gnas pa'o/ /zhes so2/ /t+t+waṃ gis de nas chos 'khor lo/ /de yi stan gyi mdun du ni/ /bzhag byas aḥldan lag g.yas su/ /dung byen nas ni 'di skad brjod/ /deng nas brtsams nas 'jig rten du/ /skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor rab bskor/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa/ /dri ma med pa kun du gang 5/ /the tshom med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /'di la blo ngan med par brjod / /chos kyi spyod pa'i tshul mchog ni/ /rang gi mnyam med rab tu ston//de ltar sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ / byas zhes 6dgongs pa byed ces brjod/ /de yis rdo rje 'chang kun gyis/ /thams cad du ni khyod srung 7'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de nas de bzhin gzhan nyid ni/ /mkhas pas dam tshig bsgrags par bya/ /thabs dang shes rab sems kyis 8ni/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /rtag tu dogs med gyur byas nas/ /'dod pa lnga la longs spyod bya/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul gyur pa/ /sems can de yi rang bzhin gyis/ /de lta de ltar sems can don/ /'dod chags sogs pas 9dag par bya/ /gang gzhan dam tshig la sdang ba/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i skye bo de/ /'bad pa yis ni gsad 7par bya/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba la/ /sems can kun la phan don phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor rab bskyod pa1 / /pha rol po yi sems phrogs mukyang / /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /12—/8/

'dod chags lta bu'i bde med pas/ /skye bo rnams la de rtag sbyin/ /sems can don du gzhan bud med/ /bsten pas bsod nams thob par 'gyur / /sangs rgyas la sogs smod pa la/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rnal 'byor gyis/ /tshig ni rtsub mo la sogs pas/ /bla med dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /'od dpag med kyi brdzun ngag smra/ /don yod grub mchog ting 'dzin gyis/ /blo ldan rgyud gsungs cho ga yis/ /dam tshig dag pa bsten par bya/ /zhes bya ba'o/ /de nas dpal te ru ka zhes sogs/ /bstod cing yang ni bstod byas te/ /thal sbyar byas pas /'dud byas nyid/ /'di skad slob ma la brjod bya/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /sems can kun la thams cad du/ /ji ltar ga/dul bya sna tshogs pa/ /rdo rje'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs kun rgyal ba rgyal/ /bdag po'i 'khor lo bskor bar gyis / /zhes so/ /rjes su gnang ba'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o// //de ltar byas nas de nas phyis/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas/ /dkyil 'khor bltas nas gsang sngags kyi/ /bskul bar smra ba sbyin par bya/ /ting 'dzin sngags kyi rgyal po yis/ /byin nas gsang ba brtsam par bya/ /rgyud 'dir gsungs pa'i dam pa'i rdzas/ /mkhas pa yis ni bza' bar bya/ /de nas steng du langs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun bdag rnal 'byor brtson/ /rdo rje'i ming dbang bskur ba yis/ /'di skad de bzhin gshegs lung bstan/ /de la 'di'i rim brjod bya ste/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dpal gzugs kyis/ /slob ma de bzhin yongs bzhag nas/ /rang yang bdag po'i sbyor ba ldan/ /12—sde82

chos gos lag pa g.yon pa yis/ /'dzin pa'i tshul gyis de bzhin du/ /mngon par mchog sbyin tshul nyid kyis/ /mnyam par gzhag 3pas 'di skad brjod/ /ngas 'di khyod la lung bstan bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin du dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa 2khyod kyi dam tshig go zhes bya ba'o//gang gis cho ga 'di yis ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i tshul gang gis/ /gang la lung bstan byed bzhin pa/ /dpal te ru ka sogs lha dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang / /dkyil 'khor 'khor du gnas rnams dang / /dam tshig gcod pa'i mgrin pa yis/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub bstan pa mdzadaḥ/ /'di ltar 'di'i 4phyag rgya chen pos mchog tu gsang ba chen po bzang po bden pa'i byin gyi rlabs 5kyis 'grub par 'gyur te 'di'i tshig gis zhes bya ba la dad par bya'o zhes bya ba nyid brjod nas phyis6/ yang dag dbugs dbyung sbyin par bya/ /gsang mchog dkyil 'khor dam par ni/ /bltas nas su ni rab zhugs pas/ /sdig pa kun las rnam nges grol/ /de ring legs par gnas par 'gyur/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /slar yang 'chi ba yod pa min—/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi choms par/ /'jigs pa med pas rol par gyis—/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las ni 'das/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir//dngos grub dam pa sdom pa ni/ /'di ni rtag tu bsrung bar gyis/ /rjes gnang mchog tu dbugs 'byin pa/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rab tu gsungs/ /rdo rje zhes gang phyag rgya dang / /byang chub sems ni mi spang zhing / /gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'o/ /dam pa'i chos 12—183

ni spang mi bya/ /mi shes nga/'am rmongs pa yis/ /gal te na ni spangs pa nihūṃ/ /gang las de ni nges par sbyangs/ /rang gis bdag nyid mi spang zhing / /dka' thub kyis kyang btsir mi bya/ /ji srid bde ba'i bde ba bzung / /'di ni ma 'ongs sdogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /nam yang spang bar mi bya'o/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam / /gang zhig slob dpon la smod la/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam / /sangs rgyas thams cad smad pas na/ /de ni rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob2 / /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug nad/ /mkha' 'gros 'tshe dang gdon rnams dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren drag rnams kyis/ /bsad nas dmyal bar ltung bar byed/ /de phyir kun nas rab 'bad pas/ /rdo rje slob dpon bla ma che/ /dge mchog rab tu mi spyoms pa/ /nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la gus de la yon/ /de nas rjes mthun dbul bar bya/ / de yis 4rims sogs gdung ba rnams/ /phyir zhing dbyung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi 5dam tshig spyod/ /sbyin min bu dang bu mo sogs/ /srog rnams kyis kyang bsten bya na6/ /longs spyod g.yo ba smos ci dgos/ /gang phyir bskal pa bye rnams kyis/ /rtag tu rnyed par dka' ba yi7/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang brtson ldan pa/ /tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsgrub/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod/ /rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de yis 8bsod nams tshogs yin te/ /tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /de ring bdag 12—/84

skyes 'bras bur bcas/ /gang 'dir 1legs par rab tu gnas/ /dam tshig lha rnams dang mnyam mo/ /rang byung du ni da lta skyes/ /ding 2'dir dbang bskur tshe ldan pa/ /rdo rje bcas sangs rgyas kun gyis/ /khams gsum gyi rgyal sred che yi/ /rgyal po bdag pos gnas pa yin/ /di — ring bdud las rgyal byas nas/ /grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs/ /di 4ring sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyod 'gyur bar ni the tshom med/ /zhes bya ba yi bka' drin rdo rje yid kyis te/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde skyes bsten par gyis/ /shin tu skyes sla'i 5bde ba sangs rgyas kun gzugs brnyan/ /rtag pa nyid ni rtogs par 'gyur bar 6shog /ces bya'o/ /bla ma yi 7ni zhabs gnyis la/ /gus pas mnyes gshin pas btud de/ /ji ltar gsungs shing bstan pa kun/ /ji lta'i dag rjes gnang zhes gsol/ /de ltar dam bcas byas pa yi / /slob ma la phan bsam pa yis/ /sngon bzhin bshad pa'i rim pa yis/ /rdo rje dril bu'i brtul zhugs sbyin/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa t+t+waṃ 9 dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi hūṃ/ zhes bya ba'o/ /'di skad gsang sngags brjod nas ni/ /'di skad bzhin du dril bu sbyin/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /ces so/ /de nas me tog dri la sogs/ /sgeg mo sogs pas mchod par bya/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis kyang / /de bzhin gshegs rnams mchod byas nas/ /ci ltar bde bas slob ma rnams sa/ /72—/85

shes rab sgo nas mchod pa yang / /spos sogs ji ltar 'dod pa yis/ /ji lta ba yi mchod par ①bya/ /ji ltar 'byor par gyur pa yis/ /zhugs pa'i slob ma bza' dang bcas/ /rnam par sna tshogs ro'i bza' ba/ /myos byed btung ②ba sna tshogs dang / /gang zhig rgyud gzhan la grags pa'i(1/ /glu sgra nye bar spyod rnams kyis/ /'di ④don cho gas phul ba yi 'u/ /bla ma'i bde bas yang dag mchod/ /de bzhin du ni yang gsungs pa/ /chang bcas chang min khyebatung ba dang / /ji ltar 'dod pa ⑦bsten par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyis/ /ji lta'i rim pas bsgom par bya/ /gsang ba blude nyid glu chen dang / /dga' dang rol mo gar rnams dang / /dga' rol rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /gtso bo la sogs mchod par bya/ /de nas dul ba'i klu/sems nyid ni/ /sngon du smra bya zhes bya'o/ /dam tshig ma lus pa 'di rnams/ /ji ltar gsung bar rab bsgrub bya/ /de nas phyi rol mchod sogs dang / /yid 'byung rnams kyis gtso bo la/ /sngags pas gus pas mchod byas te/ /nyi ma shar ba'i dus su yang / /dpal te ru ka ye shes che/ /zhes bya'i bstod pas ji ltar yang / /legs par bstod nas de nas phyis/ /'di skad rgyal ba la mkhyen gsol/ /gang yang skye ba'i dngos gyur ḍa snadang / /ma rnyed rnal 'byor dbang phyir dang / /nye bar dgos 11pa ma tshang ba'am/ /dran pa rab tu rmongs byas pa/ /de thams cad la bzod par rigs/ /de ltar mkhyen gsol de nas phyis—/ /'di yis gshegs su gsol bya ba/ /oṃ khyed kyis tesems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥ/12—186

ye shes dkyil 'khor gtso bo rnams/ /de nas yang dag basbu bya ste/ /dgyes par rab tu bzhad pa'i zhal/ /slob dpon slob ma'i yon tan 'gyur/ /bar byas rang rang 'od rnams kyis/ /sems can kun la reg par bya/ /ji ltar 'dod pa de bzhin du/ /gsal bar byas pa bsam par bya/ /de nas ji ltar spro ba yi3/ /lha yi 'khor lo gus pa yis/ /rang gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /de nas phur bu gdon bya ste/ /sngags ni oṃ badz+ra tī li kri la ya sarba biṭ+wāṃ badz+ra dha rā dz+nyā snehūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces so/ /de nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /de yis rdul tshon la'ang spros —pas/ /de kho na nyid kyis te rlabs cican phyir/ /yang dag mchod nas de nas yang / /de phyir blo ldan kyis legs gshegs/ /a kā ro mu khaṃ la sogs can/ /brjod bzhin du ni 'di yi don/ /mnyam par gzhag pa ༄5mngon du bya/ /de ltar snang ba med byas nas/ /rang gi snying gnas pa'i gtso bo/ /mchod nas de bzhin bstod byas te/ /de yi sbyor ba nye bar bsdu/ /bkra shis kun du spyod pas brgyan/ /mgo bor gdugs ni bzung nas su/ /de nas bla ma rang nyid kyis/ /rdo rje dril 'dzin slob ma la/ /bskor ba bya ba yin pa ste/ /sngags pas 'di ltar brjod bzhin du/ /kun nas dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la'o/ /mnga' bdag sku mdog sngon po rgyal gyur cig /dmar pos ji ltar mdzes byas rgyal gyur cig /dam tshig gis brgyan mdzes pa rgyal gyur byug /zla phyed dbu la brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /lha mo'i 'khor los brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /dang po sangs rgyas sku mchog gnas pa rgyal gyur cig /'dod pa thar pa nor dang chos sbyin rgyal gyur cig /rnam par dgyes rol rang bzhin rgyal gyur cig /phyag rdor bde ba'i mgon po rgyal gyur cig /de nas 12—187

——sgor gdugs dang bcas pas phyag bya'o/ /slob mas 'di ni bsten par gyis/ /de nas rgol ba tshar gcod 'gyur/ /de skad brjod nas slob dpon des/ /lag pas gdugs ni bsal byas te/ /langs nas 'di skad slob ma la/ /'di ni de nas bsgrag 1par bya/ /de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon dang / /sngags dang rgyud ni 'dzin par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par bzhed/ /sems can la rjes brtse don du/ /khyod kyi 2dkyil 'khor cho ga yis/ /'bad pa yis ni bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la spyor/ /ser sna dogs pa thams cad la/ /sems can rnams la phan pa dang / /de la bu khyod kyis bya ste/ /rang nyid dka' ba chen po yang / /de nas cho gas sbyin sreg ni/ /mkhas pas zhi ba'i don du bya/ /de nas sbyin sreg zin pa ni4/ /slob dpon mchod bya yang dag par/ /mu tig gser dang rin chen rnams/ /glang rta sa gzhi yul ljongs dang / /bran po chobran mo 'khor rnams dang / /chung ma phun sum tshogs kun dang / /gos zung du ma rnams dang ni/ /dgyes pa'am sa la gang cung zad/ /bdag tu lta ba dang bral bas /dbul bya gtso bo zhi bar gyes/ /bdag nyid dngos po thams cad kyi6/ /phyag byas nas ni dbul bar bya/ /me tog spos sogs thams cad rnams/ /ston pa'i mdun du dbul bar bya/ /bla ma'i yon ni blang 7bar bya/ /dngul dang gser dang rin chen sogs/ /rta dang glang po rgyal srid do/ /slob mas kyang ni de nas phyis/ /dam tshig bsten par gyur rnams kyis/ /dpal te ru ka shes rab che/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom/ /zhes bya'i rjes su gnang sems kyis / /skor ba lan gsum byas nas ni/ /lus thams cad ni phab byas nas//72—/88

ji ltar sngon bzhin phyag byas te/ /bdag nyid bla ma la phul nas/ /mchod pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /ji srid mnyes par ma gyur par/ /de srid bla ma mnyes par bya/ /cung zad shin tu yid 'od gang / /shin tu khyad par 'phags pa nyid/ /de de rnams la bla mar dbul/ /de nyid mi zad 'dod pas so/ /gang gis gtang zubar dka' ba gang / /de ni bzang po zhes byar grags / /de ltar gang zhig dbang bsgur ba/ /de ni slob dpon du mngon brjod—/ /de yis sngags byin nges par ni/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med / /de nas oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs/ /rdo rje'i glu ni brjod bzhin du/ /rdo rje gar gyis — rab sbyor bas/ /rdul tshon rgya mtshor 'gro ba yi/ /chu bo nyid la rab 4bskur bya/ /de nas sa de yang dag par/ /ba'i rang bzhin gyis yang dag byug /bdag dang slob ma mi bdag la/ /phan pa'i phyir ni sbyin sreg bya/ /slar yang gsang sngags de nyid kyis/ /phur pa dbyung ba de bzhin no/ /bde ba yis ni khrus byas te/ /bdag med sgom pa spyad par bya/ /slob dpon gyis ni de nas phyis/ /legs par bsdus pa'i yo byad nor/ /rang nyid kyis ni longs spyad de/ /slob ma rnams la mi bgo'o5/ /dkyil 'khor gyis ni thabs thams cad/ /slob dpon nyid la sbyar bar bya/ /gal te dam tshig can gyis 6 ni / /slob ma la ni nye bar sbyar / /7de ltar bdag gis legs par sbyar ba 'di rnams kyang rang gi rtog pa sna tshogs 'brel med cing lung dang mi ldan par bsdebs pa ni ma yin te/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i le'u gnyis pa las/ gang gis slob ma dbang bskur ba/ /de nyid bzhi rnams bcas pas so/ /theg pa chen por yongs smin la/ /phyi nas sngags ni rab bstan bya/ /sngon du phag 72—189

mo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bri bya de nas te ru ka'i'o/ /rdo rje'i bu mo'am de nas gzhan—/ /der ni shes rab gzhug par bya/ /rgyud gzhan du ni dbang bskur la—/ /tshul 'di bstan par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar ma sbyar te/ 'di gzhan tshopas che ba nyid kyi phyir dang / 'di nyid kyis thams cad la khusbyar bar bya ba'i phyir ro/ /chen po sngon du brjod pa ni bstan bcos las kyang rig pa nyid do/ /dbang bskur ba'i le'u nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa las kyang / dbang bskur ba ni sbyin bya ba/ /rang slob ma la phyi dang gsang / /rgyal po rkun mo sogs spangs pa'i/ /skye bo dang bral phyogs su bya/ /'dir ni cho ga'i skyon mang pos/ /mnar med sogs su ldung bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di ni mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /slob dpon chen po rgyal ba bzang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang tshul mthun par bdag gi bla ma bzhed do/ /de bas na bdag gis rang dgar zhugs pa ma yin no/ /skye bo rnams ni tshe dang shes rab longs spyod mos pa dang ni brtson pa'ang dman/ /de phyir rgya chen rgyud la blta ba'ang med na nyan dang legs par spyod pa cir smra yod/ /de nas rang gi tshul gzhan chom 'dres rgyud chen 'di yi cho ga bla mas nyer bstan gang / /nub par gyur pa'i 'jigs pas rang gi dran pa so mas bsdebs na sa legs par 'gyur sems nas/ /rang bzo ma byas rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung dang bla ma'i bka' rnams dpang por gzhag 5byas nas/ /ji ltar nus pas sbyar ba 'di la 'khrul par gyur na bla ma rnams kyis bzod par mdzod/ /'di las byung ba'i dge ba dri med zla ba'i 'od zer ltar bsil bas/ /'gro ba shes 12—/90
