gsum khrus bcud rlung dang 'khor lo bskor/ /rtsa ba drug la yan lag so dgu nad la sman dpyad bar chad srung tsho'akhor gnad bral gags 2bsal to/ /sa la sogs pa'i ro bzhi ngos gzung rdo'akhor lo bzhi yis ro bzhi bsnyams la zhi gnas phyogs la ni/ /thabs dang ldan pas pi wang sgra sogs rtsa rlung la ni shes rab sku gsum mthun sprur sdas sogs lnga/ /zin dang ma zin legs par shes nas lus kyi gnad la nyi ma zla sogs basprus nas rdul sprugs byed/ /'byung bzhi'i rlung la lte ba la sogs stong ra bcas nas na tsha bogs 'don gsal 4'khyems la sogs bsal / /bcu pa'i rlung shes ting 'dzin rang grol sman pa lta bus brgyad po bsal nas rdul chu ltar spyad bya/ /dngas ma bsgrubs na skyon rnams sel phyir bdag lta'i bud shing bsregs nas 'od gsal chos skur bkral/ /'di don rim brgyud bla ma la brten gus pas blang phyir byin rlabs lam khyer snyan nas snyan du brgyud / /mchog gi blo can brtse ba chen pos theg gzhan spangs la smin dang grol ba rim pa gnyis la 'bad/ /snod bcud la sogs gzhal yas khang dang phung po khams sogs lha ru dag pas rgyal ba thams cad basbu/ /rdo rje lus la bde chen gnas pa pho nya la sogs spros dang spros med 'khor lo zung du 'jug /rim pa 'di la mos pa brtan pas sprul pa mthong zhing skyon yon dang bcas chung ngu 5phyir tshogs pa6/ /skad cig bzhi yis dga' ba gsum son 'bring po'i drod de lhan cig skyes paju tī'i lam zhugs nas/ /'jig rten las 'das brgya phrag bdun po yon tan kyis spras gnas dang nye gnas nyi shu bzhi sogs la/ /dngas ma yas byon pukhra sogs khyab rgyu ba mas brten / bde chen brtol nas ma chags pad+ma'i sa/ /rab bkram chen po phrag bdun yon tan ye shes gsal byed chos 12—261

sku'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur// //'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rdzogs la sogs gting dpag dka' ba gsal por rab phye snyan brgyud lha/mkha' 'gro'i gsang / /dri med bsags pa'i dge ba des ni sa gsum gnas pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par shog /yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang tshig rdzogs so// //rtsibs kyi rgya mdud dang bcas pa mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyis pu la ha rir bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/255 hūṃmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉stabam pa'i man ngag zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 / —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ci —/ ce〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉phyung / zhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7dri/ 6〈〈pe 〉ra 〈〈snar 〉staX/ 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉tha mas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga rgyud/ 97〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gin da/ 7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra na/256 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sham/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sten/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoraphro/ 4〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snga sa nyan par bgyis/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rigs/ zhwa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga / )〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra kur/ rnyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngo la/ tsusna/〈〈snar 〉zas—/ bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉du 'jug pa/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉〉rgya/257 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgom/ 2 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasag — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabad nyid mi shes pa/258 lha〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dbyeng / snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tsā/ rka 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kug cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasrung /259 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉(/ 2〈〈snar 〉ra zhi/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stananyid/26༷ te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ribadun/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa skur/ snye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga nga / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga cad/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skoraphrin/ ṭ+wāṃ〈〈pe 〉〉steg rnam pa/ 〈〈snar 〉ra sreg rnam pa/261 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra srung / 2〈〈snar 〉dgegs/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra zung / 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagags/5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉7yin/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7pa/ dza〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉dhu/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉༄ li/12—262
⑨〈〈snar 〉thartan/262 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉spyad/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (356)12wa 263

༄ga /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/kye༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra sasba ra maṇ+ḍa la sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mgon po dpa' bo kun bdag nyid/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun bdag nyid de/ /'khor lo dga' ba bzhi ru grags/ /skad cig bsnyen sogs ngo bo nyid/ /mi phyed nam mkha' dang mtshungs pa/ /zhal bzhi g.yas brkyang ba yis bzhugs/ /sa dang pha rol phyin dag pas/ /phyag dang phyag mtshan 'chang ba'i mchog /de bzhin shes dang shes dag pas/ /thod dang mgo bo zla phyed 'chang / /mi bskyod pa dang drag po'i 'od/ /gar gyi ro dgu'i nyams dang ldan/ /sred dang zhe sdang rnam dag pas/ /'jigs byed u ma'i steng na bzhugs/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo'i 'dren pa la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i lte ba na/ /bde ba che la rnam 12—264

rol pa/ /yang dag ting 'dzin rnam dag pas/ /dpal ldan bde mchog la phyag 'tshal/ /mgon por yang dag 'khyud bzhugs pa/ /zhal gcig ma la cher dmar ba/ /gri gug thod ldan bde rang bzhin/ /rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal—/ /de mdun zhi ba dga' ba dang / /lus dran nye bar gzhag ngo bo/ /sku mdog nag mo gri thod mtshan/ /ror gnas mkha' 'gro mar phyag 'tshal/ /g.yon du rgyas dang mchog dga' dang / /tshor ba dran pa nyer gzhag rim/ /sku mdog ljang mo gri thod mtshan/ /ror gnas khā ma la phyag 'tshal/ /nub tu dga' bral dga' ba dang / /dbang dang sems dran nyer gzhag bzhugs/ /sku mdog dmar po gri thod mtshan/ /ror gnas dum skyes mar phyag 'tshal/ /g.yas su 'gugs dang lhan cig skyes/ /chos dran nye bar gzhag pas bzhugs/ /sgu mdog ser mo gri thod 'chang / /ror gnas gzugs can la phyag 'tshal/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs pa/ /phyag rgya lnga yis 1rnam par brgyan/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal dang mtshungs/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs bdag phyag 'tshal—/ /pukhra 'dun 2dang mgo bo dang / /so dang sen mo rnam dag pas/ /thugs kyi 'khor lor thod dum dang / /rab gtum nag mo la phyag 'tshal/ /dzā larnya ra brtson 'grus spyi/ /skra dang spu ni rnam dag pas/ /keng rus kyis 'khyud sku mdog sngo/ /gtum mig ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /u rgyan dang ni dpyod pa dang / /rna ba g.yas dang pags pa dri/ /keng rus chen po dang lhan cig /'od ldan ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ar bu dā dang sems ltag pa/ /sha yi khams ni rnam dag pas/ /mche ba rnam par gcigs spyor ba'i/ /sna chen ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /go dā ba ri rna g.yon dang / /rtsa rgyus dang dbang bdag 12—265

nyid de/ /lha dgra dang bcas mkha' 'gro ma/ /dpa' bo'i blo ma la phyag 'tshal//rā me shwa ra (rus pa dang / /smin dbus brtson 'grus dbang po dag /'od dpag med la yang dag 'khyud/ /lha mo mi'u thung la phyag 'tshal/ /de bī ṭ+wā ko ṭi mchin pa dang / /mig dang dran pa rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje'i 'od kyis yang dag 'khyud/ /lang ka'i dbang phyug mar phyag 'tshal/ /mā la ba 1dang phrag pa snying / /ting 'dzin dbang po rnam dag pa/ /lha mo rdo rje'i skur sbyor ba/ /shing grib ma la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /kā ma rū dang mchan khung dang / /mig dang shes rab dbang bdag nyid/ /gsung 'khor dmar por 3myu gu can/ /sa srung dem la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o ṭi nu gnyis mkhris pa dang / /dad pa'i stobs ni rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje ral pa can gyis 'khyud/ /'jigs byed chen mo la phyag 'tshal/ /tri sha ku ne+e lte ba'i gnas/ /glo ba brtson 'grus rnam dag pa / /dpa' bo chen pos yang dag 'khyud/ /rlung shugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo6 //ko sa la dang sna rtse dang / /dran dang rgyu ma rnam dag pa/ /rdo rje hūṃ mdzad kyis 'khyud pa/ /chang 'thung ) ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ka ling ga dang kha'i phyogs dang / /gnye ma dang ni ting 'dzin stobs/ /rab tu bzang dang snyoms 'jug pa / /sngo bsangs lha mo la phyag 'tshal/ /lam bā ka dang mgrin gnas dang / /grod pa dang ni shes rab stobs/ /rdo rje bzang gis 'khyud bzhugs ma/ /shin tu bzang mo la phyag 'tshal/ /kāñtsi dang ni snying phyogs gnas/ /bshang dang ting 'dzin yan lag dang / /'jigs byed chen pos yang dag 'khyud/ /rta rna ma la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / ṭī ma la ya mdoms bar dang / /brtson 'grus mtshan rtse rnam dag pa/ /mig mi bzang ldan mkha' 'go ma/ /bya gdong ma la 72—266

phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku yi 'khor lor pre ta puratshosna/ /dkar mo bad kan mtshan ma dang / /dga' ba rnam dag 'khor shugs ma/ /stobs chen ldan la phyag 'tshal lo / /kṛ ha de ba bshang lam dang / /rnag dang chos rnams 'byed bdag nyid/ /rin chen rdo rjes yang dag 'khyud/ /dum skyes ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa brla gnyis gnas/ /khrag dang dran pa rnam dag pa/ /rta mgrin dang ldan mkha' 'gro ma/ /chang 'tshong ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /su waṇ+ḍi dī pa 37byin par gnas—/ /rdul dang btang snyoms yan lag dang / /nam mkha'i snying por 'khyud mdzad ma/ /'khor lo'i go cha mar phyag 'tshal/ /nā — gar sor mo tshil dang ni/ /shin tu sbyangs pa rnam dag pa/ /te ru ka dpal stoms 'jug pa/ /shin tu dpa' mo la phyag 'tshal/ /sin dhu rkang pa'i bol dang ni/ /yang dag lta dang mchi ma sbyangs/ /pad+ma gar dbang phyug dang ldan/ /stobs chen ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma ro mthe bong steng dang ni/ /yang dag rtog pa mchil ma dag /rnam snang mdzad dang snyoms 'jug pa/ /'khor los 4sgyur ma la phyag 'tshal / /ku lu tā dang pus mor gnas/ /snabs dang yang dag ngag dag pa//rdo rje sems dpa' snyoms 'jug pa/ /brtson chen ma la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /nyi dkyil spros 5med la gnas pa/ /g.yon pa la sogs go rims kyis/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa 'chang / /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /spyan gsum lhan cig skyes dga' bas/ /thugs ni yang dag mnyes mdzad pa/ /thugs gsung sku yi mkha' 'gro ma/ /gnag dang dmar dkar la phyag 'tshal/ /shar sgor nyi ma la gnas pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma mtshungs 'od mnga' ma/ /khro mo gri gug thod pa 'chang / /khwa gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yon sgor nyi ma la 12—267

bzhugs pa/ /lā ma dang 'dra'i 'od mnga' ma/ /khro mo gri gug thod pa 'chang //'ug gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nub sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ /dum skyes ma yi 'od 'dra ma/ /khro mo gri gug thod pa 'chang / /khye gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho sgor nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ /gzugs can 'dra ba'i 'od mnga' ma—/ /khro mo gri gug thod pa 'chang / /phag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag las dang yang dag 'tsho/ /rtsol dang dran pa yang dag ldan/ /sgo skyong ma ni bzhi po la/ /de goms thob phyir bdag phyag 'tshal/ /shar lho yi ni mtshams bzhugs pa/ /gnag dang ser ba'i 'od mnga' ba/ /drag mo gri gug thod pa 'chang / /gshin rje brtan mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /lho dang nub kyi mtshams bzhugs pa/ /ser dang dmar ba'i 'od mnga' ba/ /drag mo gri gug thod pa 'chang / /gshin rje pho nya mo la 'dud/ /nub dang byang gi mtshams bzhugs pa/ /dmar dang ljang ba'i 'od mnga' ba/ /drag mo gri gug thod pa 'chang / /gshin rje mche ba mar phyag 'tshal/ /byang dang shar kyi mtshams bzhugs pa/ /ljang dang gnag pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ /drag mo gri gug thod pa 'chang / /gshin rje 'joms ma la phyag 'tshal/ /ma skyes pa dang skyes pa dang //spyig pa mi bskyed 'joms pa'i phyir/ /de bzhin dge ba bskyed pa dang / /de bzhin gnas dang spel ba byed/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag pa'i phyir/ /'bad dang rtsol ba rab mdzad pa'i/ /'jig rten chos rnams rnam mnyam phyir/ /sgo skyong rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /lus dang ngag dang yid dag pa'i/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis 7rnam par brgyan/ /ma lus mkha' 'gro'i 'khor lo la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang / /72—268

bde ba chen po rnam dag pa/ /sgrib pa'i dri sogs dag pa'i sems/ /gang de yang dag rnam par gnas/ /ye shes 'khor lo thugs 'khor lo/ /gsung dang sku yi 'khor lo dang / /de bzhin dam tshig 'khor lo la/ /gnas kun bdag nyid phyag 'tshal lo/ /nga rgyal zhe sdang 'dod chags che/ /gti mug phrag dog rnam dag pa/ /rin chen mi bskyod rta mgrin dang / /rtag pa brtag 1bdag rim pa yis/ /rnam shes ye shes rnam dag pa/ /dam tshig che dang 'byung bar grags / /phung po khams kyi ngo bo nyid/ /'khor lo lnga po la phyag 'tshal/ /mkha' spyod dang ni sa spyod dang / /de bzhin sa 'og gnas pa dang / /kun rdzob dang ni don dam dag /'khor lo lnga la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /thim dang longs spyod bdag po yi2/ /gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /skye dang 'jig dang gnas pa dang / /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa ste/ /'dis ni khams gsum thams cad la/ /sngags dang dbyings dang chos dag gis/ /rtag tu khyab nas yang dag gnas/ /bde mchog dpal tshogs phyag 'tshal nas/ /dpal ldan bde mchog ces bya ba'i/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bstod byas pas/ /bsod nams gang thob de yis ni/ /'gro rnams de yi rang bzhin shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta shā ram̐ ka la shas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ / zhus chen gyi lo tsā 4ba bsod nams bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //72—269

bsdur mchan/264 humatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉torakhor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so//265 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bdun/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lhag266 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉re/ ge〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stab/ du/〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pe/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sungs/ ༅〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bdag phyag 'tshal/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thung / ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nyate mā la ya 'doms par/267 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsur/ rgya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉wapa/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ bya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉tha/ ⑤〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉srog268 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nya)/269 97〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉/ kyi〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ rgya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉tor/ bya)〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉lotsā/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (357)12wa 270

༄ / /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'gor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa jes bya ba/khyesngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra sadza ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra de ba ga ṇa sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mo 'khor lo dang ldan pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo dang / /dag pa'i chos kyi dri med pa'i4/ /khrag 'thung mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi dpal/ /rnam par snang mdzad rigs las byung / /sum cu rtsa bdun yang dag spro/ /rdo rje phag mor 5phyag 'tshal lo/ /lus dang sems dang chos dang tshor6/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i dngos/ /mkha' 'gro khā ma dum skyes ma/ /gzugs can ma la phyag 'tshal bstod7/ /pad+ma'i dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das/ /phyogs kyi 'dab mar lha 8mo bzhi/ /mtshams kyi dag ni snod bzhi po/ /zhal bzhi dag la phyag 'tshal bstod9/ /sen mo so la thod dum 12—271

gnas—/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul rkang 'du 1byed/ /rab gtum mo ni mgo la gnas / /pukhra ra mar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /keng rus chen mo greyang dag bzhugs / /gtum mig ma ni skra dang spu/ /brtson 'grus rdzu 'phrul spyi gtsug la / /dzā lan+ta rar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dpa' mo pags pa dri ma dang / /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul keng rus can/ /'od ldan ma ni rna g.yas gnas/ /o ḍi ya nar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ar bu da ni rgyab tshigs la/ /sna chen ma ni rnal 'byor ma/ /sha la mche gcigs sems rdzu 'phrul/ /bde ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo rtsa dang rgyus pa la/ /dad pa'i dbang po dpa' bo la / /rna ba dag ni g.yon pa la/ /nye ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /brtson 'grus dbang po nye ba'i gnas/ /'od dpag med ni rus pa la/ /mi'u thung ma ni smin ma'i dbus/ /mar me ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchin pa la ni dran dbang po/ /lang ka'i dbang phyug rdo rje'i 'od/ /de bī ko ṭi mig gnyis la / /nye ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting 'dzin dbang po shing grib ma/ /phrag pa la ni nye ba'i gnas/ /snying ga la ni rdo rje sku/ /mā la bar ni phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i gnas 'di dag /mkha' la spyod pa 4rnam dag pa/ /phyogs dang mtshams su nag por bzhugs5/ /de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes rab dbang po sa srung 6ma/ /mchan khung la ni gnas pa ste/ /myu gu can ni mig la gnas/ / ka ma rū 7par phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed che/ /nu ma la ni gnas pa ste/ /mkhris pa rdo rje ral pa can / /o ṭir zhing la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtson 'grus stobs ni rlung shugs ma / /lte ba la ni gnas pa ste/ /glo ba la ni dpa' bo che/ /tri sha ku ne+er 72—272

phyag 'tshal lo/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung ma/ /sna rtse la ni rab tu gnas / /rgyu ma rdo rje hūṃ mdzad de/ /ko sar nye zhing phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting 'dzin stobs ni sngo bsangs ma/ /ts+tshasdo rmyeha ni kha la bzhugs/ /gnye ma la ni rab tu bzang / /ka ling ga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin du bzang mo shes rab stobs / /ts+tshasdo 3ha ni mgrin pa'i dbus/ /grod pa la ni rdo rje bzang / /lam bā ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ting 'dzin yan lag rta rna ma/ /kāñtsir snying la gnas pa ste/ /bshang ba la ni 'jigs byed che/ /nye ts+tshasdo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /hi mā la yar mtshan ma'i rtse/ /brtson 'grus yang dag bya gdong ma/ /gsang ba'i sbubs la mig mi bzang / /nye ts+tshasdo 4la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i gnas 'di dag /sa la spyod pa rnam dag pa5/ /kha dog dmar po phyogs mtshams na/ /yang dag bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pre ta mtshan ma 'khor lo shugs/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub lam/ /bad kan la ni stobs po che/ /'du ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kṛ 6ha bshang lam dum skyes bzhugs//shin tu sbyangs pa byang chub lam/ /rnag la rin chen rdo rje ste/ /'du ba can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sau rāṣ+ṭa brla gnyis la/ /nye bar gnas pa'i 'du can du/ /chos rab 'byed pa chang 'tshong ma/ /rta mgrin khrag la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gser gling dag ni byin pa la/ /dran pa 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /rdul ni nam mkha'i snying po ste/ /nye ba'i 'du la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin du dpa' mos legs par 'khyud/ /btang snyoms yang dag sor mo la/ /tshil ni he ru ka dpal te/ /dur khrod grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sisnu rkang pa'i bol la ni/ /yang dag lta ba stobs chen ma/ / mchi ma 7pad+ma gar dbang phyug /dur khrod 12—273

grags la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchil ma dpa' bo rnam snang mdzad/ /'khor los 2sgyur ba yang dag rtog /mthe bong gnyis la nye dur khrod/ /ma nor gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ku lu tar zheni yang dag ngag /brtson chen ma ni pus mo la/ /snabs la rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /nye dur khrod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di ni sku yi 'khor lo ste/ /sa 'og spyod par gnas pa yin/ /phyogs dang mtshams na dkar por gnas/ /de la rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag las dang 'tsho ba dang / /yang dag rtsol ba dran pa dag /khwa dang 'ug pa khyi dang phag /sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag spong 1bzhi rnam dag pa/ /gshin rje brtan ma pho nya mo/ /gshin rje mche ma gshin rje 'joms/ /mtshams ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsam gtan dkyil 'khor bsrung don du/ /'di brgyad kyis ni bgegs spangs so/ /bde mchog 'khor lor bstod pa yicho/ /dge bas bdud bzhi'i dgra bcom ste/ /lha tshogs lha mor 5/khrir gyur nas/ /bsam tshogs stobs mkhas ldan gyur cig /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa zhes bya ba kha che'i mkhas pa chen po bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// //6 12—274

༄ / /dpal 'gor lo sdom pa la bstod pa/1 ༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra sasbra ra sto tra2/ bod skad du/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la bstod pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun rtog spros bral dri ma rnam dag cing / /mtsho ltar bde ba chen por ro gcig pa/ /nam mkha'i ngang du sprin dkar dag pa bzhin/ /rang bzhin rnam dag chos rnams mngon gyur te/ /ji ltar mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin/ /gnyis med bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /yid bzhin nor bu rtog med ji bzhin du/ /gdul bya mchog la sprul sgu khro bo'i tshul/ /dpa' bo 'jigs byed gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan/ /sku yi rang bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad ni/ /sgeg dang dpa' dang 'jigs su rung ba'i tshul/ /gsung gi rang bzhin yan lag drug cu ni/ /bzhad dang gshe dang rngam pa'i tshul du bstan / /thugs kyi rang bzhin gzugs dang ting nge 'dzin/ /zhi ba sems 12—276

dpa' rmad du byung ba'i tshul/ /dbang phyug chen po'i sgeg pa'i nyams bcom nas/ /gnyis med yum la 'khyud nas 'gying bag bzhugs/ /gzhon nu gdong drug dpa' ba'i nyams bcom nas/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan g.yas brgyang kyizhabs kyis mnan/ /khyab 'jug zhal gsum 'jigs pa'i nyams bcom nas/ /zhal bzhi mnga' zhing bcu gnyis phyag dang ldan/ /lha chen tshangs pa rgod pa'i nyams bcom nas/ /g.yas pa ser po bzhed 2pa'i tshul du bstan/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i gshe ba'i nyams bcom nas/ /glang chen pags pas rgyan byas mche ba gcigs/ /sgra gcan lha min nyi zla khar bcug nas/ /rngam pa'i nyams bcom tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams/ /brgya byin spyan mangs zhi ba'i nyams bcom nas / /sgu la spyan gsum gzi brjid ldan pa po/ /me lha tshangs pa zhi ba'i nyams bcom nas/ /thal ba'i tshom bus sku la brgyan pa po/ /klu chen se sha rmad byung nyams bcom nas/ /mi mgo lnga bcu gcig gis do shal byas/ /sgu gsung thugs la sdug bsngal gsum nub pas/ /thams cad bde ba chen por thugs su chud/ /yang dag ting 'dzin rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das/ /'khor lo'i dbus na g.yas brkyang spyor bas bzhugs/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing gar bstan/ /thabs kyi tshul gyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /thugs rje mchog gyur de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi yum gyur rdo rje phag mo ni/ /sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /bdud bzhi bcom nas bde chen thugs chud ma/ /gnyis med yum gyur de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi sogs las mdzad ye shes bzhi yi sku/ /tshad med bzhi dang phyag rgya bzhi ldan ma/ /phyogs bzhi pad+ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro yum bzhi mo la phyag 12—277

'tshal lo/ /rtag pa la sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi/ /bum pa bzhi dang bdud rtsis bkang 1ba'i snod/ /mtshams bzhir mchod pa'i gzugs kyis gnas pa yi/ /thabs shes dbyer med de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems ni skye ba med par thugs chud cing / /mi bskyod rigs su sku mdog mthing gar bstan/ /rnam thar brgyad rtsibs thugs rtags rdo rjes brgyan/ /mkha' spyod yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung ni sgra brnyan snyelta bur thugs chud cing / /'od dpag med rigs sgu mdog dmar por bstan/ /rnam thar brgyad rtsibs gsung rtags pad+mas brgyan/ /sa spyod yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku ni sgyu ma lta bur thugs chud cing / /rnam dag rigs su sgu mdog dkar por bstan / /rnam thar brgyad rtsibs sku rtags 'khor los brgyan/ /sa 'og yab yum rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje brtan sogs khro mo chen mo brgyad/ /mi'am ci sogs gdul phyir tha dad bzhugs/ /khwa gdong la sogs lha mo brgyad po rnams/ /dam tshig 'khor lor bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen las grub dpag med gzhal yas khang / /byang chub mchog gi chos rnams yongs rdzogs pa/ /gtso bo bde chen thugs kyi snang ba ni/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang lha mo'i tshogs kyis mdzes/ /chos rnams tshad med dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor/ /rnam par gzigs shing tha dad gdong du bstan/ /nyan thos rang rgyal 'khor los 4sgyur sogs brgyad/ /phyogs rnams skyong zhing klu dang srin po'i gzugs/ /thugs rjes nyon mongs bsreg 5mdzad 'bar ba'i phreng / /rnam snang rang bzhin thar pa'i grong khyer mchog /bde chen bzhugs gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la bstod pa kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bram 72—278

༄ / /dpal 'gor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa bzhugs so//1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shri tsakra saṃ pa ra stod 2tra/ bod skad du/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bstod pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos nyid dbyings las bzhengs pa'i sku mchog na / /skal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i k+kong dkyil na/ /ri rab chu skyes nyi zla'i gdan steng du/ /'jigs byed dus mtshan brgyad bkug zhabs kyis mnan/ /sku mdog mthing nag mkha' ltar dag pa'i 'od/ /gcer bu glang chen stag gi sham thabs can/ /zhal gdangs mche gcigs hūṃ gis 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /4khro gnyer spyan gsum glog ltar 'gyu/ /ral pa'i thor cog zla phyed rdo rje dang / /thod pa nor bu mi skyod dar gyis mdzes//dpa' bo bsgeg 5pa rab du 'jigs byed cing / /rgod dang gshe dang rngam pa'i ngang tshul can/ /snying rje zhi dang rmad du byung ba'i nyams/ /gar gyi rnam 'phrul nam mkha' khyab par ston/ /'khor lo rna cha mgul rgyan gdub kor dang //12—280

ske rags thal chen tshangs pa'i skud pa can/ /mi mgo'i do shal rdo rje dril bu 'khyud—/ /dpal ldan te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnyis med tshul gyis bcom ldan 'das ma yang / /sku mdog dmar mo gcer bu skra grol zhing / /phyag rgya lnga dang rdo rje thod pa 'khyud/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rang bzhin la—/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i rigs rnams yongs su rdzogs/ /srid pa rnam dag sku yi yan lag la/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi yul gyi rnam par brgyan/ /khyod ni khams kyi rang bzhin dpa' bo dang / /rtsa yi rang bzhin dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi/ /bye ba'i grangs snyed ma lus 'khor bcas kun/ /gnas dang nye gnas zhing dang nye zhing sogs / /sa bcu'i gnas su gnyis med dgyes par rol/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs la rnam rol zhing / /rnam dag skye mched las kyang 'khor lo bzhi/ /lus kyi rnam dag rang bzhin gzhal yas khang / /rnam shes brgyad las sprul pa'i dur khrod brgyad/ /dngos dang dngos min rang bzhin bcom ldan 'das/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso/ /ma lus gcig tu 'dus pa'i sgur gyur pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod kyi 'od zer glog tsam mthong ba las/ /ngo mtshar 'dzin pa'i yid kyis bdag bstod na/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /mgon po khyod kyi thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /dam tshig brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis bu bzhin dgongs nas kyang / /bar chad bdud dpung zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /dur khrod la sogs gnas su srog dor nas/ /khyod kyi rnal 'byor rtag tu brtson pa la/ /ye shes yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba dang / /dngos grub tshul bzhin grub par mdzad du gsol/ /sangs rgyas phrin las byed 12—28/

sgo༄ga /dpal 'gor lo bde mchog gi rgyun bshags rgyas pa ba4/gas so//—1 —༄go/ /dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa gdul5 / /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang te ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med dbang phyug sku dang gnyis med cing / /bde chen 5'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas la sogs sprin 'phro ba/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku/ /'khor 'das stong par mdzad pa'i thugs rje yis/ /gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha' lta bur thams cad thogs med cing / /ngardod dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul lus dang ldan/ /thugs dam dbang she /ra/ sgrub 4la brtser dgongs pa/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs rnam dag ye 12—283

shes sku brnyes pa/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo ma lus gcod pa'i phyir/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa/ /rgyal gnyis rdo rje'i zhabs la dad pas 'dud/ /lha mi'i longs spyod phun tshogs thams cad dang / /kun du bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po dang / /gsang dang gsang rab gsang chen bla med kyi/ /mchod pa'i sprin chen rgya mtsho dag gis mchod/ /bdag gi ṭ+wā/lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang / /chags dang zhe sdang rnam par rmongs sems kyis//srid pa nyam na/ngar sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ / da nas da sdig pa thams cad rab tu bshags / /rdzogs sangs rgyas mgon byang chub sems dpa' mchog /'phags pa rnams kyis dge ba gang bgyis pa/ /de dag bla med byang chub 'bras thob par/ /ma lus pa la rtag tu rjes yi rang / /rdzogs sangs rin chen rang gi sems gnas dang / /rtog pa'i dra ba rab dral dam pa'i chos/ /sa dbang tshogs dang brtul zhugs dge 'dun la/ /rab tu dad pas bdag ni skyabs su mchi / /rgyal dang rgyal nyid legs skyes de dag la/ /kun nas kun du bdag nyid bdag gis dbul/ /sems dpa' mchog gis bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /dad pas bdag nyid spyod kyi 'bangs su mchi/ /glo bur nyon mongs tshogs kyis gdung ba —yis/ /bskyod pa'i skye bo mtha' dag bsgral bya'i phyir/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i sngags rnams bshad pa ru/ /sman mchog mgon po la ni bdag gsol lo/ /mchog tu mi dge ba ni rab bcom pas/ /bdud kyi skye rga na dang 'chi las grol/ /mya ngan 'da' bzhed gyur pa spang bar ni/ /sman mchog mgon po la ni bdag gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten gang byung la/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed ltar/ /di 72—284

ring nyid du sems bskyed do/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /de bzhin brtan por gzung bar bgyi①/ /ji ltar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis/ /sngon gyi bde gshegs grangs med la/ /thugs bskyed dam tshig dpag med dag /'tshang rgya bar du ma btang ltar/ /bdag ni deng nas byang chub bar/ /lus srog ltos pa med par yang / /bslab 'di mgon bzhin bsrung la gnas/ /ye shes thugs kyis dgongs su gsol/ /rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pa/ /rtag tu brten zhing ku spyad par bya/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo / /sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje dag /rtag tu mi phyed brtul zhugs bzung snye/ /rgyal bas dgongs te gsungs pa yi/ /dam tshig bzhi po bsrung bar bkyi/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi sogs/ /rig sngags 'chang kun mi 'da' ltar/ /ding nas bla med byang chub bar/ /bdag gis tshul bzhin bsrung bar bgyi/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zla rer bcu phrag gnyis po dang / /bco lnga la ni rab tu mchod/ /jeg pa dman la 'dod mi bgyi/ /sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang mi spang zhing / /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la—/ /gus pas bsnyen bkur mchod par bgyi/ /bdag gis sems can thams cad la/ /brnyas pa nyid du mi bkyid doce/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'gong bar 5mi bgyi'o/ /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba sbu spyad pas/ /nam mkha'i mthas klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bdag nyid shog /12—285

skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /blo ldan rigs bzang nga rgyal med pa dang //snying rje che ldan bla ma la dad cing /ṣe /'khor lo bde mchog dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang / /zab cing rgya che'i chos ni rtogs pa dang / /kak+ko shu kra la sogs rtag za zhing / /mthar thug theg chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /ding tsho)nas byang chub snying por mchis bar du/ /bcom ldan bde gshegs kun du bzang po dang / /gsang ba'i theg pa dbyer med rmad byung dang / /mi 'bral tshul bzhin rtag tu sgrub phustepar shog /sgrub mchog 'di la bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /tshe 'di la sogs skye ba bdun bar du/ /dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo chen po yi/ /zhabs rdul ze'u rngo /'bru spyi gtsug gnas par shog /gang tshe 'gro ba'i mgon la blta ba dang / /phyir zhing cung zad 'bring bar 'dod na yang / /bcom ldan bde gshegs thugs kyi bdag pos 1ni/ /thams cad sgrib med sa ler mthong bar shog /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa yi/ /sems can ma lus byang chub dgod pa'i phyir/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i spyod pa ji lta bar/ /bdag gi spyod pa'ang de dang 'dra bar shog /sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag bde dge bas de kun de thuthob shog /tshe rabs kun du sgo gsum rin chen dang / /bum bzang dpag bsam sa sogs lta bur shog /mgon po kun mkhyen thugs rje'i byin rlabs 4dang / /sgrub pa mchog la rtse gcig sbyangs pa yis/ /bde mchog mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub mchog thob nas/ /sems can thams cad smin pa'i mthur 8ldan shog /dbang dang mngon shes so sor rig pa dang / /gzungs dang rnam par thar pa'i sgo rtogs nas/ /nam mkha'i mthas pya/klas gyur pa'i 72—286

sems can rnams/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs bgrod par shog /tso bde gshegs spyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yis/ /dam bcas bsrung zhing dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /thugs dam bzhin du rtag bsrung dngos grub ni/ /rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la sprul bar shog /'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis/ /me tog rgyal mtshan gdugs spos rmyethogs nas kyang / /rol mo glu dang sgra snyan tshogs mchod nas/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid par shog /skad cig de la snang ba gsum thob nas/ /gsal dang rtags snang rang gi rigs rtogs te/ /dur khrod la sogs rgyal nyid sa thob nas/ /ts+tshasdo d+ngha la sogs sa la bgrod par shog /shin tu rnam par dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas rnam par grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun du bzang po kun gyi bdag po yi/ /sras kyi dbang po nyid du bdag gyur cig /sa gsum mthar phyin gsum phrag gsum gnas gyur/ /shes brgyad gyur pas ye shes lngar gyur te/ /ye shes chos kyi dbyings dang dbyer med pa'i/ /chos sku byang chub snying po thob par shog /chos dbyings las byung nam mkha'i mtshan nyid 'dra/ /thog ma dang ni tha ma med pa'i bdag /sems dpa' rdo rje thugs kyi bdag po ru/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du bdag gyur cig /dngos grub ma lus pa ni kun gyi bdag /dbang phyug chen po lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /stug po'i rgyan gyur ma lus kun gyi rgyal༄ / /mi 'gyur dam pa nyid du bdag gyur cig /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku mnyes zhepas/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes su rab chags la/ /'dod chags me kun rang bzhin rnam dag pas6/ /gsung gi dbang phyug nyid du bdag gyur cig /nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid lcun gyis grub/ /yon tan yid bzhin rgya 12—287

chen mkha' she'adra bas/ /gdul bya rdzogs sangs nyid du re skong ba/ /khyab bdag rdo rje nyi mar bdag gyur cig /phrag dog dag pas bya ba grub brnyes shing //phrin las rgya mtshos gdul bya dpag med rnams/ /grub mchog phyag rgya che la dgod shemadzad pa'i/ /bde gshegs gdon mi za bar bdag gyur cig /dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi bdag /dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo'i skur grub nas/ /nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /'khor 'das ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du shog/ //dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyun bshags rgyas pa slob dpon byu ri bas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /jo bo rje dang lo tsā bye ba rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/283 dzo7mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉rdzar bkod/ 37〈〈snar 〉thadul/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zochog cho〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgrub/284 3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/ 2〈〈snar 〉wāms/ sno 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉des na/ ④〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadungs pa/285 ṭ+wā〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sum̐s/ — 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasten cing / ཿ〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngazung / gye〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉bgyi'o—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaragom par/286 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉8nga / — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgrub/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ze/ zu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kudri/5〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ya/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mide/ rkye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ 8sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7thu/9sna〈〈snar 〉7tha'/287 rte〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ting 'dzin mang pos gdul bya'i rgyud mkhyen nas/ /thams cad mdun na sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni/ /sna tshogs nam mkha' khyab pa'i chos bstan pas/ /zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs bgrod par shog /12—288

༄khya/ /lam gyi rab tu bya ba bzhugs so//1 ༄4/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang sta gon gyi cho ga dang 2dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o / /bsnyen pa la dang po skabs 4dbye ba ni/ slob ma dad pa dang / shes rab dang ldan pas maṇ+ḍal byas te/ phyag gsum byas la me tog 5gsum dbul/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te thal mo sbyar bas/ slob dpon gyis bdag la bde mchog 'khor lo mngon par 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal por dbang bsgur ba stsal du gsol zhes lan gsum zhu/ 'o na bdag gis bsnyen pa bya'i6/ khyod kyis rdzas sogs shig ces gnang ba byin la/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyel pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i sngags su byin la srod tho rangs brgya rtsa zlos su gzhug go/ /de nas bdag nyid lū yi pa'i rnal 'byor ram/ dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom pa'am/mngal skyes kyi yang rung bas rdo rje dang do li yi bzlas pa bya/ thun bzhi'i rnal 72—290

'byor gyis spyir rtsa sngags 'bum phrag gcig gam/ yang na yab yum gyi snying po'am nye snying gang yang rung ba 'bum/ 'khor gyi lha la khri khri sum+bha ni 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa ni grangs kyi bsnyen pa'o/ /yang na mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa rmi lam du lhas dbang bskur la reg 5k+ṣeces gnang ba'am brdas kyang rung ngo / /dbang med na bzlas pa dum gcig byas la/ yid kyis lha mngon du dmigs te gnang bar bsams la byar rung ba ni bdag po'i bkas so/ /de'i tshe mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma re ma chags par gtang rngubar bya'o/ /de nas bskul ba'i phyir slob mas maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas snga ma ltar zhu ba yang bya'o/ /rdzas tshogs sam ma tshogs zhes dri'o/ /kha cig ni tshogs la kha cig ni ma tshogs zhes zhu'o/ /de nas sdig pa bsal ba dang bsrung bar bya ba ni/slob ma'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po bsams la yang de'i snying gar sdig pa shaṃ nag po las sha za'i gzugs rid pa rkang lag phra ba/ skra gyen du badze+es pa bsams la hūṃ gi sko'od kyis gyen du phul te sna bug g.yas nas byung ba dang / hūṃ de sgo mtshams kyi lha mo brgyad du gyur nas/ de rnams kyis gri gug gis bgos nas zos te/ yang hūṃ du song nas sna bug de nyid nas slar thim par bsam/ srung ba ni lag pa g.yon par ha byas pas/ rdo rje rgya gram bsams la de slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag pas cho/lus rdo rjer song bar bsam6/ sum+bha ni brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa rdo rje rgya gram yang de'i spyi bor gnas par bsam/ de nas de dag skad cig mas phyag gnyis pa'i te ru kar bsams la mchod pa dang gtor ma la sogs pa byas te/ mdun du slob ma'i gtso bo la sogs pas maṇ+ḍal byed pa sngon du 'gro 12—291

bas phyag byed du bcug la thal mo bskyed par bya ste/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bdag gis bskyed/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis 7mgron du gnyer / /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad pa yis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas snying ga dang / lkog ma dang / spyi bor dri'i thig le gsum byas la rdo rje reg pa sngon du 'gro bas hūṃ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod cing rim pa bzhin du pad+ma dang / 'khor lo dag la yi ge gsum po de nyid rim pa bzhin du mtshan pa 'og ma gnyis nyi ma la 'khor lo zla ba la bsam par bya'o / /de nas oṃ pu dzā 4oṃ a zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod pas yul nyer bzhir lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis choreg bzhin du yul de dang / de'i gnas rnams su mos par bya'o/ /de nas skyes pa la ni snying ga la sogs par oṃ ha la sogs pa bsam zhing bud med la ni lte ba la sogs par oṃ baṃ la sogs pas byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas de dag la mchod pa bya ste/me tog ni mgo zhwala'o/ /spos ni shangs la'o/ /mar me ni spyan la'o/ /dri ni thugs kar ro/ /zhal zas ni zhal du dmigs te'o/ /de yang oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūṃ zhes bya ba la sogs pas so/ /de nas tshems shing dor bar bya ste/ mdun du ba lang gi ko ba tsam du sa gzhi ba'i lci ba sar pas byugs la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa khyams gru bzhi'i nang du chud pa bris pa la me tog gi tshom bu dgu bkod nas—/ der slob ma shar ram byang du kha blta 7bas tshems shing ma yo ma gas pa/lo 'dab kyis kha brgyan pa can tsan+dan gyis byugs pa la/ me tog gi phreng ba 72—292

bcings la/ o badz+ra da na da kaṣ+ṭha bi ma la bi shusne swā hā/ zhes bya bas gtad pa / cho ga bzhin du lkubacas nas thal mo'i bar nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dor du gzhug go/ /'dir tshems shing gi mtshan ma brtag par bya ste/ shar du bltas na zhi ba'i dngos grub bo/ /byang du bltas na rgyas pa'o/ /nub tu bltas na dbang ngo / /lhor bltas na mngon spyod do/ /gyen du bltas na rig pa 'dzin pa lha'i dngos grub bo/ /thur du bltas na 'og gi dngos grub bo/ /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du song na dngos grub med do zhes brtag par bya'o/ /de nas ngag dag pa'i don du bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i dri'i chu la 'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma bzlas te/ de nas oṃ tweḥbi shudha dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa ā myu bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa a pa na ya hūṃ zhes brjod pas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khror bar lan gsum blud par bya'o/ /de nas yi ge nyer gnyis pa'i sngags lan gsum bzlas pa'i ku sha sngas dang stan gyi phyir byin la/ rang rang gi mi gang dang lag tshad kyi sgud pa sum sgril byas la gsum pa gsum gyis mdud pa byas te/snying po'i sngags lan bdun bzlas la dpung par bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas chos bshad pas spro ba skyed par bya ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ /u dusmra ra'i me tog bzhin/ /brgya lam na yang 4res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung bzhin 5/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gis mtshungs med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du mar ni/ /sngon chad sdig pa gang byas pa/ /de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba/ /mthong bas kyang de byang 'gyur na/ /grags pa mtha' yas gsang sngags kyi/ /tshul la spyod pa smos ci 12—293

dgos / /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur—/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu dri med pa/ /de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad/ /gang gis khyed rnams sras bcas pa'i/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bstan 'di la/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /gang gis ༷da rnams 'byung 'gyur bar ṭ+wāṃ/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba dag gis dam pa'i chos bsgrags pa byas nas/ sum+bha nis srung 5ba byas te/ tho rangs kyi rmi lam ci mthong ba kho bo la bos ri shig byas nas/dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i mthar seng ge'i nyal thabs kyis nyal du gzhug go/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs te/ bsrung ba'i don du sum+bha ni bzlas par bya'o zhes bya ba ni slob ma sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas bum pa sta gon du gnas pa brjod par bya ste/ re zhig bum pa bcu'am drug gam gnyis sam gcig kyang rung ste/ rtsa ba dang nag bo la sogs pa'i skyon med pa/ gser ram dngul lam kham pa la sogs pa'i rgyu las byas pa/kha dog dkar por bsgyur ba rigs kyi mtshan mas mtshan pa/ 'o ma can gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ rigs kyi sku mdog mthun pa'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/bste gnas kyi chu 'o ma can kyis bkang ba/ tsan+dan dang ga bur dang / gur gum chogla rtsi dang / hu lu ka ste dri lnga dang bcas pa/ bdud rtsi lnga dang rin po che lnga dang / 'bru lnga dang sman lngas gang ba'i snod steng du bzhag ste/ 'og tu pad+ma'i gdan steng du gdugs phub la/ dkyil 'khor du rim pa bzhin/72—294

sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /re re bzlas te bzhag la lhag par gnas par bya'o/ /re zhig bum pa bcu'i lugs la ni/ rnam par rgyal ba la gcig /pad+ma'i snod bzhi dang bcas pa'i yum bzhi la re re/ thugs dang gsung stisku dang dam tshig gi 'khor lo rnams la re re ste de ltar na dgu'o/ /las thams cad pa dang bcu'o/ /drug gi lugs la 'khor lo lnga la re re rnam par rgyal ba dang drug go/ /las thams cad pa dam tshig gi 'khor lor thubasdu'o/ /gnyis pa ni thabs dang shes rab kyi dbye bas so/ /las thams cad pa ni gtso bo la bsdu'o—/ /gcig gi lugs la ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha ma lus pa gcig tu bsdu zhing las thams cad pa yang der bsdus te/ de ni khyim pa dbang bskur ba la yin kyi/ dge tshul yan chad la ma yin no/ /gcig gis ma yin par rgyud las bkag pa'i phyir ro/ /rtsa ba ni dbyibs kyi skyon no/ /nag po ni kha dog gi skyon te de dag med pa'o/ /tshad kyang mchur sor nyer gcig /zheng du bcu drug gce'u med pa'o/ /mgrin pa la sor drug go/ /mchu la sor brgyad do/ /mgrin pa'i spubs la sor gnyis so/ /mngon spyod la sogs pa'i phrin las gzhan la ni tshad gzhan dang gzhan du brjod do/ /dkar por bsgyur ba ni rang bzhin kyis kha dog dkar po med pa la'o/ /rigs kyi mtshan ma rnam par rgyal ba la ni chos 'byung gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar ka pā la'i nang du chud pa'i rdo rje dang rdo rje gri gug go/ /rigs kyi yum bzhi la ni gri gug dang ka pā la'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo la rdo rje dang gri gug go/ /gsung gi 'khor lo la pad+ma dang gri gug go/ /sku'i 'khor lo la 'khor lo dang gri gug go/ /dam tshig gi 'khor lo la ka pā la dang gri gug go/ /las thams cad pa la ni sna tshogs rdo rje dang gri 12—295

gug go/ /'o ma can gyi shing ni tsu 2༄ta la sogs pa'o/ /rin po che sna lnga ni gser dang dngul dang mu men dang mu tig dang bye ru'o/ /nas dang gro dang til dang 'bras so ba dang / ma sha ste 'bru lnga'o/ /thra gehaste dang / kaṇ+ḍa ka ri dang / a pa rā dzi ta dang / daṇ+ḍit+pa la dang / ha sa de ba ste sman lnga'o/ /pad+ma dang gdugs ni shog bu las rngo byas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor ni ser po 'ba' zhig las byas pa'o/ /de yang lha dang phyag mtshan med pa'i gdan cigazhal yas khang pa'i thurnam pa 'ba' zhig bri'o/ /gal te nus pa med na sngar gyi tshems shing dor ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa lta bu bya'o/ /de nas bum pa lhag par gnas pa bya ste/ me tog la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dzo7dang / gtor ma rnams sta gon byas nas/ slob dpon bdag nyid ting nge 'dzin rdzogs par bsgoms la dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdus te/ phyag gnyis pa'i ting 'dzin gyis gnas par bya'o/ /de nas skad cig mas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum par ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par bsam mo/ /rigs kyi yum bzhi la ni yum re dang ka pā la re re'o/ /thugs dang gsung dang sgu dang dam tshig gi 'khor lo'o/ /de nas 'bar ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas rnam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs te bum pa'i lha rnams la bstim mo//de dag ma lus par zhu ba las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus gang bar bsam mo /de nas bum pa'i gnas lnga dag tu rdo rje'i phyag rgyas reg cing / oṃ badz+ra pad+ma a mṛ ta su bi shudha dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba sarba dharmā na su bi shudhe dharma dhā tu sarba na ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de nas me tog gi phreng ba dang 'brel ba'i rdo rje bum pa'i steng du bzhag ste lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis 12—296

bzung ste/ lag pa g.yas pas bgrang phreng snying gar bzung nas 'khor lo'i gtso bo la ni brgya bzlas shing / 'khor gyi lha rnams la ni nyer gcig bzla'o/ /las thams cad pa la ni sum+bha ni brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas phyi'i mchod pa lnga dang yid las byung ba'i lha mo bcu drug dang / rin po che sna bdun gyis kyang mchod de spos snod dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i lag pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'go ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyurakye/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /'gro ba'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtog pa'i 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing / /'jig rten don du rab 'jug pa/ /de snyed pa la rtag phyag 'tshal—/ /zhes bya bas bstod la/ yi ge brgya pa brjod de/ gtor ma byen gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas dpa' bo'i dga' ston dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo byin gyis brlab par bya'o zhes bya ba ni bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ dkyi'/ 'khor bsgrub par bya zhing ras ris la ni dkyil 'khor mngon du dmigs te/ bdag 'jug byas nas slob ma la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de la phyogs bzhir slob dpon bzhi'am bdag gasbug pu yang rung ste/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri chus khrus byas nas/gos dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs pa'i rgyan gyi chas su zhugs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs nas kha byang du bltas te/ stan mthon po la 'dug 3par bya'o/ /de nas yang snga ma ltar ting nge 'dzin rdzogs par bsgoms te/ phyag gnyis pa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas nas go rims bzhin du dbang bdun dang / dbang gsum pa dang / bzhi pa'i mthar thug pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las 12—297

blang bar bya'o/ /de ni bdag 'jug pa'o// //de nas slob ma gzhug pa ni/ yol ba'i phyi rol du maṇ+ḍal byed du bcug la phyag 3༄byas te/ me tog snyim par bzung nas gnas pa la/ slob dpon kyis nang nas bka' bsdam mo ②zhes brjod par bya'o/ /bde chen bdag ni skal ba bzang / /zhes bya ba ni slob ma'i lan no/ /de ltar lan gsum bya'o—/ /dgos pa ci'i phyir 'jug /phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyi phyir ro zhes slob ma'i lan no/ /de nas dung chos spyi bor bzhag ste/ khyor bar chu lan gsum blud la/ sum+bha ni bzlas pa'i ku sha'i chus bsang ba bya'o/ /de nas dbab pa'i cho ga bya ste/ mtshal chen bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas/ /dur khrod ras la byugs nas ni/ /bsdus pa'i phye ma cha gcig dang / /bye la nag po'i bshang ba ni/ /de mnyam cha ni gcig tu bya/ /de mnyam zhe gu gul nag por spyad ④/ /dur khrod sol ba blangs nas ni/ /mchod yon snod du bdug pa sbyar/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs par ni/ /slob ma'i lus la rab bkod de/ /de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'jug par bsam/ /slob ma'i lag nas bzung nas ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtse gcig sems kyis bzlas par bya/ /de la sku babs na ni 'phar ba la sogs pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul 'byung ngo / /gsung babs na ni dbang pos mi sod pa'i don rnams smra bar 'gyur ro/ /thugs babs na ni mngon par shes pa lnga la sogs pa'i yon tan 'byung ngo / /ye shes babs na ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ting 12—298

nge 'dzin la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dbab pa bsdus la/ lag pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ snying po'i sngags de nyid lan bdun bzlas pas srung tub bya'o—/ /de nas go bskon par bya'o/ /de nas sum+bha ni bzlas pa'i chus bsangs pa'i sna tshogs pa'i mdog gam kha dog ser po'i dar ras kyis gdong g.yogs bcings la stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs kyang sbyin no/ /de la gdong g.yogs bcing ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ dwa da sha saṃ ga ni ro dha ka ṛ ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas brtul zhugs dbog par bya ste/ 'gro ba bgrod pa rnams kyis gyebartul —zhugs sbyin bya de dag ni/ /srog gcod mi bden gzhan nor gzhan gye chung ma de bzhin chang gi btung ba spang 1 / /'khor ba byerdo rje zhags pas rang gi dge ba 'joms byed sdig pa lnga po 'di dag yin/ /gang dag gang gi dus byung sum cu mi yi bla ma de yi mtshan gyis rab tu sbyin bya ste/ /sna tshogs gtso bo srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad bka' 'di khyod kyis kyang ni bskyang bar bya/ /cho lo kha na ma tho'i zas dang brjod ngan 'byung po lha min dbang po'i chos ba lang bud med skyes rnams de bcu mi choyi bla ma lnga po la yang gnod mi bya/ /snying grogs la 'khu rje dpon de bzhin sum cu mi yi bla ma yid ches dge 'dun la'ang / /dbang po rnams kyi chags pa zhes byas mi treyi bdag po'i brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga yis—/ /de ltar brtul zhugs phog nas/ de nyid gsum lan bdun bzlas pa'i me tog gcig lag pa'i pad+ma'i dbus su gtad la shrī he ru ka ya bid ma te bit+yā rā dzā ya dhi ma te swā hā/ zhes bya bas nang du gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis lag pa nas bkri zhing / las kyi rdo rje phyi bzhin 'brang bas dkyil 'khor lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ dang por rigs nges par bya 12—299

ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas/ slob dpon gyis byebaden pa bdar ba sngon du song bas me tog 'dor du gzhug go/ /de la 3bden pa bdar ba'i tshig ni—/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /srid pa'i nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgyas bskyod pa'i nyon mongs choms mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po'i de nyid grub par mdzad du gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /'di yi dngos grub cir gyur dang / /rigs gang la ni skal ldan dang / /bsod nams ci 'dra las byung ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor 'di ru shog/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ku la bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod la t+t+waṃ zhes brjod pas/lag pa'i bar nas dkyil 'khor kyi dbus su me tog 'dor du gzhug go/ /de nas oṃ de baim+bi ya uṅgha pyaṭā ya swā hā/ zhes bya bas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de nyid dang me tog lhung ba'i gnas dang rigs rnams bstan par bya'o/ /de nas de bzhin du bskor bas byang phyogs kyi sgor khyer te/bum pa gzhan gyi dung chos las rnam par rgyal ba'i dung chos su me tog 'dor du gzhug go/ / nyung zad blugs la lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bo dang srin lag gis skye ba'i sriganas lnga dag tu dung chos kyi chus sngags 'di dag gis bsangs la/de nas ku sha'i chus khams lnga dag par bya ba'i phyir lan gsum du chu'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de la sngags ni oṃ ā yī dzā spru drwa pañtsa skan dha bi sho dha ni swā hā/de nas sngar bzhin gnas lnga dag tu/ oṃ a i ṛ u '-i pañtsa ta thā ga ta bi shudhe swā hā/ zhes bya bas bsangs la/ ri mor bris pa'am 'bur du brkos khyepa'am 12—300

gos kyis kyang skyerung ste/ rgyal ba 2rigs lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi cod pan bskor bar bya'o/ /'dis ni phung po lnga dag pa yin la de ltar byang phyogs sku'i sa gzhir bye chu cod pan gnyis kyis lus dag par byed pa'i dbang yin no/ /de nas de bzhin du bskor bas lho'i sgor khyer te/ shes rab pha rol phyin ma dag par bya ba'i phyir sngar bzhin skye ba'i gnas lnga dag tu dung chos kyi chus oṃ a ā i ha hā haḥho dze da sha thupā ra mi tā pa ri pū ra ṇi swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'dis bsangs la gser ram dngul lam dar la sogs pa'i snyeste dar dpyang byubacing bar bya'o/ /de nas nyi zla dag par bya ba'i phyir sngar bzhin skye ba'i gnas lnga dag tu/ oṃ srur+ya tsan+d+ra bi sho dha ka swā hā/ zhes bya bas bsangs la rdo rje dril bu snying gar lan gsum bsnol ba sngon ྅du 'gro bas spyi bor gzhag sgopar bya'o/ /de ltar lho phyogs gsung gi sa gzhir ngag dag pa'i dbang rnam pa gnyis so/ /de nas thugs rdo rje dag par bya ba'i phyir shar sgor khyer te yul dang dbang po dag par bya ba'i phyir sngar bzhin skye ba'i gnas lnga dag tu/ oṃ a ā e e/ ar ār o lo al yas bi ṣ+yo 1dh+ri ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes bya bas bsangs la spyi bo dang mgrin pa dang rna ba dang dpung pa dang lag pa dang ska rags dang rkang pa dag tu me tog gi phreng ba bcu bcings la/ lag par rdo rje'i sor gdub gtad pa ni rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang ngo / /de nas nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dag par bya ba'i phyir sngar bzhin skye ba'i gnas lnga dag tu/ oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā tsa tur brad+ma bi ha ra bi shur+bhe swā hā/ zhes bya bas bsangs la sngar gyi me tog lhung ba blangs la spyi bor gzhag ste/ me tog gar babs pa'i rigs dang mthun pa'i ming gis dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /de ltar brtul zhugs dang ming 12—301

shar phyogs thugs kyi sa gzhir sbyin no/ /de nas nub sgo ye shes sa gzhir khyer te ye shes dag par bya ba'i phyir/ sngar bzhin skye ba'i gnas lnga dag tu oṃ k+ṣa dharma tsakra pra brta ka swā hā/ zhes bya bas bsangs la rdo rje dril bu lag tu gtad de—/ rnam par dag pa'i lam ston pa'i phyir rjes su gnang ba'i dbang sbyin par bya'o—/ /de nas phyi'i ngag dag pa sngon du song bas bum pa dang gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang khyim pa'i phyogs dang rab tu byung ba'i phyogs la rim pa bzhin du'am tshig gis brda sprad par bya'o/ /dbang bdun gyi rjes la'am/skabs 'dir yang rung ste rigs drug gi dam tshig dang / rtsa ba'i ldung ba la sogs pa'i dam tshig dbog par bya'o/ /de ltar na rang don gyi dbang rnam pa bcu ste 'jig rten pa'i dbang ngo / /'jig rten las 'das pa ni 37tha snyad pa dang mtshan nyid pa'i dbye bas gnyis te/ tha snyad pa ni khyab bdag rnam pa gsum gyi dbang yin la/ mtshan nyid pa ni bsgoms bye pa las byung ba'i ye shes nang gi byang chub kyi shing drung du thob pa gang yin pa ste/ rgyas par ni bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /gang phyir dbang gi don la ni/ chen po rnams sbyar te me tog 'dzin pa rnams la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /kha cig gsang sngags grub don du/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug par byed/ /bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten gzhan don gnyer—/ /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer bar/ /dad pa mang du byed pa yis//blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya yi/ /tshe 'di don du gnyer mi bya/ /tshe 'di don du gnyer ba la/ /'jig rten pha rol don mi 'byung / /'jig rten pha rol don gnyer mis/ /tshe 'dir yang ni 'bras bu rgyas/ /zhes bya bas 'jig 72—302

rten pa'i dngos grub kyi phyir min gye/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi phyir bsam pa brtan po la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'khor ba'i dgra las rnam rgyal ba//dpa' chen khyed bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsolahu/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsolakye/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol —/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni 'jug tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum bzlas/ zhes bya ba ni slob ma gzhug pa'o/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid skad cig mas ④rang snang gi rig ma dang / gnas lnga snyebyin gyis brlab 6pa byas nas/ slob ma rnams zhal nas gzhug pa'i spyor bas thig le'i rnam par zhu ba dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i mthar yum gyi ldums su spros la/grangs ji snyed pa de snyed kyi hūṃ gi rnam par bsams la de dag yongs su gyur pa las / phyag gnyis pa'i te ru kar bsams te de nas de dag rdo rje'i lam nas drangs te thugs ka nas phyung la mdun du rang la mngon par phyogs par sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan re re la 'khod par bsam mo/ /de nas de dag la mchod pa lngas mchod la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /bu tshur jeg pa chen po la/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod yul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /sgu gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /dus gsum byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /de dag gis kyang gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam drad de/ /skyob pa dpal 12—303

ldan he ru kas/ /bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /dpung chen dag kyang des bcom ste/ /'jig rten 'jug pa yongs mkhyen nas/ /'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis 3snablo gros 'di gyis shig /ces bya ba ni rjes su gnang ba spyin pa'o/ / des na 5sems kyang rmongs pa'i phyir/ /dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas/ /dbang gi de nyid gsal bar byas / /dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro gur dang ni/ /de bzhin sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / /bde mchog la brten lung gi rkyen/ /grong khyer sum+bha ri'i rgyal po'i sras/ dpal 'jigs byed lha'i zhal snga nas bstan pa rgyal po seng ge gdan gyi rnam par dag pa'i lam gyi dbang bskur ba'i rab tu bya ba rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid kyi spyan sngar bod kyi lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong grags 'byor shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //log par dad pa'i skye bo rnams/ /lam 'dir dbang ba ma yin no/ /de phyir dbang bskur dam pa 'di/ /bla ma rje yis 5bdag la gnang / /phyi rabs gdul bya skal ldan mis/ /bla ma dam pa rtag bsten pas/ /lam 'di rim gyis bgrod byas te/ /mi 'gyur ye shes mchog thob shog/ //6 72—304

sgyur/ (bye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉'jug29/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 gsum/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kas+t+waṃ sgo/ bye — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ma mas/ ④ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sbyar/299 hūṃ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrung / — / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar
