bcu yi rang bzhin bdag /bcu yi dbye bas rnam par gnas/ /stan ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de ni sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /dri med tshul khrims yang dag ldan/ /nye ba'i stan du rab tu grags/ /zhing ni 'od byed shes par bya/ /de ni bzod pa'i pha rol phyin/ /nye ba'i zhing ni brtson 'grus gyur/ /'od 'phro ba dang yang dag ldan/ /tshasdo bsam gtan yang dag ldan/ /mngon gyur zhes bya'i sa ru gnas/ /nye ba'i tshasdo shes rab ste/ /de ni sbyang dka'i lku sa zhes bya/ /'dus pa rtag tu thabs yin te/ /ring du song ba'i sa ru gnas/ /nye ba'i 'dus pa rtag tu ni/ /mi g.yo ba dang thabs su gnas/ /dur khrod smon lam rtag tu gsungs/ /legs pa'i blo gros sa dang ldan/ /rgyal chen dpal dang kyehe ru ka /de ru rol pas legs par bzhugs/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /rang 'byung mchog gi dbang phyug ste/ /ston pa dpa' bo kun gyi gzhi/ /rnam pa kun gyi mtshan nyid gcig /sa gzhan dang por tshogs ldan tha mar sprin te rtag tu ye shes mchog tu grags/ /nye ba'i dur khrod 'byung po'i gnas te te ru ka chags bdag gis bstan/ /stan ni sdug bsngal dag tu shes/ /nye ba'i stan ni kun 'byung ste/ /zhing gi ming ni 'gog pa'o/ /lam ni rtag tu nye ba'i zhing / /zad pa shes pa tshajo ha/ /nye ba'i tshajo mi skye ba/ /chos ni 'dus pa nyid yin no/ /nye ba'i 'dus pa rjes su shes/ /dur khrod kun rdzob shes pa'o/ /don dam nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /shes pa bcu yi rang bzhin gyis/ /gnas la sogs pa dag par grags/ /zab mo 'bum gyi mdo las kyang / /ye shes grags par gyur pa yang / /sangs rgyas gzugs kyi rang bzhin du/ /'khor lo bde mchog la gnas pa'o/ /'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyag dang ldan/ /12—363

kha dog mtshon cha dang ldan pa/ /lha mo rnams dang dpa' bo kun/ / pulbir la khyasogs rab bsam bya/ /byang chub kyi chos sum cu bdun/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dag pa'o/ /sen sogs yan lag bkod pa yang / /de ni go cha chen por dran//rnal 'byor 'di dang yang dag ldan/ /lhan cig skyes pa gzhan yin no/ /phyi rol nang dang mnyam ldan pa/ /he ru ka buskur yang dag gnas/ /ma skyes pa yi rang bzhin phyir/ /stong pa zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /gang phyir rgyu dang bral ba'i phyir/ /de ni mtshan ma med par brjod/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma kophobhe haṃ/ thog mar stong bsgoms de rjes mkha' byas rlung dang me dbus chu/ / gzhi bsam ④gzhan yang brgya byin rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gzugs su byung / /de steng rtse mo brgyad dang mtshan pa'i ri rab rtse mor gser kyi rdo rje dang ni gzhal yas khang / /gcig tu me tog sna tshogs kyis mdzes sna tshogs mang po'i ras chen bzang pos gcig tu mdzes/ /dril bu 'phan dang yang dag ldan pa'i sgra yis phyogs su grags shing dril chung snyan pa'i sgra/ /'khor lo'i rnam pa'i rang dbus kha spyor gsum mchog me tog phreng bas mdzes/ /phyi rol sgo bzhir rta babs chen po nyid kyis mchog tu mdzes/ /dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas srid pa las byung rdo rje sngon po chen po'o/ /de'i mthar bde mchog ces grags yul dang yang dag ldan pa 'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /sngon po lta bu'i 'od bzang ldan zhing lte bar byas pa yid ni hūṃ las byung ba mtha' yas mgon po'o//spros pa'i shes rab yan lag sbyor ba phyogs su phyir bzlog gyur nas bsdus te rdo rje mgon po'o/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i rang bzhin srid pa kun dang mnyam pa pad+ma'i dbus su bsgom/ /du ba lta bu'i 'od zer bzang po thog mar gtso bo'i zhal ni zla tshes 72—364

—lta bu yi/ /mche ba ldan zhing g.yon pa'i zhal bzang ljang gu rgyab zhal rnam par 'gyur ba bzang po'i spyan/ /g.yas par ha har dgod bcas nyi nyi zhes zhi gser 'dra shin tu 'jigs/ /g.yas pa brkyang bas dus mtshan dang ldan 'jigs byed mnan cing dri med mkha' 'gro dra bas rol/ /mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng bas brgyud ①pa'i do shal mdzes par 'phyang bas brla nas phrag pa'i bar/ /lus ni phyag rgya drug brgyan mi mgo sna tshogs bcings shing dbu skra kham pa gyen du badze+es—/ /cod pan zla ba phreng bas mtshan pa sa steng mun pa sel ba spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan/ /sbyangs par gyur pa'i phyag chen po ni mchog gyur mang po zad byed 'phro ba'i ②dril bu dag pa'i rdo rje'o/ /gang gi duglang po'i pags pa khrag gis brlan pa gyen du 'phyar ba bsnams pas mdzes par bstan/ /g.yas na rno ba'i mdung dang zhags pa mchog ldan ḍa ma ru dang gri gug go/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang pad+ma sa gsum las rgyal zhags pa mgo bo bzang pos mdzes/ /rnam kun rang bzhin srid pa kun mnyam de yi gzugs su rab tu byed/ /phyag na rdo rje ldan zhing gdug pa kun la sdigs mdzub skra grol legs par dmar/ /rab tu chags pas mgrin par 'khyud cing zhal ni khrag gis gang zhing phyag g.yon pad+ma bsnams—/ /thabs dang shes rab gcig tu spyor bas lhan cig skyes bde rtag tu dga' sems rang bzhin can/ /sprin ltar snang ba lha mo'i tshogs ni mtha' yas spro ba lha mo phag mo ste/ /zhal gyi grwa yi phyogs nas khrag 'dzag cho pas/ /yan lag kun la byugs pas mdzes pa dang / /mgo bo thod dang mgo yi phreng ba dang //gcer bu mi yi rus pas rnam par brgyan/ /g.yas pa'i byin pas bdag po yi/ /g.yon pa'i brla ni yongs su 'khyud/ /'khor lo kun bdag sbyor ba yis/ /12—365

rnal 'byor pa rnams sems dga' ma/ /rtag tu khros pa phag gdong du/ /bdag gis brtags /1nas bshad pa'o/ /yang na bud med lta bu'i zhal/ /'khor lo'i gtso mo bsgom par bya/ /yang na de ni du ba'i mdog /dga' kun mtshan nyid gcig pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi/ /rdo rje phag mo bsgom par bya/ /'khor lo'i dbus rtag lha mo ni/ /gang zhig bskyod pa'i sbyor bas gnas—/ /rdo rje phag gdong gtso mo ni/ /skyes pa lta bur byed par rjogasungs/ /rdo rje phag mo lha mo che/ /lha mo kun dang mnyam ldan pa/ /gtso bo'i gzugs kyis bsgom bya ba/ /bde mchog don du rnam par shes/ /stag gi pags pa'i gos dang ldan/ /spyan gsum rtag tu bsgom par bya/ /sil sil zer ba'i sgra yis ni/ /brla gnyis mnyam par khyab pa'o/ /'bar ba'i phreng khyab 'jigs pa'o—/ /'jigs byed chen po 'jigs par byed/ /lhan cig skyes rol dur khrod de/ /lhan cig skyes dga' te ru ka /chags bcas kye'akhyud pa yang dag ldan / /'o byed pas ni rtag tu gnas/ /bskyod pa chen po'i spyor ba yis/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i kha dog lta bu'i khros pa ste/ /spyan gsum zhal ni lha ru gzigs/ /mche ba bzhi yi ④myu gus brgyan/ /dam pa'i don du rab tu grags/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na sa gsum las rgyal sna tshogs rdo rje gsor bas 'jigs/ /g.yon na dngos grub zla ba ltar dkar snod ni khrag gis bkang ba bsnams/ /phyag gnyis gtso la 'khyud pas lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ldan rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /ban du ltar dmar 'od tshogs mang po ldan pa'i rdo rje lha mo bsam/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang khā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /dga' dang bde bas mgu ba yi/ /rdo rje sbyor bas bsgom par bya/ /12—366

sngon po ljang gu dmar po'i sku/ /ser ba'i 7'od nyid rnal 'byor ma/ /phyogs bzhir pad+ma'i 'dab ma la/ /lhan cig skyes dga' shin tu mdzes/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi po/ /phyi dang nang na yang dag bzhugs/ /chu dang rlung dang me chen po/ /sa yi rnam pa'i dngos por byung / /byams pa smon lam mā ma tī⑤—/ /btang snyoms ye shes sgrol ma ste/ /gos dkar mo ni stobs su gsungs/ /phyag rgya mngon 'byung ①byed pa mo/ /btang snyoms spyan mar grags pa ste/ /snying rje dang ni mnyam ldan na/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs rnam dag pa/ /bla ma'i rim las 'ongs pas bstan/ /mkha' 'akro ma sogs gzugs bzang ro yis stan byas phyag na pad+ma kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yas pa'i phyag ni gri gug dang ni ḍa ma ru ldan bsnams shing skra grol spyan gsum pa'o/ /phyag rgya drug gis sku la brgyan cing mi mgo mchog gi thod 'chang gcer bu'i chegazugs can shin tu 'jigs/ /stan la g.yas brkyang bzhugs shing rnam 'gyur zhal mdzad hūṃ sgrogs dga' ba'i snying po'o//stag gi pags pa'i na bza' dang / /mi ro'i steng na legs par bzhugs/ /dngos grub kun ster bsam par bya/ /lho dang shar dang rgyab dang ni/ /nub kyi phyogs kyi cha ru ni/ /zhal bzhi zhal rnams nyid kyis ni/ /'o byed par ni rnam par bsam/ /rgyal po dang ni rgyal rigs nyid/ /ma dang pha dang mnyam ldan pa/ /rgyal rigs sogs gzhan blangs nas ni/ /thod pa rnams ni mtshams su gzhag⑤ /mchod pa bzhi po legs gsungs pa/ /gti mug chen po rnam dag pa/ /mchod pa'i don kyis 'khor lo yi/ /'khor lo bde mchog dpal las gsungs/ /rab gtum thod pa'i dum bu ni/ /lho yi rtsibs la rnam par gnas/ /gtum mig ma dang yang dag ldan/ /keng rus chen po shar 12—367

phyogs su/ /'od ldan ma dang legs sbyor ba/ /keng rus byang gi cha ru'o/ /sna chen ma dang yang dag ldan/ /mche ba rnam gcigs byang du'o/ /dpa' bo blo (ma yang dag ldan/ /chang la dpa' ba bden bral du/ /'od dpag med dang mi thung nyid/ /rlung gi phyogs su rtag tu bzhugs/ /rdo rje 'od ldan lha mo ni / /laṅka'i dbang phyug ma rtag tu/ /dbang ldan phyogs su legs par bzhugs / /'di dag sems can kun don mdzad/ /me phyogs rdo rje lus dang ni/ /ljon grib ma dang yang dag ldan/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo mkha' spyod du//bde mchog las ni 'di dag gsungs/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i phyi rol du/ /rdo rje sngon po'i phreng bas bskor/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug sngo/ /sangs rgyas tshogs 'phro yang dag ldan/ /sa srung byem dang yang dag ldan/ /myu gu can ni lho ru dgod/ /'jigs byed chen po dang lhan cig /rdo rje ral can shar du bzhugs/ /byang du 'jigs byed chen po dang / /rlung gi shugs ma legs par bzhugs/ /nub tu rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / /chang 'thung ma dang yang dag ldan / /sngo bsangs lha mo legs sbyar ba/ /shin tu bzang po bden bral phyogs / /rdo rje bzang dang shin tu bzang / /lhan cig rlung gi phyogs su brten / /dbang ldan phyogs kyi gnas su ni/ /rta dang shin tu 'jigs byed mdzes—/ /me phyogs bya gdong ma dang ni/ /mig mi bzang dang yang dag ldan//sa spyod gsung gi 'khor lo ste/ /pad+ma'i phreng dang yang dag ldan/ /spro zhing bsdu bar byed pa po/ /rtag tu kha dog dmar por bsgom/ /lhor ni rtag tu stobs chen dang / /'khor lo'i shugs mas mdzes pa'o/ /dum skyes ma dang yang dag ldan/ /rin chen rdo rje shar du dgod/ /shoṇ+ḍi smi rngusbyor yang dag ldan//12—368

rta mgrin byang gi phyogs nyid na'o/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /chu yi phyogs su dgod par bya/ /he ru ka dpal su bī ra/ /rtag tu bden bral du bsgom bya/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / /stobs chen po ni rlung gi phyogs/ /'khor los sgyur ⑨ dang gti mug che/ /rtag tu dbang ldan du bsgom bya/ /rdo rje sems dang brtson chen mo/ /sku yi 'khor lor bsam par bya/ /phyi rol 'khor phreng dkar po'o/ /kha dog dkar por rnam par bsgom/ /'di ni sa 'og 'khor lo yi/ /sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid gyur pa'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad phyag bzhi ste/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin pa'o/ /ḍa ma ru ni g.yas na 'dzin/ /ral pa bcings pas rnam par mdzes/ /spro zhing sdud pa'i gzugs can te/ /ro yi gdan kyel legs par bzhugs/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang yang dag ldan/ /rus pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /phyag na rdo rje dril bu dang / /lha mo 'khyud la mchog tu brtson/ /gcer bu'i gzugs can hūṃ zhes sgrogs/ /mgo yi phreng bas nye bar mdzes/ /lhan cig skyes dga' 'khor lor bcas /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma bsgom bya/ /dpa' bo kun dang mnyam spyor bas/ /bde mchog ces bya rnam par byung / /rab gtum mo sogs lha mo de/ /zhal gasbug gis ni mdzes pa'o/ /phyag gnyis dbu skra grol ba ste/ /gcer bu mi rus sogs pas brgyan/ /g.yon na khrag gi thod pa ste/ /g.yas na sdigs mdzub gri gug go/ /thams cad spyan gsum hūṃ sgrogs pa/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs su byung / /rig ma'i sked 7 par ske rags te/ /rab tu 'bad nas bsgom par bya/ /gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin can/ /gdug pa'i khrag gsol ba la dgyes/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs lha mo bzhi/ /sngon du g.yon du 12—369

bskor ba can/ /gang phyir 'gro kun g.yon las byung / /de nas bde mchog las ni gsungs/ /dkar po sngon po mnyam sbyor bas/ /nges par du ba lta bur gyur/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni sngon por stanakhye/ / de nas du stemadun du legs par bzhugs/ /khwa dang 'ug pa khyi yi gdong / /phag gi gdong rnams de bzhin du/ /sngon po ljang gu de bzhin dmar/ /ser po'i 'od can sgo ru bzhugs—/ /rtag tu bden bral mtshams su ni/ /gshin rje brtan ma mchog tu 'jigs/ /rlung phyogs rnam par dag bsgom pa/ /gshin rje pho nya mdzes pa'i zhal/ /dbang ldan gshin rje mche ba ma/ /g.yon pa'i sbyor bar gcig tu 'gro / /shin tu rnam dag gshin rje 'joms/ /me yi gnas su rtag tu bsam//rim pa min dang rim pa yis/ /'di dag shin tu grags pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la rim min pa/ /rnal 'byor ma las rim pa gsungs/ /lha mo'i gzugs ni gzi brjid che/ /kha dog gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /mtshams kyi lha mo mchog 'di dag /'gro ba'i bgegs ni rnam 'dren pa/ /g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ pad+ma ste / /g.yas na cang te'u gri gug go/ /'di dag sgo la sogs par bzhugs/ /he ru ka 'khyud legs par bzhugs/ /pu dzā bye o a go rā de mā kā o tri ko ka la kā ti pre kṛ ④sau su na si ma ku/ mkhas pas mgo dang spyi gtsug sogs/ /pu la sogs pa bsam byas telta/ /lhan cig skyes dgas mdzes pa yis me/ /'khor lo phyi nas spyan drang ste/ /rkang pa mnan cing gyen du blta/ /gyen du dze gi sgra bsgrags ⑦shing / /phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug /mdzub mo mdud pa byas pa dang / /gung mo sbyar bar byas nas kyang / /mthe bo mnyam par ldan pa ni/ /dpral ba'i phyogs su 12—370

bzung hūṃ7byas te/ /de ltar phyogs bskor rnal 'byor pas/ /mgu ba'i gsang sngags brjod par bya/ /lhag gnas rang gi 'khor lor bzhugs/ /rdo rje pad+ma mchog dag pa/ /yi ge r+ya —yis lte ba bskyed/ /yi ge byu las rdo rjer byung / /sngon du yan lag bzhi bkod nas/ /phyis ni bde ba legs par spyad/ /dang po'i dga' ba dpa' bo ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnal 'byor ma/ /thams cad lhan cig skyes dga' ste/ /legs par bde ba'i thabs su spyor/ /mtho ris sa steng sogs 'jig rten/ /skad cig gis ni sku gcig gyur/ /'khor lo sdom las dga' kun gsungs/ /dpa' bo gnyis med yang dag ldan/ /lha rnams sems kyi byernam par snang / /lhan cig skyes nas 4'khor lo'i dbus/ /snying rje che ldan rnal 'byor pas/ /phyi nang bdag nyid mchod pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor khyab bdag legs par mchod/ /sbyin bdag la sogs mi dmigs pas/ /mtha' gsum spyor bas legs par gnas/ /gang du mchod cing bstod pa der/ /rgyud rnams las ni mthong ba'o/ /'di don legs par dpyad nas ni/ /mnyam par bzhag nas dpa' bo mchod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro mchog gi rnal 'byor ma yis mgul nas 'khyud/ /sku la dpa' bo'i phreng ba legs par byas shing rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs/ /'khor lo la gnas bde mchog snying rje chen po'i stobs kyis brlab phya/ /khyab bdag khyod kyi 6zhabs kyi pad+mar rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /ral pa la ni mi bskyod pas mdzes 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gzhi ru gyur cing dam pa'i don du gsungs pa'o / /bdag gi 7bla ma'i blos gsungs pa/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ral pa'i steng //de ni dbang bskur bar gsungs pa/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rim las 'ong /12—371

zur bzhi 'khor lo chen po ni/ /'dren pa rin chen 'byung ldan no/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad de bzhin du/ /ral gri don yod grub pa'o/ /khwa sogs mchog gi lha mo rnams/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs bsnams/ /lugs gzhan bsgom par bya ba'am/ /brgyad po ro yi steng na bzhugs/ /khwa la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams/ /gsungs pa ji bzhin de yi zhal/ /bdag gi bla ma'i rim las 'ongs/ /rgyu de yis ni bris pa yis/ /gzhan dag lha mo rnams kyi zhal/ /bud med gdong lta bu yin zer/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pa yis ni/ /lugs gnyis gang 'dod blang bar bya/ /keng rus chen po dang keng rus/ /rta mgrin dang ni glang sna ma/ /bya gdong ma dang rta rna nyasogs/ /gsungs pa ji bzhin 'di dag bsgom/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /dpa' bo la sogs rab tu grags2 // /gsungs pa ji bzhin rnam rol par/ /dpal ldan bde mchog 'di dag bsgom/ /sngon du phung po byin brlabs nas/ /ji srid mchod dang bstod 'gyur ba/ /bskyed pa'i dang po'i sbyor ba ste/ /chung ngu'i sbyor bar mngon par brjod/ /ri rab la gnas sa bon rdzogs/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs rnam bsgom pa/ /blo yi dbye bas byas pa ni/ /shin tu sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /ye shes rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rnal 'byor pas rtag rnal 'byor cher/ /chen po zhes ni rab tu grags/ /rnal 'byor lhag pa'i spyor dbus su/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnam par gnas/ /chen po'i yang ni chen po ru/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor kun shes bya/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan zhing / /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas gang / /dpal ldan dpa' bo kun gyi gzhi—/ /rang byung rnal 'byor thams cad rig /dpal ldan smad 'tshong 72—372

zhabs kyis ni/ /byin gyis brlab kyepa'i mtshan nyid gsungs/ /de bas bla ma mnyes byas nas/ /rnal 'byor thams cad legs par brtsam/ /dgod pa dang ni ngu ba nyid/ /shin tu yid 'phrog pa yi gar/ /sna tshogs kun byed thams cad mkhyen/ /rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis mdzes/ /'di nyid las ni gang gsungs pa/ /mnyes byed rnam par dag pa dang / /gsal byed yon tan ldan pa'i mi/ /byang chub phyogs dang go char bcas/ /go cha chen por yang dag ldan/ /thog mar 'di rnams rab tu bya/ /grub na yongs su sparngo ba dang //yi ge gsum gyi cho ga yis/ /grub na de la bkod bya ste/ /'khor lo gsum gyi rang bzhin du/ /sku gsung sbyor bas dag pa bya/ /oṃ ni sku yi 'khor lo ste/ /yi ge āḥni ngag tu gnas/ /hūṃ ni sems la rnam dgod pa/ /byas nas cho ga spang bar bya/ /rtog pa'i dbang gis legs byung ba/ /sems can gzung ba'i rgyu yin no/ /yi ge gsum gyi dgod pa 'di/ /de nyid kyi — ni gzugs su spyor/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa dang / /sku yi yi ge skye ba med/ /gsung dang thugs kyang yi ge med/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje rtogs —/las byung / /log par gzung bas zin pa'o/ /oṃ ni thams cad gsal byed doci/ /hūṃ snyehūṃ phaṭa dang yang dag ldan/ /dngos grub bsgrub pa'i rgyu ru ni/ /ming bzlas pa ni legs par brtsam/ /stong pa nyid kyi sngags brjod cing / /gnod mdzes rgyal po de bzhin no/ /ra ba dra ba bsam byas shing / /rdo rje sa gzhi de bzhin no/ /rlung dang me ni yang dag rdzogs/ /chu dang sa yi dkyil 'khor la/ /ri rab sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /sna tshogs pad+ma yang dag ldan/ /dpe byad brgyad cu las byung ba/ /de steng zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /zla ba la gnas hūṃ las byung / /12—373

he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /phag mo la sogs yang dag ldan/ /kha dog sna tshogs sogs kyis brgyan/ /'jigs byed chen po g.yon brkyang ba/ /sgo skyong rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /dpa' drug rnal 'byor ma go cha/ /go cha chen po yang dag ldan/ /dngos grub kun mdzad dpa' bo ste/ /bde mchog mdzes pa bsgom par bya/ /sngon du yi ge gsum bkod de/ /bzlas pa legs par brtsam par bya/ /'di ltar dpal ldan bde mchog ni/ /bsgom pa rnal 'byor gzhan dag zer/ /dngos po gang dang gang gis ni/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag spyor//des ni de yi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin no/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba te bī re shā ya hūṃ hūṃ gyophaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kaspraghi san+ni bhā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā 2ma ku ṭoṅka ṭā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rdaṭī ka rā lo gra dī ṣa ṇa mu lā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho r+ya ta shu la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga zi dhā ri ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ byā ghā 3dzi na asbra ra dha rā ye 47hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhu spran+dha klukā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ra ka ra hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ brnya ban+dha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tā sa ya tā sa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ spyo bha ya k+ko bha ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ — hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ phe phe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ thugs kyi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo rtsa ba'i sngags so // // 5oṃ da ha da ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ ba sha ru bye ra an+t+ra mā lā ba lam+bi ne+e kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sap+ta pā tā khā shesnag ta ju dze+e ga sabaṃ pā tardza ya tardza ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā kasbyo ā kasbyo hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa / oṃ hri hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ rja rja hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags so // //nyu1 12—374

oṃ haṃ haṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ho ho t+t+waṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsi li tsi li hūṃ t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li hūṃ t+t+waṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li nyi li hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sku'i 'khor lo'i dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /ka ra la sogs dpa' mo yi/ /dbang phyug gir grags gzhan dag zer/ /bdag gi bla ma'i lugs nyid kyis/ /dpa' bo rnams kyi sngags su bshad // //lha oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti badz+ra bā rā dī a pa ra 3dzi te tre+e lo kya mā te bibye shwa ri sarba khyu ta bha yā rngub te ma hā badz+re badzā sa ne+e a dzi ti 4a pa rā dzi te wa bye snye/ka ri ne+e tretra bhā ma ṇi/ bi ṣa sho ṣa ro ṣa gro dha ka rā li tri te ṭī dz+wakā ma byā pra bhe pa ṭī a ⑧pa rā dza ya bi dza ya dzam+bha ni stam+bha (3ni mo ha ni/ badz+ra bā rā ṭī ma hā yo gi be+e⑪/kā me shwa ri kha ge/ tar+ya thā/ pro tai ge pro tai ge/shārte ha na ha na pā rdekhu/ ki ki ni kho khi ni dhu na byu na/ badz+ra ha ste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la dh+wa ri ṇi ma hā pi shi ta ྾māṃ sā ⑩sa ni/ ma nu ṣān+t+ra pā bri te san+ni bye/ snye na ra shi ro mā lā thugraṣ+pe ta dha ri ṇi ⑩sum+bha ni suste/ ha na ha na pā t+t+waṃ sarba pā pa dzo nyashemāṃ—/ sarba pa shu dz+wa lku ma hā māṃ —— sats+tsha da ni gro dha mūrti/ rdaṭī ka rā li ni ma hā mu dre shrī te ru ka /de ba myu gra ma nyi ṣi/ sa ha sra shi re sa ha sra bā hā be/ sha ta sa ha sru na ne+e dz+wa li ta/ te dza gya dz+wa la mu khi piṅga la lo matsa ne+e/ badz+ra sha rī re badzā sa ni/ mi li ta tsi li ta/ he te hūṃ hūṃ kha kha dhu dhu ru ru dhu ru dhu ru mu ru mu ru/ a dwo te ma hā yo gi pa ṣ+ṭha ta sir+bhe/ dro t+t+waṃ dro t+t+waṃ/ gri gro/ te he/ha ha/ d+dhā me/ ha sa ha sa/ bī re/ ha ha ho ho hūṃ hūṃ tre+e lo kya bi nā sa ni/sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭī stota thā ga ta pa ri bā re hūṃ phaṭa/ sau ha byu pe 2snyekhaḥg dza rū pe 12—375

gaḥ / tre+e lo kye da re sa mu dra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ bī ra dre te hūṃ t+t+waṃ hā hā —1 ma hā pa shu mo ha tsani yo ge shwa ri t+t+waṃ khuḍā ki ni/ lo ki ni lo ki kā māṃ ban+dha ni sabye bidre hūṃ phaṭa/ bhū ③ta tā sa ni ma hābyubī re pa ra ma sispyo blubibye shwa ri phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā// //rnal 'byor pas bzlas sngags 'di rnams/ /'dod pa'i don kun legs par ster/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bor ldan/ / 3gzhan bde mchog las byung ba'o/ /in+t+ra khyu ⑪ti'i rim nyid dang / /sañtsa re dang smad 'tshong gzhung / /dpa' bo dang rgo lha rnams ni/ /phyag gnyis zhal gcig nyid du bstan/ /dz+ra ⑩ lan+ta ra dpal zhabs dang / /kats+tsha pa da'i nyu1lugs kyis kyang / /dpa' bo rnams dang rnal 'byor ma/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rab tu grags/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs dpa' bor bcas/ /sgo skyong rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi rab tu grags/ /khro bo'i gzugs can hūṃ dang bcas/ /rab gtum ma sogs lha mo rnams/ /kha dog sna tshogs bye brag dang / /phyag gnyis pa dang zhal gcig pa/ /tsar+ya pa yi gzhung yin no/ /yang na sems kyi rnam dag pasamu/ /gcig tu kha dog sngon por gnas/ /dpa' bo lha mo rnams dang ldan / /gzhung 'di legs zhes kha cig gsungs/ /sku gsum 1 dag pa'i dbye ba yis/ /kha dog gsum du rnam par gnas/ /gang phyir 'khor lo gsum gsungs pa/ /de phyir kha dog gsum du dbye/ /lugs 'di rnams ni gang 'dod pa/ /rnal 'byor rigs ngapas de bsten bya/ /phyag gnyis thog ma nas brtsams nas/ /ji srid 'bum gyi phyag dang zhal/ /phyag zhal mtha' yas dngos grub phyir/ /bsam mi khyab sbyor gyis bsam bya/ /de ltar blo bzang gis 12—376

shes bya/ /spyod dang bral bas sbyar ba min/ /'di kun mchog tu dga' ba ste/ /gang zhig bsgom bya de 'bras bzang / /sngon du gus pa'i sems kyis ni/ /bla mas gsungs pa blang bar bya/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya bde mchog las/ /slob dpon kha cig gis gsungs pa/ /he ru ka 'byung rgyud las gsungs/ /bde mchog la ni gnas pa min/ /bdag gis ma bris pa des na/ /dpa' bo rdo rje bzod pa mdzod/ /man ngag gis ni phag mo ni/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya zhes su grags—/ /bde mchog gtor ma'i las dang ni/ /dkyil 'khor dgug pa'i don gyis so/ /te ru ka 'byung rgyud du ni/ /te ru ka yi phyag na gnas/ /dpa' bo'i bdag po'i sngags gsungs gos kyi don gyis stag gi pags pa rnamasasna //bdag gi 7bla ma yis bstan lhan cig skyes pa gos med rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gzugs//rtag tu drag po'i dung mdog dkar zhing dmar ba'i sku ni rigs drug bsdus pa'i don gyis so/ /kha dog thog ma 'dra ba'i gzugs te thog ma'i nyi ma lta bu'i zhal te lha mo skra grol ba'o/ /lugs gnyis gyur pa dpyad nas sems la gang 'dod de dag bya/ /g.yas na rtsa gzhan khrag ste myur du 'bab pa me tog ldan pa'o/ /g.yon na khu ba ster ba rgya mtsho lta bu de ni dpa' bo'i rang bzhin no/ /rkang dang rus pa rtsa dang chu dang lnga pa khu bar ldan pa 'di ni pha ru gyur/ /ma ni pags pa sha dang khrag dang snying dang me dang lhan cig pa ste gang 'di gnyis po dngos grub po/ /mgon po dpal ldan te ru ka 'di bskyed pas bskyed pa gang zhig pha dang bye brag med / /'dir ni dpal ldan bde mchog ces bya yon tan kun gyi gzhi ste dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin no/ /de ltar shes nas de yi gzugs ni sa gsum bde ba ster ba'i de nyid rnal 'byor pa yis /bsgom/ /'byung gnas sgra yi 72—377

gzugs las ni/ /rnam par byung sogs gang shes pa/ /de yi don ni bdag gis bstan/ /rab tu 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rab 'jug dkyil 'khor sogs rnams kyi1/ /phyi rol rnam pa'i mtshan nyid gcig /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis de dag gsungs/ /gang zhig ldog par rtag gsung ba/ /'khor lo bde mchog la legs gnas/ /de ni lhan cig skyes 'dri dngos/ /rtag tu snying la gnas pa'o/ /phyi nang bdag nyid mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sems la rnam dgod bstan/ /dpal ldan te ru ka rol lus la gnas par 7da lta bstan/ /rnam dag te ru ka yi yan lag lhan cig skyes gnas mnyam par gzhag /phyis ni rnal 'byor pa yi rim gyis lus skyes rnam par bsgom/ /lhan cig skyes mnyam ma lus phur bu pags pa bcings par 4 rab tu sbyar/ /brtan zhing mkhregs pas bcings pa'i rus pa'i phreng ba dra ba'o/ /sna tshogs kyis mdzes sna tshogs phyag rgyas brgyan pa'i sku/ /go cha mkhregs pas dag pa de ni go cha chen por ldan/ /gang zhig dmigs dang bral ba'i rtsa ni sems can kun phan 'dod/ /lha dang lha min mi dang bcas pa 'di kun de yis khyab / /bhe 5ram pa yi rlung ni rkang pa'i mthil du shin tu legs par gnas/ /lte bar song ba'i 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor dmar po'i gzi brjid can/ /lho bar dkar ba'i chu yi gzhi ni yid 'ong gzugs te snying gar dbang pos rnam mdzes ser po'o/ /mgrin pa'i steng na ri bo'i mchog ni brgyad pa dang ldan ri rab ste/ /bdun bskor zla ba nyi ma dbus na 'char zhing nub pa'o/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma sum cu rtsa drug ldan par gyur pa'i rdo rje'i dbus/ /grub pa'i ā li kā li las byung hūṃ sgrogs mdzes 6pa'i mgo/ /der gnas gser gyi gdan ni sna 72—378

tshogs dbus/ /ming ni dang po zhes bya las ni lhan cig byes pa dri med zla ba'i 'od / /yan lag kun gyi mtshams su 'gro bar 'gyur ba'i 1rim pa yis/ /bskyed pa'i pad+ma'i sna yis rdudabus phyogs su/ /legs par ཿbskul bas mgo bo thog ma med par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas skyes/ /sum cu rtsa drug ro dang ldan pa mdzes pa legs par gyur pa'i rtsa rnams kyis/ /mi mthun phyogs ni bzhad par gyur nas shin tu rnam par dag pa'i khams/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba zhes pa'i sgra yi don ni de lta bu'o/ /rgya mtsho'i chu ni shin tu rnam pa sna tshogs 'gram na ri yi dbang por ldan/ /zab cing mdzes pa'i snying po thog mar grub pa'i dur khrod do / /rgyal mtshan sna tshogs 'phan dang dril bu'i do shal mdzes/ /gsum du byung ba'i 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor de ni lus yin no/ /mchog tu mdzes shing legs pa'i skud pa dang ni rnga yab kyis mtshan pa/ /dri ma rnged pa'i mtshon twoni rol pas rnam par dag /bum pa la sogs gnas pa de yi dngos dang ldan pas khengs / /lhan cig skyes gnas sems las skyes pas 5bris pa thal ba'o /pad+ma la gnas khro spangs shing / /gtsang zhing brtson pa mnyam gzhag pa'i/ /rnal 'byor ye shes mnyam ldan pa'i/ /sems ni he ru ka ru gsungs/ /rgyud lnga dag gi 'bras dag ni/ /rdo rje zhes su mngon par brjod/ /der gnas sa bon rdzogs pa ni/ /de dpal he ru ka ru brjod/ /shrī yi sgra ni gnyis med don/ /he ni rgyu dang bral ba nyid/ /ru ni gzugs dang bral ba'i don/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /ā li kā li mnyam spyor ba/ /dkar po dmar po'i rang bzhin no/ /shrī yig tu ni legs gnas pa/ /shin tu thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /shrī yi brda yis brjod pa ni/ /bha ga'i don du mngon par brjod/ /12—379

sems ni he ru ka nyid de/ /dpal ldan he ru ka zhes gsungs/ /bā ni dag lam 'das pa'i sgra/ /rā ni rdul dang bral ba nyid/ /tī ni rgyu rnams mi dmigs pa/ /phag mo'i sgra ru rab tu grags/ /ral pa'i rtsa ba zhes grags pa/ /bde ba skyed par byed pa'o/ /sna tshogs sems can don mdzad phyir/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rnam par gnas/ /byang chub sems ni zla bar gsungs/ /dpal ni bde chen 'khor los 2sgyur/ /der gnas rtag tu 'dzag pa ni/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i mthar gnas pa'o/ /dus kun yongs su rdzogs pa rgya mtsho'i lam du 'bab pa lta bu yi/ /lte ba'i 'gram du gnas gyur nyi ma bcu drug bsten 3pa bskyed pa'o/ /stong pa lta bu'i rnal 'byor gyis༄ / /lha dang lha min mir bcas rnams / /gcig gi rang bzhin legs dag pa/ /sdogs mdzub legs pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /byang chub sems las byung gyur cing / /yan lag kun la rnam par gnas/ /de phyir rtag tu dag pa nyid/ /phyi dang nang du gnas par bstan / /yan lag bcu gnyis las byung phyir/ /phyag ni bcu gnyis rnams dang ldan/ /zhal bzhi rnams su legs bstan pa/ /rnam thar bzhi po dag pa nyid / /lha mo'i gzugs can mkha' 'gro ma/ /dum skyes ma dang khā ma ste/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi po/ /g.yo dang mi g.yo ba rnams skyong / /gnyis med rnam pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dbang po la sogs gang 'thung ba/ /de ni gsol ba zhes su bstan/ /phyag rnams kyi 4ni mtshan nyid ni/ /sku gsung dag phyir mdung thung ste/ /glang po gti mug rnam par spangs/ /dgra sta zhe sdang gcod pa ste/ /lus dang ngag sems las byung ba'o/ /sems can don gyis gri gug rno/ /'phyar ba brtson 'grus yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu dga' ba'i rang 72—380

bzhin gyis/ /ḍa ma ru yi sgra ru brtag /rdo rje stong nyid mi tshig pa'i/ /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin phyir/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ yan lag la bsnams rmyeganas/ /bde ba bskyang — phyir thod pa dang / /zhags pa yul gyi yon tan te/ /mgo bo tshangs pa'i rang bzhin no/ /dril bu shes rab rang bzhin no/ /yi ge lnga bcu rnams kyis ni/ /mgo bo mdzes pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /yan lag brgyan pa'i mgo yi phreng / /dngos grub kun gzhi bdag nyid can/ /mche ba bzhi dang mnyam ldan pa/ /bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms pa po/ /zab par 'phro ba dang ldan pa'i/ /rtag tu so yi phreng ba gnyis—/ /pha rol phyin drug rnam dag pa'i/ /phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa'o/ /phyogs kyi gos kyi rang bzhin gyi/ /gzugs su byung ba'i gos dang bral/ /ā ni kun nas 'gro ba kun/ /li la stong par sbyor bar snanyid/ /de nas g.yas brkyang zhabs su grags/ /te ru ka yi bye brag go/ /yan lag g.yon pa bskum pa zhes pa yi 4/ /tshig tu gsungs pa'i legs par thob pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /g.yas brkyang ba yis yekun nas 'khor lo'i tshogs ni dpal he ru ka 'byung ba'o/ /slob dpon gzhan gyi lugs kyis zhabs g.yas bskum par 'dod/ /blo bzang gang zhig kyang ni gzhan du gar gyi rkang pa zer te bdag ni g.yon par 'dod/ /g.yon pas g.yon pa'i skye bo'i rgyan byas don kun ster bar nus/ /rgyal byed g.yon pas 'tshe ba kun spangs legs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de phyir cho ga'i thams cad dge ba'i g.yon pas gzung / /gang phyir bde mchog 'dren pas thams cad g.yon pa las byung brtsam 6/ /sems dang sems med 'gog pa dge ba'i lam du gang zhig brtags pa'i pad+ma la/ /rdo rje'i mtha' las byung ba mnyam 12—381

zhing ro gcig pa dang mtha' yas pa'o/ /phag mo mchog tu sbyor ba las byung skyes pa gang phyir gtso bor gnas/ /de phyir g.yon pa'i gzhi yis ༄lkubargyan pa mchog gi lha mo'i bde mchog go/ /zla ba nyi ma rnam dag srid par skyes pa'i rang bzhin ro dang bcas/ /pad+ma mchog tu byung ba snyeri bo las byung shin tu mnyam par ldan byung khu ba'o/ /de ni nam mkhar 'gro ma zhes/ /sangs rgyas khams su rnam par brtag /nam mkha' kun du spyod grub pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes mngon par brjod/ /des bskyed pa yi gzugs gang yin/ /gzugs can ma zhes mngon par brjod/ /gzugs su skye ba'i rim pa nyid/ /rtogs 1par gyur pa dum gyes ma/ /gang zhig mdzes par legs brjod pa/ /mi dang bud med sogs par byung / /mtshan nyid thams cad kun rdzogs pa/ /des na lā mar rab tu grags/ /bdud kun la sogs rnam par bral/ /de nas gzhal yas khang du grags/ /chos kyi dbyengs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /pad+ma sangs rgyas bzhi ge de'o / /rtag tu 'dod chags dang bral zhing / /gang du mtshan nyid bzhi spyor ba / /rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan/ /de ni dpa' bo zhes su gsungs/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /der ni dbang phyug legs par thob /lhan cig skyes pa dga' ba'i dngos/ /de ni dpa' bo'i dbang phyug gyur/ /gzhom med dpag tu med pa dga' ba bde mchog 'khor lo de ni sde tshan mtha'/ /rtag tu thur du phyogs pa 'di ni yan lag kun la yid du 'ong ba 'dzag /'dod chags la sogs rtswa 5dang 'dra ba 'bigs pa'i ye shes kyis zos so/ /rnam par mi rtog rang bzhin gyis/ /de ni kun rdzob myong ba'o/ /nam mkha'i pad+mar nam mkha'i dbus su mkha' spyod 'khor lo rol pa'i rang bzhin no/ /der gnas 12—382

shin tu rnam par brtags pa mkha' spyod 'khor lor legs par grags/ /bhu zhes pa ni sa'i dbus gnas skyes pa/ /lte ba'i pad+ma der gnas shin tu rnam par brtags pa sa spyod 'khor lo'o/ /sa 'og ces par gang bstan pad+mar byang chub lhang ba'o/ /phyi rol nges pa'i yid ni sa 'og gnas pa'i mtshan ma'o/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul rnams kyis/ /ho ru ka gzugs legs par gnas/ /ā li kā li yang dag ldan/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bas mdzes a yig sprul pa'i 'khor lo ru/ /pad+mo'i nang du legs par gnas/ /lhan cig skyes pas rol pa yis/ /'jig rten gsum kyi rgyan 1du grags/ /oṃ t+t+waṃ dīḥkhaṃ 'dab mar 4 māṃ ṭ+wāṃ t+t+waṃ mtshams kyi cha ru'o/ /dbus su he ru ka yi sa bon mchog gi sems ni pad+mar shin tu legs par gnas/ /chos sems pad+ma chen po la / /stong pa'i rdo rje rnam par gnas/ /der gnas rtag tu 'dzag pa ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun 'grub pa'o/ /de yi steng du longs spyod la ni phyag 'tshal 'og tu lta ba rtag tu blta/ /ā khra lhan cig o au mchog gi rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bor ldan/ /der gnas mgrin pa'i phyogs su ni/ /gang du mkha' 'gro ma rnams rol/ /der ni rtag pa'i dus mchod pa/ /mchog tu dga' bar legs par shes/ /haṃ ni bde chen 'khor lo ru/ /zla ba lta bu legs pa 'dzag/bgrod dang bgrod pa ma yin pa/ /der ni mig gis mthong ba min/ /twa ri ti na gyen du grags/ /bā t+pa phyogs su rnam par gnas/ /bi be+esgo 4ni dbus su gnas / /bi shrashra 5ni thur du grags/ /rgyu mthun pa dang rnam par smin/ /skyes bu de bzhin dri ma bral/ /'bras bu bzhi po 'di rnams dang / /dga' ba rnams su rab tu grags/ /chung ngu 'bring po chen po dang / /chen po yi yang 12—383

chen po ste/ /sems kyi dbye bas bzhi rnams su/ /mi la sogs pa rnams su rol / /pad+mar sprul pa'i 'khor lo thams cad sems kyi skad cig nges par 'byung / /sems kyi chos kyi rang bzhin 'dren cing rtag tu sdug bsngal sel ba rnam par smin/ /mgrin par gnas pa'i he ru ka mgon mang po rtog pa thams cad dpyod pa'i rang bzhin no/ /shes dang mi shes spyi bor gnas pa nga rgyal dang bral de ni rnam pa'i mtshan nyid rang bzhin no/ /skad cig bzhi po gang 'di skad cig gcig gis bskyed/ /'khor lor skad cig de ni gtso bo yin te gzhan ni mtha' yas dngos por 'gyur/ /me tog phreng dang tsan+dan bud med sogs/ /ji srid bltas pas bde bar gyur/ /de srid dga' bar legs par grags/ /sems can kun la legs par gnas/ /rdo rje pad+ma mnyam spyor bas/ /gang zhig sems ni rnam par gnas/ /de yi sems kyi mtshan nyid gang / /dga' ba chen po zhes su brjod/ /legs par sbyor las bral ba'i sems/ /bde ba'i mtha' ru legs par gnas/ /de bral zhes pa'i ming du gsungs/ /rnam par sel ba bskyed par grags/ /dga' dang mchog tu dga' ba dang / /dga' dang bral ba gsum pa ste/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin 'di/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi rang bzhin no/ /gang de lhan cig skyes de kun/ /bsam gyis mi khyab ces gsungs so/ /tshig med kun song zhi ba ste/ /ye shes he ru ka ru brjod/ /gzhan gdan zhes pa shes rab bstan/ /bdag gi gdan ni thabs yin te/ /'di dag gnyis med rang bzhin ni/ /spyor ba'i gdan du snarnam par gnas/ /de nyid bdag ni nges bskyed pa'o/ /de spangs pa yi dngos po ni/ /lhan cig skyes zhes yang dag gsungs/ /tshig lam spyod yul las 'das pa'o/ /bdag 72—384

gi de nyid rtag tu bsngags3sna/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid yang dag ldan/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa ni/ /lus dang 2rnam par gnas pa'o/ /dmigs pa'i dngos po sangs rgyas te/ /mi dmigs pa ni rdo rje 'dzin/ /gnas gnyis mnyam par dmigs nas ni/ /shes rab gnyis ni bstan pa'o/ /brtan 1sogs bcu ni sa rnams dang / /pha rol phyin pa bcu mchog go/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi dbye ba yis/ /lus kun la ni rnam par gnas/ /rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'di dag ste/ mgo dang / spyi gtsug dang / rna ba g.yas pa dang / rgyab kyi tshigs pa dang / rna ba g.yon pa dang / smin ma'i dbus dang / mig dang / dpung pa'i rtsa ba dang / nu ma gnyis dang / lte ba dang / sna'i rtse mo dang / kha dang / mgrin pa'i phyogs dang / snying ga dang / chu so dang /mtshan dang / bshang ba'i lam dang / brla gnyis dang / byin pa dang /sor mo dang / rkang pa'i bol dang / mthe bo dang / pus mo rnams su bdag po la sogs pa skye ba dang gnas pa dang / rab tu thim pa zhes so/ /pul+li ru ni bdag po ste/ /dzā lan+dha rar spyod pas gnas/ / o ḍān 4du ni thim pas gnas/ /stan la sogs pa'i gnas rnams phyasu/ /yan lag kun du thim gyur pa/ /bde mchog gi ni mtshan nyid do/ /sprul pa ru ni skyes pa ste/ /longs spyod pa ru gnas pa'o/ /chos kyi sku yi rang bzhin gyis/ /thim par gyur par som nyi med/ /de ltar sku rnams cha shas kyis/ /bdag po longs spyod thim pa'o/ /gnas su ji ltar de bzhin du/ /skye ba dang ni gnas pa nyid//thim par gyur pa'i rim pa yis/ /rtag tu dga' ba skye bar 'gyur/ /gnas byed pa yi sgo nas ni/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro bskul ba'o/ /dpal ldan dzā lan+ta 12—385

rar ni/ /skad cig de la bde bar 'gyur1/ /bde bar bskyed pa'i bsdus pa ni / /brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid do/ /de ltar te ru ka phag mo/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas dpa' bor ldan/ /de yi phyag sogs sangs rgyas te/ /khams kyi ming ni 'byung ba'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa rnam gnyis te/ /bud med skes pa la sogs brtag /thams cad yul du rab tu bstan/ /nam mkha' bdud rtsi'i ngo bo'o/ /de la spyod pa gang yin te/ /thams cad nam mkha' spyod par shes / /thams cad mkha' 'gro dra ba yi—/ /snying po bde mchog mchog yin te/ /'dir ni phreng med bzlas pa med4/ /lhan cig skyes par kun du gnas/ /de bas shin tu rtog bral bas/ /gus pa bskyed cing 'bad pa yis/ /'jigs dang 'dzem pa rtag spangs nas/ /rnal 'byor rol pas gnas par bya/ /'dir ni mya ngan 'das dang sbyin sreg rnal 'byor bsam bya dkyil 'khor la sogs pa/ /bum pa rdul tshon thig skud cho ga lus la lhan cig skyes nas zhe7rig par bya/ /gtsub shing gtsubs 6pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /ye shes me ni shin tu 'bar—/ /rlung gis bskyod par gyur pa las/ /lte ba'i pad+ma rnam par gnas/ /du ba rtag tu lha mo ste/ /legs 'bar lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas dang / /longs spyod 'khor lor gyur bsregs 7nas/ /thabs ni rab tu mchod byas nas/ /smin mtshams mdzod pur song gyur nas/ /o ḍān zhes ni bya ba yi/ /gnas kyi sgo nas 'phros nas ni/ /dzā lan+dha rar / rab tu zhugs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bsreg /yid kyi shugs ldan lha mo ni/ /mig gis mthong ba ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas snying ga na bzhugs khyab/ /bdud rtsi'i tshogs ni blang byas te/ /'o ma yi ni rgyun lta bur/ /72—386

gser gyi sgo ru rab tu zhugs/ /rkan gyi dbus nas 'dzag pa ni/ /longs spyod 'khor lor legs par gnas/ /zo chu'i 'khrul 'khor bzhin du ni/ /sngon du sems ni rnam par gnas/ /tha ma med par legs par bsreg /legs par sangs rgyas mnyes pa ste/ /yang ni 'dod dang ldan gyur nas/ /lte ba'i 'khor lor legs par 1gnas/ /'dir bzhugs yang ni 'gro ba dang / /'ong bar gyur pa de bzhin no/ /kun spyod mkha' 'go ma rnams kyi/ /'khor lo bde mchog las gsungs so/ /ldog pa yi ni mtshan nyid do/ /'di dag thams cad bdag gis —bshad/ /gang gzhan bde ba'i dngos grub ni/ /bla ma la gus de shes bya/ /sna tshogs sngags bzlas rnal 'byor mkhas pas kun gyi bdag nyid kyis legs mchod/ /'khor lo la gnas bla ma rdo rje dpa' bo'i tshogs dang legs pa'i rnal 'byor ma yi zhabs/ /nga rgyal bcas pas rgyud rnams kun gyi snying po'i gnas ni legs par brtags/ /phyi nas blo dang ldan pas sems can don 'dod rtsom pas dkyil 'khor brtsam/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi lha rnams ni/ /bri ba smad 'tshong gzhung yin no/ /te ru ka 'byung sogs las kyang / /dzā lan+ta ra sogs pa gsungs/ /'dus pa la sogs rgyud rnams kyi—/ /ming de ci yi phyir na 'gal/ /sngags pas 'khor lo sdom dkyil 'khor/ /bde mchog don du bri bar bya/ /slob dpon gyi 5ni mtshan nyid bstan/ /rgyud las ji ltar bstan par 'dod/ /g.yon pa'i lag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gzhan na cang te'u hūṃ sgrogs pa/ /yang dag ye shes rgyud shes shing / /he ru ka dpal gsang sngags shes/ /khro med gtsang la mkhas pa dang / /spyor shes ye shes pha rol son / /spyi bo las 6skyes thod pas brgyan/ /yan lag thal bas rjes su byug /bla 12—387

ma chen pos slob ma la/ /mchod pa la sogs de dag dri/ /dga' bas de ni smra bar bya/ /bdag gis thams cad tshogs par gyur/ /bza' dang btung ba la sogs pa/ /ras dang lha bshos thams cad ldan/ /dpa' bo lha mo mchod pa'i don/ /bdag gis cho ga byed par nus/ /dpa' bo chen pos de nas 'dir/ /shes rab yan lag gnyis med 'dus/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /'khor lo kun la rnam par gnas/ /mdun du gnas pa'i slob ma ni / /bsod nams ldan zhing blo dang ldan/ /thog mar srung 1ba byas nas ni/ /de nas sa ni rnam par brtag /rgyud las bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor gnas/ /khro bo'i 2snaspyor bas mnan nas kyang / /gnod mdzes gsang sngags bzlas nas ni//'bad pas bgegs ni bskrad par bya/ /slob ma mkhas pa legs par gzung / /bde ba'i mchog ni mnyes nus pa/ /bde mchog las gsungs bya ba ldan/ /sngon du phag mo la gus pa/ /bsod nams 'dod cing gtsang la mkhas/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri ba'i pha rol son/ /dga' zhing sdug pa yang yin te/ /de dang lhan cig legs par brtsam4/ /gtor ma sbyin sogs byin nas ni/ /te ru ka dang gnyis med gnas/ /bla ma dpa' bo legs mchod nas/ /sa bzhi 5 dag pa legs par brtsam6/ /ri phug nags kyis mkhregs 7pa dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du'am/ /sngon du grub pa'i dur khrod du/ /der ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /der ni phyi ba ma lhung bas/ /dkyil 'khor sa ni nye bar byug /dur khrod thal bar ldan pa dang / /bdud rtsi lnga dang mnyam ldan pas/ /sa de nye bar byug par bya/ /der ni dkyil 'khor brtsam par bya/ /bar ma mchog dang dbugs dbyung dang / /dri yi chu dang lhan cig pas/ /'bad pas 72—388

mnyam par brdung bar bya/ /sa ni mnyam zhing gtsang bar bya/ /dbus dang thog ma gang bstan pa'i/ /lhag ma'i bshad pa yang dag ldan/ /bla ma dam pa las shes bya/ /des shes gang de bzhin du min/ /shar dang byang du gzhol ba ni / /sngags pa 1rtag tu dngos grub 'gyur/ /dbus su mtho bas rgyal srid dang / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ /byang du mtho bas 'chi ba'am/ /yang na nor ni zad par 'gyur/ /ji skad bshad pa'i shar mtho bas/ /myur du rigs rnams zad par 'gyur/ /dbus su dma' ba'i sa gzhi gang / /sgrub pa po ni 'jigs par 'gyur/ /de ltar mtshan nyid bcas pa yi/ /dpa' bo'i dbang po sogs pas brtag /sa'i mtshan nyid do/ /mgul rgyan dang ni gdu bu nyid/ /rna rgyan spyi bo'i nor bu dang / /mchod phyir thogs dang thal ba ste/ /phyag rgya drug gis rnam par brgyan/ /mkha' 'go ma tshogs phyogs bzhi ru/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhag nas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag na 'dzin/ /rang gi gtso la gsol ba gdab/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor bdag po bshad du gsol/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad spangs pa ste/ /kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol—/ /sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag pa dri med pa //kun du bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol/ /gang zhig lag na thod pa dang / /chang la dga' bas myos pa rnams/ /spyod pa 12—389

gzugs can rnal 'byor ma/ /lha mo chen mo mnyes pa ste/ /khams kyi rang bzhin thams cad dam/ /de bzhin srog dang rtsa rang bzhin/ /rang lhag lha la rab phyogs pas/ /grub pa'i phyag rgya rab tu bsgyur/ /te ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /bsams nas bgegs ni rab tu gzhom/ /bgegs kyi tshogs ni gzhan rnams dang / /gdug pa'i tshogs ni bskrad par bya/ /rkang pa'i 'og tu dgod bya ba/ /rdo rje 'bar ba hūṃ las byung / /saṃ yig mig gnyis shes nas ni/ /zla ba nyi mar rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje dril bu blangs nas ni/ /g.yas na rdo rje yang dag ldan/ /blo dang ldan pas phyogs kun blta/ /khros pas sems can don la brtson/ /de ru gnas pa'i gdug pa dang / /bdud dang bgegs dang log 'dren dang / /de rnams bskrad pa'i don gyi phyir/ /tshig 'di dag ni brjod par bya/ /gang zhig sa yi bdag po rnams/ /klu dang gnod sbyin dri za sogs / /'byung po 'byung mo mkha' 'gro ma/ /sems can don du bya bar brtson / /myur du 'gro ba nyid du gyis/ /he ru ka yi bka' thos nas/ /myur ba nyid du bor nas ni/ /khyed rnams 'gro ba nyid du gyis/ /gal te 'gro bar mi 'gyur na/ /rdo rje 'bar ba kha ṭ+wāṃ gis/ /de yi mgo ni brgyar dgas 3 bya / /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛt+ta kṛṇ+ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kṛrje pa ya kṛt+tha pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga bān badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /g.yon du bskor ba la brtson pas/ /dpa' bo chen po khros pas bskor/ /bskal pa'i me ltar langs nas ni/ /de las byung ba'i 'od sogs kyis/ /bdud la sogs pa thams cad bsregs / /'di ltar sems pa'i rnal 'byor dag /hūṃ sgra bsgrags par 4gar byas te/ /mya ngan khro dang 72—390

'jigs pa med/ /de bzhin drag dang brtse hūṃb gnyis/ /rjes su chags ldan ro 'di dag /dang po zhal la legs par gnas/ /mi sdug pa dang ngo mtshar gang / /'jigs dang g.yo dang de bzhin du/ /rjes su chags gnas ro 'di yis—/ /g.yon pa'i zhal du gyur par gsungs/ /bzhad dang dga' ba dbang phyug dang / /bzhad 2pa dang ni sgog pa nyid/ /rjes su chags nas ro nyid dang / /de ni nub kyi zhal yin no/ /smod pa dang ni ngo mtshar nyid/ /brkam par gyur pa gang yin pa/ /dpa' bo 'jigs byed gnas 'di dag /g.yas kyi zhal la de dag gnas/ /pad+ma rdo rje dbus su ni/ /gang zhig sems ni legs gnas shing / /zhi ba de ni legs dag pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa dga' ba'i gar/ /gar ni chos kyi de nyid du/ /shes pa'i gar du je tshom med/ /'jig rten la phan rgyu yi phyir/ /'jig rten chos can gar bya'o/ /glang po che yi pags pa dang / /mdung dang zhags pa gri gug dang / /ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ dang / /thod pa dang ni zhags pa dang / /mgo bo rdo rje dril bu dang / /mgo bo lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang / /de rnams thogs pa'i snang ba'o/ /mgul rgyan thogs shing g.yon pa dang / /g.yas na gdu bu de bzhin du/ /rna rgyan rna ba la bkod cing / /g.yon gyi spyi bo nor bu dang / /g.yas pa yis ni thal ba dang / /mchod phyir thogs dang yang dag ldan/ /bde byed lta bu bya ba dang / /ri mo lta bu bya ba'o/ /pad+mo lta bu'i lag byas te/ /pad+ma lta bur gyur pa'o/ /ji srid ri mo lta bu yi/ /gar ni rnal 'byor ma lhan cig /zla ba gnyis po mi 'gyur ba/ /ḍa ma ru ni skyed byed pa'o/ /mtshan nyid bdag gis bstan pa'o/ /yongs su ldan pas blta ba'o/ /bde mchog don ni legs mthong nas/ /rnal 'byor ma 12—391

yi mtshan nyid dang / /gzhan yang gar dang dngos grub dang / /dkyil 'khor don dang cho ga bshad/ /de ltar bstan pa ni sasbra ra'i sgra zhes bya ba'o/ /cung zad ngo tsha'i mig zur gyis/ /he ru ka zhal 'o byed cing / /legs pa'i phag mo gar bya'o/ /kun+da zla ba dri med so/ /dmar 'od lta bu hūṃ sgrogs pa/ /khros pas bgegs kun rlag 1par byed/ /lhan cig skyes dga' rol pa yis/ /sems can don ni byed la brtson/ /de dang lhan cig dpa' bo che/ /'khor lo'i sa yi dbus su gnas/ /za ba'i phyag rgya la sogs pas/ /bgegs rnams kun ni bskrad par bya/ /ji srid gar gyi bstan bcos las/ /snying rje'i phyag rgya la sogs pa/ /he ru ka dpal phyag rgya ste/ /de ni dngos grub kun ster ba'o/ /zhal bzhi la sogs sngags kyis ni/ /phur bu ra ba dra ba dang / /ji bzhin sngon gyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /cho ga thams cad bya ba'o/ /de ltar go bgos bdag nyid ni/ /'og tu mtshon cha nges par gzhag2 /'khor lo lhan cig bdag nyid ni/ /steng du mda' ni bri ba'o/ /bdag nyid mkha' spyod dra ba ni/ /de ltar go bgos go dang ldan/ /sum cu gsum pas kyang mi phig /mtha' yi dbyangs yig las byung ba/ /sna tshogs rdo rje gzi brjid bzang / /des na rtag tu mi phig pa—/ /'bar ba'i gzugs su rnam par bsam/ /'dis ni hūṃ 'byung khro bo yis/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dgang bar 5bya/ /yi ge bdun pa bzlas pa yis/ /rdo rje'i lta ba kun du blta/ /sa gzhi dag par bltas nas ni / /bgegs rnams kun ni rnam par spangs/ /bdud rtsi lnga sogs legs par byug /blo bzang gis ni me tog gtor/ /mkha' 'go ma rnams yang dag ldan / /rdo rje sa dbus legs par gnas/ /dpa' bo rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /12—392

mnga' bdag he ru ka bsgom bya/ /'byung gnas sgra gzugs la sogs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor rigs 7snapas rnal 'byor dmigs/ /dpal ldan bde mchog 'khor lo che/ /dngos grub sa la brtsam par bya/ /ya sde brgyad pa'i sa bon ni2 / /stong pas steng du brgyan par bya/ /de ni lan gsum brjod byas te/ /sa la reg pas sa reg gnas/ /bkug nas mdun du blta bar bya/ /mdzes ma zhes bya'i ma mo ni/ /legs pa'i gzugs can legs gzugs des/ /te ru ka la dga' bas gsol/ /mgon po bdag gis ci zhig bgyi/ /rdo rje can bdag bka' stsol cig /khyed kyi dkyil 'khor don gyis na/ /bdag gis bum pa gzung bar bya/ /ma la sogs dang yang dag ldan/ /blo dang ldan pas thod pa gzhagarngu /cho gas mchod pa byas nas ni/ /ar+gha byin nas lhag par gnas/ /t+t+waṃ de bī ④sak+ṣi bhū tā yi sarba bud+dhā māṃ tā 3yi rna/ tsat+yā na ya bi she ṣe 6 byu 6mi pā ra mi ta su klutsa/ mā ra me+e bye ya thā bha ga — shākya sedhe na tā yi nā/ ta thā mā ra ba lam̐ dzi twa maṇ+ḍa rtse1/lo saṃ li kha ma haṃ/ lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis ni/ /mdzes ma dga' ⑩nas smras pa ni/ /kye mgon po khyod kyi bsod nams ni/ /dri med bsags pa bdag gis shes/ /da ltar khyod ni de phyir /rol thams cad khyod kyis sbyidabang du gnas/ /gang zhig bya ba de bka' stsol/ /bdag ni de dag byed pas spro/ /zhes pa'i tshig ni smras gyur nas/ /sa der thim par gyur par bsam/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs/ /sngags pas de nas byas pa'o/ /sa gzhi lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chu nyid kyis/ /sa ni legs par byugs par kimadzes /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug gnas/ /blo bzang gis ni maṇ+ḍal bya/ /sna 12—393

tshogs me tog dgram pa dang / /spos kyi dri yis legs bsgos te/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i spyor las byung / /legs pa'i 'khor lo der spyan drang / /'byung gnas sgra tshul la sogs pa'i/ /rnal 'byor sngon du dmigs nas ni/ /'khor lo'i gzugs bdag sbyor ba yis/ /gnas dang gnas su rnam par bsam/ /dpal ldan he ru ka sogs ldan/ /rnam pa kun gyi mtshan nyid gcig /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir sbyor ba/ /bde mchog dngos grub thams cad ster/ /lam la gnas shing 'bras bur gnas/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang phyug mdzes/ /yul la sogs pa gnas stan du/ /gsang ba spyan drang bsgom 1bya ste/ /ye shes 'khor lo mnyam spyor ba/ /dam tshig dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /ngo bo gcig pa'i legs dag pa/ /lhan cig skyes dga' shin tu mdzes/ /rkang pa mnan cing gyen du blta/ /gyen du dze gi sgra bsgrags shing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug /mdzub mo mdung byas gung mo nges par sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan por rab sbyor te/ /dpral ba'i dbus phyogs legs bzhag nas/ /phyag rgya mchog gis ma tshogs bskul/ /mkha' spyod la sogs mnyam ldan pa'i/ /ye shes 'khor lo shin tu mdzes/ /g.yon du bskor ba'i bye brag gis/ /bskor ba nyid kyis dgug par bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa yi/ /pad+ma blangs par gyur nas ni/ /sngags pas de nas ar+gha byin/ /zhabs bsil nyid kyi bye brag go/ /dri la sogs pas yongs bkang ba'i / / pad+ma bzhi pos legs par mchod/ /bdug spos tha dad nyid kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni bdug par bya/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa'i cho ga'o/ /12—394

gos dang phyag rgya lnga la sogs/ /shes rab yan lag phur bu dra/ /ā li kā li zhes brjod nas/ /rgyu sogs stong pa sngon 'gro dang / /'jug pa sgra la sogs pa nas/ /ji srid gsungs pa'i sbyor ldan pa'o/ /bdud rtsis tshim byed mya ngan 'das/ /lag pa'i mchod pa dbang bskur dang / /go cha chen pos legs par bsrung rmye / /sngags rnams kun gyis mchod pa ste/ /de ltar de nyid bcu bzhi ni/ /dus kun du ni legs par brtsam/ /bde ba'i stan las 'bad pa yis/ /shes rab yan lag stan gyi steng / /mgul rgyan gdu bu dpung rgyan dang / /rna rgyan tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / /mgrin par brgyan byas mgo bo'i phreng / /ska rags sil sil sgra sgrogs pa/ /ral pa cod pan dar dang ni/ /bcos pa'i skra yis rgyan du byas/ /rdo rje pad+ma kha ṭ+wāṃ bcas/ /ḍa ma ru sgra sgrogs pa dang / /dpa' bo kun dang rnal 'byor ma/ /go cha gsum gyis brgyan byas shing / /te ru ka dpal rgyal po che/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug nges par byas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bum pa lhag par gnas par bya/ /mgrin pa ring la lto ba che/ /mchu 'phyang rtsa ba rnam par spangs/ /kha dog gnag sogs spangs pa yi/ /bum pa bcu rgo bya ba'o/ /de rnams nang nas mchog gcig ni/ /phag mo ru ni rab tu brtag /dgra sta zhags pa de bzhin mdung / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yang legs par bri/ /de ltar glukhro bo'i rdo rje dang / /pad+ma'i lo ma sogs pas brgyan/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi chu nyid kyis/ /bkang zhing dri yis legs par byug /'bru dang rin chen sman rnams ni/ /so sor lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /lha mo'i sngags kyis bsngags pa yi / /me tog phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /ras bzang po yis mgul pa dkri/ /rnal 'byor ma tshogs gtso bo yis/ /rdo 72—39pya

rje phag mo'i bum pa che/ /sngags pas sems can don gyi rgyur/ /lho yi sgo yi g.yon du ni/ /'khor lo'i ri mo dang nye bar/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa gzhagasna /mkha' 'gro ma tshogs 2bum pa bzhi/ /de yi mtshan mas mdzes par bya—/ /ji lta'i gnas su bzhag nas ni/ /dri drug sogs pas legs par dgang / /bdud rtsi lnga yis legs bkang ba'i/ /thod pa'i mtshan ma gulegs par brtag /bum pa bzhi po gzhan rnams ni/ /'bad pas mtshams su gzhag 4par bya/ /las kun byed pa'i bum pa ni/ /he ru ka yi mtshan mas mtshan—/ /bi mu mā 5ra bid legs bkang / /bgegs kun rnam par sel bar byed/ /mchod nas 6gus pas gsol btab ste/ /lho yi sgo ru legs par gzhag7 /rtag tu rdo rjes gdug pa kun/ /myur ba nyid du sel bar byed/ /phyi rol bum pa'i mtshan ma gang / /thams cad ji ltar gsungs bzhin bstan/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor bum pa yi/ /mtshan nyid lus las byung ba'o/ /bum pa lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /lho ru mngon phyogs sngags pa ni/ /lha mo bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /he ru ka ma dang sbyor la/ /legs chags 'dzum bcas dga' zhing spro/ /bar ma mchog dang dbus dbyung dang / /me tog spos la sogs pa yis/ /g.yon pa'i spyod pa rtag spyod pas/ /bde mchog dpa' bo mchod par bya/ /g.yon pas blangs pa'i spos dang ni/ /mi yi sha dang ldan pa yis/ /bdugs 9par gyur nas sngags pa yis/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang dpal ldan te ru ka sogs nam mkha'i dkyil gyur mkha' spyod sa spyod dang / /sa 'og gnas bzhugs lhan cig skyes pa'i bde dang ldan pa stan dang tshasdo ha lha mo/ /dkyil 'khor gnas pa de 72—396

kun dus mtha'i me ltar spyod la dngos grub rgyur ni gsol ba btab/ /te ru ka dpal phag mor bcas/ /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul che/ /phyogs kun bzhugs pa dpa' bo dang / /byang chub sems dpa' bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po kun brnyes shing / /de rnams bzhugs par gyur pa rnams/ /che ge mo bdag rdo rje che/ /slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /sang ni dkyil 'khor 'dri 1bar 'tshal brtse bas bskyed par gyur nas ni/ /nye ba nyid du mdzad du gsol/ /dri zhim me tog legs par bsregs/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi thod pa ni/ /blangs nas spos bdug 'khor lo dang / /skye bo dam pa kun 'dus pa'o/ /lha lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o/ /dpa' bo lha mo dkyil 'khor bzang / /mchod cing gsol btab de nas ni / /phyi rol song nas slob ma bzang / /stobs chen me tog lag na thogs/ /brtson 'grus che ldan shes rab che/ /rigs dang ldan zhing nga rgyal med/ /bde mchog mnyes byed mkhas pa dang / /phag mo la gus snying du sdug /phyag rgya lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /thal ba yis ni byugs pa dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud kyi cho ga shes/ /rnal 'byor ma rgyud la dad pa'o/ /gang gang gus dang ldan pa yi//sngags dang rgyud la legs par bslabs/ /gzugs bzang shin tu mdzes brtson dang / /chang la dga' bas myos pa la/ /slob ma'i dbang bsgur don gyis ni/ /kun nas de la gsol ba gdab/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang shes na/ /'byung gnas la sogs rnam par bsam/ /mnyes byed rnam par dag pa dang / /gsal byed yon tan ldan pa'i mi/ /skyes pa'am bud med 'di don du/ /12—397

dpal ldan bde mchog las rab bstan/ /bde mchog lta bur rdzogs nas ni/ /gsol ba 'debs par rnam par bsam/ /dpa' bo khyod bdag rdo rje che/ /phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la gsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la gsol/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug rnams/ /phag mo dang ni he ru ka'i/ /gsang ba'i stan sogs legs par dag /gnas pa'i lugs ni bstan du gsol/ /slob ma'i gtso bo mdun byas te/ /me tog phreng 'dzin dag sems la/ /g.yon pas kun nas blta byas te/ /rab tu rgyas pa'i bzhin gyis smra1/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /khyod ni tshul chen snod yin pas/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya//rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba'i dpa' bo ni/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams/ /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /shes rab yan lag gnyis med chub/ /dpa' bos thams cad mkhyen pa thob/ /gsang sngags spyor ba mnyam med de/ /he ru ka dpal sogs mchog gis/ /bdud sde 'jigs pa chen po yi/ /stobs chen po ni gang gis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir/ /bu yis /blo gros 'di gyis shig /byang chub bsgrub pa'i don kyi rgyud/ / cho ga 8thams cad khyed la sbyin/ /de nas slob ma ser sna bral / /dpa' bo chen po rnam dag pa'i/ /bla ma la gsol dga' ba des/ /sdom pa mchog ni bdag la gsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang / /'khor lo gsum gyi rnam gzugs can/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams bye brag gis/ /12—398

dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug gang / /rgyal ba'i sras 'di thams cad la/ /kun la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dngos po kun gyi de nyid kyis/ /bla ma la ni skyabs su mchi/ /'dir ni dngos grub kun mdzad cing / /snying rje'i ro yis khengs gyur pa/ /dpal ldan he ru ka sogs dang / /lha mo kun gyes bdag bsrung mdzod/ /che ge mo bdag rtedapa' bo che/ /sems can kun la phan par dga' / /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dngos grub sbyin bdag bdag gyur cig /blo ldan ston pa'i khrag gis ni/ /de dag rnams la thig le bya/ /snying rje sems can don la brtson/ /de dag thams cad bsrung bar 'gyur/ /zhal gyis spyan ras gzigs blangs te/ /mgo yi steng du blugs par bya/ /slob ma 'di dag thams cad ni/ /bsrung bar gyur par 2the tshom med/ /lhag par gnas pa'i slob ma ni/ /'bad pas btang ste mnyam par gzhag /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang dgyes la/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod byas nas/ /bud med bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /phag mo'i nu ma 'tshir ba dang / /bza' dang bca' ba la sogs pas/ /kun kyis 'khor lo bde mchog mchod/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// //nang par dpa' bo chen po ni/ /lha mo bzhi dang mnyam ldan pas/ /phag mor sbyor bar legs gnas pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bar bya/ /khro med gtsang ma mkhas pa dang / /sbyor shes ye shes pha rol song / /thod pas spyi bo rab brgyan cing / /yan lag thal bas byugs pa dang / /sku la phyag rgya drug la sogs/ /rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lag na thogs / /phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyis brgyan/ /he ru ka yi bdag nyid byas/ /12—399

'khor lo snying gar bsam byas te/ /de ltar bdag nyid go bgos shing / /sngags dang phyag rgyas brgyan byas nasakyi/ /dngos grub chen po rab ster ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa bri bar bya/ /de nas ro yi skud pa ni/ /khrag chen po yis brlan byas te/ /he ru ka dpal go 'phang mchog /dkyil 'khor 'jigs pa thig gdab pa'o/ /khru gang pa'am khru gnyis pa/ /yang na bzhi pa dag kyang rung / /bcu gnyis pa'am bcu drug las/ /lhag pa yongs su mi brtag go/ /de las gzhan du brtags na ni/ /slob dpon ye shes dman gyur pa / /gang du sdig can mi 'gro ba'i/ /'jigs pa'i dmyal bar de 'gro 'gyur / /mkha' 'gro ma sogs rang gzugs su/ /skad cig tsam gyis legs par byung / /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i dbye ba yis/ /ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i thig /de bzhin du yang gang gsungs pa/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi ye shes che/ /thig gi dbus su gyur par dgod/ /'di dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang chen dam pa rmad du byung / /mig tu dzaḥ2las nyi zla bsam/ /he ru ka dpal bdag nyid gnas/ /'bar ba'i blta ba legs bkug nas/ /rang rang thig la gzhug par bya/ /te ru ka sogs 'khor lo bzang / /shes rab thabs dang mnyam ldan pas/ /phyi rol stan gnas bkug nas ni/ /thig gi dbus su rnam par bsam/ /rtsa sogs pa yi gsang sngags dang / /snying po nye ba'i snying po yis / /me tog ldan pa'i khrag gis byug /rnal 'byor rig pas thod par gzhag4 /thig sgud legs par mngon par bsngags/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi sngags kyis bsrung 5/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /kha dog lnga pa cho ga ldan / /thig skud de ni gcig tu bsgril/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis 72—400

brlab—/ /dpal lha dngos grub kun byed cing / /chos kyi gnas te dri ma med/ /bla ma phreng ldan gyis blangs nas/ /g.yon pas slob ma la byin bya/ /gnyis med rnam pa'i spyor ba yis/ /'khor lo'i gtso bo 1bsgril bar bya/ /legs bsgril slob ma la btang nas/ /dza dza zhes pas mdun du gnas/ /de nas slob mas kyang brjod pa/ /rang gis kyang ni dza dza brjod/ /bla ma slob mas blangs nas ni/ /phag mo'i spyor bas legs par gnas/ /dang po'i las can sngags pa yis/ /dpa' bo'i dkyil 'khor thig gdab po/ /ye shes cung zad thob pa yis/ /khye'u bzang dang bu mo la/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma phab nas/ /thig gdab phyir na gsol ba btab/ /de yis 'khor lo bde mchog bzang / /stan sogs pa yi lha mo kun/ /lhan cig skyes dang yang dag ldan/ /mdzes par gsal bar mthong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa/ rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang / /tshon rtsi dag ni dgye ba dang / /sngags kyi sems pas mi bya ste/ /byas na byang chub rnyed par dka'/ /de bas dam tshig cho ga shes/ /sngags kyi lha rnams bcug nas ni/ /byin rlabs go gor bsams byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni rab tu brtags3/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal chen po/ /mā ma khri ni dbab par bya/ /de nyid sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba mchog ste rmad du byung / /rang nyid mkhas par gyur pa yis/ /de ltar byas na nye bar 'gyur/ /byon par gyur nas gsang ba'i mchog /mnyes par ldan pas 'di dag bri/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa / ji bzhin 'khor lo'i ji bzhin gnas/ /ji bzhin bkod pa 'gro ji bzhin/ /'khor rnams bsdu bar gyur nas ni/ /de ltar 'khor lo mchog rnams spro/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems 12—401

dpa'i lha/ /'khor lo mngon sum mthong gyur pa/ /phyi nas bris par gyur pa yang / /ji bzhin bsod nams brtag pa'o/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa/rdo rje sgra chen de dang des/ /thig gis thig gdab legs par gnas/ /mtha' yas zhing na thub dbang zla ba rnams/ /'dir ni sems can don kyi dus la bab//thog mar sngags pa yi dwags blta/ /'khor lo sa yi byang du gnas/ /nam mkha'i sa la gdab bya ste/ /blo ldan thig ni g.yon pas ①bskor/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su tsatra mā ti kra ma hūṃ/ /phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa/ /sems can don phyir de bzhin gshegs/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma'i//lha mo'i thig gi sgra yis bsgul/ /shar du gnas nas nub bltas te/ /tshangs thig gnyis pa yang gdab bo/ /me ru gnas nas nub tu zhal/ /lho yi phyogs su thig gdab po/ /nub phyogs gnas nas shar du blta/ /byang gi phyogs kyi thig gdab po/ /bskor nas slob dpon rlung gnas te/ /lho ru mngon par phyogs gyur nas/ /nub kyi cha ru legs par gdab/ /byang du mngon phyogs sngags pa ni/ /me yi gnas su rnam gnas te/ /shar gyi cha yi thig brtsam mo/ /dbang ldan mer gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /mtshams kyi thig ni gdab par bya/ /phyogs la sogs pa'i dbye shes nas/ /thig gdab pa ni legs par brtsam/ /tshangs thig dang po dbus su ni/ /thig bzhi rnams ni gdab par bya/ /thugs dang gsung dang sku 'khor lo/ /rdo rje phreng ba la sogs bya/ /kha sbyor dbus su ri mo lnga/ /blo dang ldan pas zlum por bya/ /ri mo bzhi po gzhan rnams ni/ /rdo rje phreng ba la sogs bya/ /dma' bas nad de chad pas zad/ /yo bas dngos grub med par 'gyur/ /g.yas su bsdu ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /slob ma 12—402

rnams ni brlag par 'gyur/ /'khor lo nyis 'gyur ring ba ste/ /sgo yi nyi shu'i char gyur pa/ /te ru kar bdag 'dug nas nikhya/ /thig skud kyis ni thig gdab po/ /zur bzhi pa dang sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni rnam par brgyan—/ /sa 'og gnas pa'i lha mo rnams/ /'khor lo'i phreng ba sogs pas bskor—/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /'phan dang me tog phreng bas bskor—/ /mtshams kyi cha ni thams cad dang / /sgo khyud kyi ni mtshams rnams su—/ /rdo rje rin chen gyis brgyan par/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig gdab po//de yi dbus su pad+ma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar bcas/ /phyi rol rdo rje phreng bas bskor/ /'phro ba'i rdo rje'i tshogs sprul pa'o/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad legs par bri/ /dngos grub kun dang yon tan gzhi zu/ /phyi rol du ni nag pos bskor/ /ming ni mkha' spyod ces bya'o/ /rtsibs brgyad la sogs 'khor lo ste/ /pad+ma'i ka ba'i phreng gis bskor/ /sa 'og gnas pa'i lha mo ni/ /'khor lo'i phreng bas dang por 1bskor/ /rtsibs kyi mtshams su rdo rje ni/ /mnyam gzhag dhirnal 'byor pa yis bri/ /'khor lo phreng ba'i mthar thug par/ /'bar ba'i ri mo de bzhin no/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /'khor lo'i dbus su legs gnas nas/ /hi sgrogs khro bo'i lta ba yis/ /de nas sgo ni dbye bar bya/ /sgo ni 'khor lo'i brgyad cha ste/ /kha khyer dag ni yangs rngupa'o /sgo khyud dang ni sgo yi tshad/ /lha yi snam bu'ang de bzhin no/ /kha khyer kun nas sgo yi phyed/ /'gram dang logs dang de bzhin no/ /dra ba dra phyed nyi zla dang / /'phan dang me tog phreng bas spras/ /tshon gyi sa rgo de yi phyed/ /rtsa ba'i thig gi sa yi rgyab/ /rdo rje la sogs ka ba yi/ /sa ni tshon kyi sa dang mnyam/ /12—403

rta babs sgo las sum 'gyur te/ /'phan dang dril bu dang ldan pa/ /dril bu rlung gis bskyod pa yi/ /'phan ni phyi rol mtshams su'o/ /dang por nam mkha'i thig yin no/ /de yi 'og tu ye shes thig /phyogs kun mnyam par bgrod nas ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi cho gas gdab/ /lugs byung lugs bzlog pa 'dis ni/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig yin no/ /de bzhin nang gi bdag nyid lus/ /tshogs pa las byung mgon po yis①/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor thig gdab po/ /lhan cig skyes shing rang bzhin dag /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ldan/ /phyi dang nang gi thig gdab pa'i cho ga'o —/ / // rjodur khrod rus pa legs par blang / /thal ba lo ma la ①so phag dang / /ba bla dag dang ldan pa yis/ /legs bris te ru ka 'khor lo/ /thod par rdul tshon bzhag nas ni/ /blo bzang thig gdab cho gas so/ /'bar ba'i lta ④bas bkug nas ni/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i snying po gzhug /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /gsang sngags nyid kyis mngon bsngags te/ /dpal ldan he ru ka rgyal bdag /'khor lo'i dbus su legs par gzhug0 /dur khrod las byung thams cad ni/ /dbang phyug mchog gi phyag rgya'o/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dbye ba yis/ /rdul tshon bri ba brtsam par bya/ /lag pa g.yon pas me phyogs nas/ /blo dang ldan pas g.yon du bskor/ /dkar po ser po de bzhin du/ /dmar mo rte ljang gu de bzhin nyid/ /lha mo bzhi dang mnyam ldan zhing / /dpa' bo bzhis ni bskor ba'o/ /dag cing bar du nas kyi tshad/ /ri mo lnga po bri bar bya/ /ji lta ba bzhin du gsungs pa/ /12—404

sgo yi nyi shu cha ru ni/ /mnyam par dgyes pas bri bar bya/ /sbom pas nad ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phra ba yis khye/ni nor zad cing / /yon po yis ni rnam par sdang / /chad pas slob dpon slob ma 'chi/ /g.yas su bskor nas bris pa yis/ /rdul tshon rnams ni mthu med 'gyur/ /lho yi sa ni nag po ste/ /shar ljang de bzhin byang du dmar/ /nub phyogs sa 1ni ser po bri/ /gsang sngags rim pas yid 'ong bar/ /dbus su pad+ma'i 'dab ma ni/ /phyogs kyi mdog tu brtag 1par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma ④yi 'khor lo 'byung / /he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor bya/ /sngon po dmar po dkar po che//thugs gsung sku yi 'khor lo'o/ /gzhan ma thams cad ci mdzes par /phyi rol rta babs bri bar bya/ /lha mo chen mo dang ldan pa'i/ /dpa' bo lte bar dgod par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs yang dag ldan/ /te ru ka rdor 'dab ma la'o/ /de bzhin khā sogs lha mo rnams/ /te ru ka sogs yang dag ldan/ /sgo dang mtshams kyi cha rnams su/ /sngags pas mnyam par bzhag pas bri/ /phyi rol yi dwags gnas de bzhin/ /srin mo la sogs yang dag ldan/ /'od zer 'phro zhing kha gyes pa'i/ /rdo rje rta babs steng du'o—/ /rdul tshon bkye bas rnam mdzes pa'i/ /phyi rol kyi ni dkyil 'khor bstan/ /bla ma mnyes byas blo ldan pas/ /nang gi bdag nyid rnam shes bya/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sbyor ba yis/ /rdul tshon bri ba skyon yin no/ /lhan cig skyes dga' rol pa yis tshode/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis bdag nyid bri/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs rtsom pa yi67/ /rlung la sogs pa byung ba na/ /te ru ka dpal bdag sbyor bas/ /gdug tsupa thams cad bsal bar bya/ /phyi 12—405

dang nang gi tshon dgye ba'i cho ga'o// //bu yi ①thog ma'i ye shes rnams/ /rtsibs su kha dog bzang po gang / /bsam gtan de yi 'od zer kyis/ /ye shes 'khor lo mnyam par dgug /lha mo'i tshogs ni du ma dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che/ /de nyid yang dag rin chen brgyan/ /gzhan pa'i dpa' bo stobs chen ②rnams/ /rtag tu rgyud las byung cho gas/ /'khor lo bde mchog blo ldan pas/ /yang na sarba budha sogs/ /rgyud las mchod pa'i cho gas mnyes/ /dkar po ser po de bzhin dmar/ /ljang gu dang ni nag po nyid/ /gcig tu me tog phyag rgya ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rang bzhin/ /rgya skyegs ba bla rams mchog dang / /tshon sna lnga la rjes su bcos/ /dkar po lnga yi rang bzhin rgyas/ /mnyam par mchod pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /khams kyi rang bzhin thams cad dang / /de bzhin srog dang rtsa rang bzhin/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dri dang ldan/ /sngon bzhin mnyam par 'grub par 'gyur/ /tsan+dan gnyis dang ri dwags skyes dang ga pur bcas/ /sha la ka dang na ga'i spos ni bu ram ldan/ /las kun rab sgrub ①spos la sogs/ /gu gul sa rdza ra dang ga bur dang / /ri dwags las skyes spos rnams ni/ /rdzas 'di rnams ni bcos pa yi/ /mar khus sbar ba'i snang ba bya/ /tsan+dan gur kum pri kwa dang / /ga bur ri dwags las skyes spos/ /bcos shing gdug par thugrub pa'i ras/ /phyag rgya bzang po'i ras yin no/ /kak+ko la dang e le dang / /musta rka dang ga pur dang / /ri dwags las byung ba yi dri/ /'di rnams zhib mor btags nas ni/ /seng ldeng ri lur dgod par bya/ /twa 12—406

ga 'dab ma lo dha dang / /ma ri tsa dang ga pur rnams/ /rab tu bsten par bya ba'o/ /sa hā kā ri'i ①mar khu ldan/ /kha la bsgos pas duzhes su dran/ /de 'og gtor ma'i mchod pa sbyin/ /rnam par bsgyings ma bcos pa'i chang / /chang dang bdud rtsi de bzhin no/ /dpa' bo gcig dang rgun 'bru dang / /glad pa dang ni bi ṭa dang / /rtse ṭi rnams ni de bzhin no/ /lan tshwa la sogs ro rnams kun/ /sha ka ra sogs bdud rtsi 'dra/ /thams cad bdag nyid ros dngos grub/ /ma lus lus pa med pa sgrub④/ /sna tshogs ston mos dngos grub ni—/ /chang dang sha dang yang dag ldan/ /'dod pa nye bar longs spyod dang ④//skal bzang che mchog rab tu 'grub/ /pa kwa'i 'bras bu pa na sa/ /rgun 'bru budang ni na le ka⑥ /a lu ka la sogs pa yi/ /'bras bu'i phyag rgya 'di gtan du—/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras bur spro/ /sha ka ra dang sbyar rtsir byug /a mra'i rus pa rnams la byug /sa ha ka ri'i ghu mar khu sogs/ /mnyam pa'i dri ru rab tu gyur/ /ji ltar rigs par rjoshun pa sogs/ /ba bla rgya skyegs kyis btsos te/ /mchod pa'i dus su dbul bar bya/ /lus skyes pa dang yang dag ldan / /phyi rol mchod pa bdag gis bstan/ /legs par mchod par mnyes byas te/ /phyi rol song ste gtor ma sbyin/ /gcer bu skra grol gyur pa dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs legs gnas te/ /chang dang sha dang yang dag ldan/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs la 'bul ⑨lo/ /'byung gnas la sogs rnal 'byor che/ /blo dang ldan pas spangs byas shing / /lho ru mngon par phyogs byas te/ /gnas ni mthon por rnam par gnas/ /g.yon pas g.yas pa'i rkang pa mnan/ /gyen du lta ⑩bas bltas nas ni/ /'bar ba'i phyag rgya yang dag ldan/ /phe 12—407

brjod pa yi bdag nyid can/ /oṃ a rakhri ho dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ①sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ byu ho/ gcig dang lnga dang de bdun du/ /sngon du gsang sngags brjod par bya/ /dam tshig rdzas dang yang dag ldan/ /thod pa'i nang du rnam par bsam/ /rdo rje thal mo gyen kha dbye/ /phreng ba'i phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug kun/ /lam la gnas rnams mnyes pa'o/ /phyogs skyong yi dwags 'byung po la/ /mnyam par bzhag nas gtor ma sbyin/ /kha kha la sogs sngags 'di yis/ /'dod pa thams cad bsgrub dupa'o oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sā 1byu ta pre ta pi shā tsi a da a pa smra rjor badz+ra ḍā ki t+yā ⑤da ya/ i oṃ ba bo kṛṇ+ḍan+tu sarba sirnyim+me pra yats+tshan+tu ya dze+e rjobaṃ ya the ṣ+ṭi bhu ⑦ dza tha pi pa tha mā 2ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sah+phu kha bi shud+dhā ⑨ye sa ha yi kā bha ban+tu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gtor ma byin nas de'i 'og tu/ /sngags pas spyad dang bza' ba brtsam/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ldan/ /snying rje'i stobs kyi sbyor ba can/ /rdo rjes mtshan cing khro bo'i gzugs can ro yi kha ni gdangs pa spyi bor zla ba phyed pas bcings/ /yid 'ong dril bu'i sgra yis mdzes shing sna tshogs mang pos bu'aphyang ba'i rgyal mtshan tshogs/ /brgyan pa'i drag po'i sgra dang sna tshogs mang po'i me tog gis mtshan phreng ba bcings/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni 'bar ba mchog tu dga' ba bskyed pa rdo rje rnal 'byor pas gzung ngo / /dpal ldan rdo rje lha mo de rjes bla ma mchog dang he ru ka 'khor mgon po la phyag 'tshal—/ /slob ma bzang po yon tan mchog ldan dang ni mchod pa kun gyi bye brag blangs nas ni/ /g.yas na 'khrol ba'i legs pa'i ḍa ma ru ni dri med hūṃ sgogs dga' ba'i mchog /slob dpon rol pa mdzad pas nges par dkyil 12—408

'khor khang pa'i dbus su 'jug /lho yi sgo ru song nas ni/ /lhag ma rnams su yongs su bskor/ /lha mo rgyud gsungs rim pa'o/ /rnal 'byor rgyud rigs ①shar sogs nas/ /lho yi sgo ru 'gro ba ni/ /gang bstan bde bar gsungs pa yi①—/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar brtag pa ni/ /kun rdzob don du rtogs par bya/ /phyogs ni mtha' yas cha shas kyis/ /lho la sogs pa brtags na ni / /lho yi zhal ni gang yin nyid/ /rnal 'byor pas ni kun rdzob nyid/ /dang por dpa' bo drug dang lha mo'i bkod pa srung ④ba'i 'khor lo bya/ /sngags kyis mngon bsngags ⑤cho ga ldan pas dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa de nas bya/ /bde ba'i stan la 'bad pa yis/ /shes rab yan lag stan kyi steng / /dkyil 'khor sa yi dbus su ni/ /sngon du bstan pa'i mtshan nyid ldan/ /mdzes pa'i gser dang rin chen kun/ /dkyil 'khor la ni gtor bar bya/ /sha chen po dang yang dag ldan/ /gnas brgyad du ni legs par bdug /mar khu chen po dang ldan pa'i—/ /mar me brgyad ni dbul bar bya/ /me tog sna tshogs rnam par dgram//sna tshogs dri yis legs par bsgo/ /sgo bzhi ru ni dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis med gnas/ /lus la phyag rgya lnga la sogs/ /mgo bo lnga yis mtshan pa dang / /gang yang gcer bu'i gos dang ni/ /chang la dga' bas myos pa'o/ /thams cad ral pa'i bucod pan bcas/ /srud dang bza' ba mchog tu brtson/ /mtshams kyi cha ni gzhan rnams su/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ldan/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam 'khyud cing / /nu ma 'tshir ba la brtson pa'o/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo'i bdag po ni/ /dpal ldan 'khor los ⑦sgyur legs gnas/ /lha mo bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /phag mo'i 12—409

zhal la'o byed pa'o/ /la la glu yis glu len cing / /la la gar byed rnal 'byor pa/ /la la bzhad pa rab tu byed/ /bza' dang spyod pa la chags pa'o—/ /la la rdza yi rnga brdung dang / /bkra shis glu ni sna tshogs kyis/ /'khor lo bde mchog bde ba 'ang/ /dpa' bo chen po la mchod do/ /thams cad dpa' bo drug dang ldan/ /rnal 'byor mas ni rgyan du byas②/ /go cha la sogs yang dag ldan/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor legs par gnas/ /de ltar go bgos bdag nyid ni/ /sum cu gsum pas kyang mi shigs/ /he ru ka la spro byas nas/ /bza' dang ston mo legs par brtsam/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang dpa' bo dang dudabang phyug ma la mchod pa'i cho ga'o/ /dam tshig 'khor lo drug pa ni/ /ye shes 'khor lo ④yang dag ldan/ /sems kyis kha sbyor byas pa ste/ /gyen du lta bas bltas nas ni/ /sngon du spyan drangs ⑤phyag rgyar bcas/ /sngags dang tse sgogs sbyar rjob yis mtha' yas phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /lha rnams mnyes nas dngos grub ster⑦/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ldan/ /sngon gyi mtshan ma sogs pas brgyan/ /'jig rten mgon po snying brtse can/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gshegs par 'gyur—/ /gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub thob/ /dkyil 'khor he ru ka yi zhing —/ /byin rlabs go 'phang yid 'ong bar/ /byed pa som nyi med pa'o/ /phyi dang nang gi ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drang ba'i cho ga'o// //phyi dang nang gi sems kyis ni/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo mchod/ /rang 'byung phyagi ni me tog nyid/ /bu sogs gnas na legs par bzhugs/ /12—410

de yis gdong ni bskus nas ni/ /gang yang gzhan pa'i 'khor lor gnas/ /gnyis med gnyis su med sngags kyis/ /mngon par bsngags nas byin gyis brlab—/ /mkha' 'go ma yi gsang sngags kyis/ /sgo dang sgo ru byin gyis brlab—/ /brgyad brgya mchog tu bzlas pa ni/ /mnyam gzhag 1sngags pa nyid kyis bya/ /ā li kā li bzlas nas ni/ /phyi nas dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab/ /'jigs pa'i sgra ni mang po dang / /'jigs pa'i lha mo'i lus bzang ba/ /khyim lnga yi ni lha mo mchog /byon par gyur nas mdun du bzhugs/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub ni/ /rgya chen ster bar the tshom med/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa/ rtag tu de ni mchi ma 'byung / /bdag nyid las byung zas de bzhin—/ /rdo rje la ni 'gom mi byed/ /de bzhin gcer bur gyur pas mchod//g.yon pa'i dbang phyug thams cad kyis/ /'di de phyag rgya'i tshogs kyi rim/ /bza' dang spyad pas yang dag 'grub/ /mgrin pa legs bzung sgrub pa po/ /rang gnas song nas de mnyes shing / /rnal 'byor ma rnams grub 'dod pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul che rtogs sngags pa ni/ /te ru ka ni mchog tu skye/ /yang na mkha' spyod 'khor lo dang / /sa spyod la sogs yang dag ldan/ /brtse zhing te ru kar gyur nas/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa'o/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas zhing bskor nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mchod par 'gyur/ /yang na bsod nams zhan pa'i phyir/ /dkyil 'khor gnas pa ma grub na/ /sems can don la gcig tu brtson/ /bza' dang spyad pa brtsam pa'o/ /bzhad dang sgeg pa la sogs ldan/ /glu dang gar gyis dga' ba'o/ /sna tshogs sten mos dpa' bo dang / /rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod par 'gyur/ /gar gyi bstan bcos 12—7 1/

thams cad ni/ /byed pa'i phyag rgya la sogs pa/ /de ni te ru ka dpal rgya rmye/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /nang gi bdag nyid sbyin sreg gis⑤/ /dpa' bo lha mo legs par mchod/ /dpal ldan bde mchog yang dag langs/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu ster/ /zhi ba'i btung bar gyur pa'i sems/ /rtag pa mchog gi go 'phang ngo / /zhi ba'i btung ba gzhan ma ni/ /chang dang sha sogs yang dag ldan/ /oṃ sarba budhe ḍā ki nī kyesarba bha k+ṣ-i sho dha ya gu h+ya badz+re be+e hūṃ swā hā/ mngon par bsngags nas byin gyis brlab/ /yang na lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs/ /bza' ba kun sogs rnal 'byor pas/ /shes nas kha zas bza' ba blo ldan rnal 'byor pa mos pas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i lto ba thab khung lte ba'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad ni/ /lte bar dga' bar 'byung ba shin tu 'jigs pa'i he ru ka yi zhal/ /nges par 'dab mas dkris pa chen po lha mo'i pad+ma thod par ni/ /de yi rjes su 'khor lo gsum dang sgo skyong rnams dang ldan/ /sna tshogs mang ba'i ro ster bgyes byepa dpal gyi bdud rtsi sogs/ /sna tshogs ⑤ mchog gi sreg rmerdzas kyis ni phung po'i bud shing rab 'bar ba/ /skad cig gyur pa kun mkhyen me yi rang bzhin la/ /sngags pa bzang pos rtag tu 'di dag der ni sbyin sreg bya/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa/ rdo rje nang gi bdag nyid nyon/ /ji ltar sbyin sreg rab 'grub pa/ /'bar ba chen po gzi brjid che/ /rnam par mi rtog pa ru bsreg ⑦ /bza' ba btung ba gang cung 1zad/ /de dag thams cad mkhas pas bsreg /ji ltar bstan pa'i yam shing ni/ /gzugs phung la sogs rang bzhin dag /rnam par mi rtog pa yis bsreg /gang zhig sems ni rang bzhin kun/ /khu ba khrag dang de bzhin sha /bshang dang gci ba 72—412

lnga pa ste/ /rnam par mi rtog pa yis bza'/ /rang bzhin med pa'i blo ldan pas / /de bzhin nga rgyal gti mug che/ /zhe sdang 'dod chags de bzhin du/ /phrag dog ser sna phra ma ste/ /dam tshig bsten pa dri ma med/ /de nyid bzang por mnyam sbyor bas/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor lhan cig skyes/ /gtor ma la sogs gang cung zad/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lor sbyin sreg bya/ /mtshan mo skra grol gyur pa dang / /gcer bus phyi rol gtor ma sbyin/ /sngon du bstan pa'i cho ga yis/ /lam la gnas shing gzi brjid che/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bor ldan/ /gtor ma byin pas mnyes par 'gyur/ /sems can bsam pa dang mthun par/ /phyi rol gyi tshoni sbyin sreg bshad/ /rnal 'byor rgyud dpal las bstan pa/ /lus kyi 'khor lor sbyin sreg bya/ /gang phyir lus kyi — sangs rgyas ni/ /dam tshig des na de bsreg bya/ /rten dang brten pa pad+ma'o/ /dbus su sbyin sreg bya ba'o/ /sha dang bdud rtsi bza' ba ste/ /chang ni btung bar yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin du yang gsungs pa/ phung po'i bud shing skyib pas brlan zhing g.yogs pa yang 4 /ye shes me ni byed pa'i rlung gis bskul bas de/ /du ba 'byung zhing me lce 'bar ba nyid kyis bsreg /khyab cing rgyal ba de ni chos kyi dbyings su mthong / /lus kyi sbyin sreg yang dag ldan/ /phyi rol sbyin sreg gis mnyes te/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi la sogs bsten phya/ /phyi rol sbyin sreg yang dag brtsam/ /khru gang tsam gyi thab khung gyur/ /thod pa lta bus mdzes pa'o/ /lho ru kha bltas cho ga yis/ /de la kha bltas bskor bas 'grub/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad ni—/ /ri yi steng na legs par gnas/ /pad+mar dgra sta de bzhin zhags/ /12—413
