0446༄༅/ /grub pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sidhi badz+ra yo ga be+e sā dha rgo2/ bod skad du/grub pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /gzi byin bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /khams gsum rang bzhin bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi ni/ /sgrub 4thabs mchog ni mdor bsdus pa/ /rjes gnang gcig gi spyod yul te/ /bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag bshad/ /dang por re zhig sngags pas bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dag la mi phyed pa'i gus pa'i yid can/ byang chub kyi sems brtan por bzung ba/dbang bskur ba yang dag par thob pa chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar lhag par mos pa byas te/ rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ dur khrod la sogs pa dben pa'i sa 5phyogs su shin 72——5pya3

tu 'jam pa'i stan la rnal 'byor gyi rol pas gnas su u rgyan 1gyi yul du kha bltas te 'dug nas/ de'i rjes la lus dang ngag dang yid dag par bya ba'i phyir / lha rdzas kyi btung ba sbrang ngam bu ram bdud rtsi sbyar ba las byung ba ste/rnam pa gsum po ji ltar rnyed pa bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa mchod yon gyi snod du bzhag ste/ yi ge gsum mngon par bzlas nas/ btung ba de lag pa g.yon pa nas brtsams te yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag thams cad la sngags kyis khrus bya'o / /de nyid kyi mchod pa'i rdzas rnams kyang bsang bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la / oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ/ ho mo/ hri 2hri/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi yi ge 'di rnams kyis/ lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams yang dag par spangs 4te/ dag pa brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bha ba shudheḥsat+tha dhas+thāḥswa bhā ba shusgolha5haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shudheḥsarba dhas+thā badz+ra shusgolha6haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shubheḥsadze+e dhas+thā yo ga shuzlopho7haṃ/ de nas rang gi lus khams gsum rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas khang du bsams nas skad cig gis lte ba'i dkyil du rdo rje phag mo phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang ka pā la dang / kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ dbu skra grol ba/gcer bu spyan gsum ma 8ste/ na tshod gsar pas mdzes pa la/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi 9cod pan che/ /skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ni/ /zla nyi me yi dbus na bzhugs/ /dza ba sin+tu ra yi mdog /'di 'dra'i gzugs 'chang lha mo ni/ /rnal 'byor rigs pas rtag tu bsgom/ /de yi g.yas ni phag gdong ste/ /de bzhin g.yon pa'i khro mo'i zhal/ /kun rdzob dang ni don dam gnyis/ /zhal ni gnyis su rab tu brjod/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /rim pa rgyas par shes par bya/ /de yi pad+ma'i nang 72—554

gnas pa'i/ /'khor lo don kun grub gsol ba/ /yon tan gsum brgyan mtshan ma ni/ /'od chen kha dog shin tu 'bar/ /sngags kyi yi ge legs par gang / /rdza mkhan 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor/ /srin po'i zhal ni legs bsdams nas/ /me ni kun nas sbar bar bya/ /g.yung drung 'khyel pa 'khor ba yi / /dkyil 'khor phag gdong nye bar blta/ /phyag rgya gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /'jig rten gsum yang sgrub par byed1/ /skad cig rnam pa'i rnal 'byor dag /rnal 'byor 'grub 'gyur gzhan du min/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gsang sngags btu ba'i cho ga mchog /dkyil 'khor gru gsum nyams dga' bar//rdo rje a ral+li las byung / /chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes 2bshad cing / /btsun mo'i bha ga zhes kyang ngo / /ā li kā li dbye bas der/ /sde tshan brgyad ni rim pas bri/ /gzugs me mda' dang thub pa dang / /bug pa drag po 'dod pa 4yi / /rim pas man ngag ji bzhin du/ /re mig rnams su dgod par bya/ /dang por a yig nas brtsams te/ /yi ge ha yi 5mthar thug par/ /g.yas skor 6gyis ni spyor ba yis7/ /sdom pa rgya mtshor gsungs pa bzhin/ /tha steng sum 'gyur byas nas ni/ /sgra dang thig les rnam par brgyan/ /bha mthug steng dang tsha steng yig /spyi bor ta log steng mas brgyan/ /tsa sa'i dbus nas blangs nas su/ /de bzhin ḍa yi 9'og mas brgyan/ /sha log steng ma sha steng bskyon / /de bzhin yang dag sbyar bar bya/ /li thung 'og gi yi ge la/ /nya yi 'og mas rnam par brgyan/ /pa steng ta log 'og mas sbyar/ /pha steng tha log gis ni dbye/ /ha dang ni log dbus yig pa / /na log steng na gnas pas brgyan/ /sha yi 'og na gnas pas gzung / /bha mthug 'og ma na log 72—555

gi / /'og ma yis ni gdan du bya/ /ha steng gnas pa'i yi ge nyid/ /ra steng ra yi steng mas sbyar/ /ta log steng na gnas pa yi1/ /spyi bor sbyar ba yongs su grags/ /pha steng tha log 'og ma yis / /rnam par sbyar bar brjod par bya/ /nya yi steng du na log ste/ /sbyar ba man ngag gis shes bya/ /tsa sa'i dbus nas blangs nas ni/ /bha mthug 'og ma na log gi / /'og ma yis ni gdan du bya/ /de bzhin tsa 4yi steng nas blangs/ /ta yi steng na gnas pas brgyan/ /tha steng na log 'og la brgyan/ /de bzhin pha yi 'og gnas yig/dha ba'i dbus gnas yi ge la/ /tha log 'og mas rnam par brgyan/ /nya la'i dbus gnas yi ge la/ /na log steng mas rnam par brgyan/ /sa ya'i 5dbus gnas yi ge la/ /dṛ ring 6'og mas dbye bar bya/ /thig le nā dar yang dag ldan / /de yang sum 'gyur bya ba nyid/ /na yi 'og nas ta log dbye/ /der yang sum 'gyur bya ba'o/ /sha log 'og gnas sha log zhon/ /nya 'og gnas las dbye bar bya/ /ma wa'i dbus gnas yang dag ldan/ /dzha mthug rgyab kyi dbyangs kyis brgyan/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /gsang sngags btu ba shes par bya/ /glegs bam las ni gzung ba'i sngags/ /yang dag blang ba byas pa yis/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /dngos grub rnams su mi 'gyur nyid/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /mchod pa'i rdo rje kun 'byung ba/ /tshes bcu'i dus su bab pa na/ /mchod pa lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba dang / /phyi dang gsang bar yang dag ldan/ /dri med snod ni yang dag par/ /gur gum sogs kyis byugs nas su/ /bzang po btung ba yang dag ldan/ /sin+tur phye ma btsags pa la/ /gser smyug gi ni spyor ba yis/ /mkhas pas e waṃ rnam par bri/ /72—536

dbus su gsang sngags rgyal po 'di/ /bstan bcos kyis ni dbye bas bri/ /g.yung drung dge ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /'khor lo yi ni logs su dgod/ /me+e tog rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /chu dang de bzhin thang las skyes/ /sgron ma tsā ru dam tshig ces/ /de bzhin gzhon nu ma dag mchod/ /mchod pa'i las ni khyad par du/ /gdon mi za bar bya ba ste/ /skra grol gcer bur byas pa yis/ /sngar bshad phyogs su kha bltas nas / /mnyam par gzhag pas mchod pa yis/ /dus su shin tu gsang ste bya1/ /ma gsang 2bgegs ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin du yang dngos grub nyams/ /nad kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /dam tshig nyams las byung bar 'gyur/ /srog ni yongs su gtong ba'am/ /'chi ba dang ni phrad kyang slardo/ /gal te dngos grub mchod 4'dod na/ /dam tshig rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /'gro kun g.yon las 'byung ba ste/ /'jig rten gsum po brtan dang g.yo/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor g.yon pas spyad/ /rkang pa g.yon pa sngon du dor/ /mchod pa lag pa g.yon kyis bya/ /g.yon gyis bstabs shing 5bza' bar bya/ /rigs lnga kun du spyod pas na/ /rigs gcig tu ni brtag par bya/ /bza' dang bza' min de bzhin btung / /gtsang sme ngo tsha spang bar bya/ /kun rtog kun las nges grol bas/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /rnal 'byor dra ba'i sdom pa yis/ /rnal 'byor seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /gsang sngags rnal 'byor ma yi dngos/ /rnal 'byor ma yang gsang sngags dngos/ /gal te go 'phang mchog 'dod na/ /de dag tha dad mi bya ste/ /bsam pa gang dang gang gis ni/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag spyor/ /de dang de yi ngo bor 'gyur/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin no/ /sems ni rjes mthun rnal 'byor gyes / /gang zhig goms par byed pa ni/ /bsod nams chung ba'i mi yis kyang / /12—'i 57

'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /bla ma de bzhin dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje can/ /'dir ni bla yi rgyu yin no / /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'dod pa yis/ /de phyir bla ma mnyes par bya /dgos pa bla na med pa nyid/ /dpal ldan u rgyan 1gnas kyi'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang ba snyan nas snyan zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i gzhung lugs/ slob dpon chen po dpal u rgyan 2gyi mi dbang in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal na len+d+ra pa dang / lo tsā ba dge slong pradzha krirtis bsgyur ba'o// // 5bsdur mchan/553 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ba pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra/ 〈〈snar 〉tharjid/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgrubs—/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/554 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mo byeṇa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stob mo/ —/ ༄ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kyis/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lo1ngas/5 6 7〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gilha/ 8〈〈snar 〉ra / 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ye sa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉reg555 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉shes/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stabad/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 dadapa/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra skor/ 7〈〈pe 〉stan/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga ma 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉don/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ rta〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzung /556 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 〈〈pe 〉rnam yis/ 〈〈snar 〉rnam yis ni/ —/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gis/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rtsa/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(4/ 6〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sa bon/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7kes/557 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasang bya ste/ 2〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra sang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ba/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thamachog72—358

0447༄khya/ /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byer ma'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa jes bya ba/1༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra yo gi be+e 2man+t+ra tat+ta/ arja nir de sha sla a byebye na nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyis byin kyis brlabs 4pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags gzugs rgyal ba'i dbang phyug ma/ /shin tu 'jigs shing mchog ster byed/ /thig le phra mor nyer gnas pa/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje phag mo dpal/ /yi ge re'i de kho na nyid/ /'phral du yang dag yid ches byed/ /bgegs rnams thams cad rlag 5par byed/ /gsang sngags don ni bshad par bya/ /bu yi yi ge'i mdun du blta/ /phyag 'tshal yi ge rab gsal ba/ /chos kyis lam de bshad par bya/ /rba rlabs med cing dri ma med/ /nyi ma lta bu'i rnam pa can/ /chos kun rab tu mi gnas pa/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /blo dang ldan pas rtag tu bsgom/ /chos kyi sku 72—pya60

ni thob 'gyur ba/ /blo ldan skye ba 'di yis ni/ /de la goms pa tsam gyis ni/ /'phral du yang dag yid ches 'gyur/ /rig byed dang po g.yon du bsam/ /longs sku spyod lam legs pa yin1/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung ye shes te/ /shin tu legs pa'i 'od gsal ba/ /'di ni zung 'jug shes bya ste/ /ji ltar brag ca 'dra ba yis/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sgu thob 'gyur/ /rang rig bde ba'i mchog gyur pa/ /g.yas pa ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /sprul pa'i lam ni dri ma med / /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /chu zla 'dra bar bsam par bya/ /sprul pa'i sgu ni yang dag thob/ /me long gzugs brnyan 'dra ba bzhin/ /lhan cig skyes rnams rgyu mthun pas/ /bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob/ /oṃ yig gsum dang yang dag spyor/ /thig le yang dag basbus pa gcig /de shes rab tu mi gnas pa/ /chos dbyings bdag nyid nges pa yin/ /yid ni der song sngags pa ni/ /snang ba med pa'i go 'phang 'gro/ /bla na med pa'i lam spyad do//yang dag sgogs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ /sa yig ri bong can gzugs gnas//thig le lhan skyes mi 'jigs pa/ /de ni srog gis 2rnam par shes/ /bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis/ /mdzod sru chen po'i sgo ru ni/ /sna tshogs thig le rnam par sgom/ /dngos grub ma lus thob don du/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'gro/ /ba yig ra dang yang dag ldan/ /tshangs pa'i bu ga'i rnal 'byor byed / /legs pa'i 'od zer rnam pa lnga/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rnam dag 'gro/ /dza yig nang du yang dag bsam/ /ji ltar me shel ji bzhin ni/ /gzhan gyis grong du 'jug par nus/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs nus par 'gyur/ /bu 5yig chu bur rnam pa 'dra/ /dag pa'i shel dang mtshungs pa ni/ /'gro drug rgyu ni 7rdzo—56/

bsreg byas nas/ /mngon shes drug gi go 'phang thob/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' nyid/ /yun mi ring bar nges par thob/ /oṃ yig la gnas rnam par lta/ /bla med go 'phang yang dag 'thob/ /dha yig gnyis med ngo bo ste/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /glog dang byi 1ru yang dag 'dra/ /a yig nang du sang gnas pas2/ /nyin mtshan dag par bsgom pa las /'phral du yid ches byed pa ste/ /mkhas pas bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /ci phyir ngo mtshar gsal mi 'gyur/ /ḍā yig mkha' 'gro ma yis 4'dra/ /bde ba'i gzhi 5ni zla 'od can/ /go yig nang du rnam bsgoms pas/ /mkha' la spyod pa nus par 'gyur/ /gi 6yig rgya skyegs me tog mtshungs/ /'od zer 'bar ba gsal gyur pa/ /ra yig nang du yang dag gnas/ /'od kyi phung por rnam par bsgoms / /bsgoms pas bde ba yang dag skye/ /nad med go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /phyi nas thub dbang go 'phang ni/ /byang chub mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /ni yi yi ge nad sel ba/ /in+d+ra m+bi la ltar nus pa/ /de yig snying por yang dag 'byung / /ston ka'i zla ba lta bur bsgom/ /yang dag bla ma'i man ngag ste/ /lha yi mig gis blta bar bya/ /spyan lnga po ni thob 'gyur te/ /de tshe sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /yi yig mkha' 'dra'i ye shes ni//'od zer phreng ba 'khrugs pas 8'khrugs/ /rnal 'byor chen pos lta bar byed/ /ma yig nang du yang dag gnas/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi yid kyis ni/ /the tshom med par bsam par bya/ /rgas dang 'chi ba rnam par spangs/ /bla na med pa rab tu 'thob/ / /ba yig thig le zlum po ni/ /mdzes pa'i skar ma skar chen 'dra / /ka yig bzhi la yang dag gnas/ /bsgom bya rang bzhin g.yo med pa//72—562

'dod don 'bras bu thob 'gyur te/ /yang dag sdogs pa'i byang chub byed/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol/ /lus can gyis ni mngon sum byed/ /me yi sa bon gzi brjid ldan/ /'bar ba gser 'gyur lta bu'i me/ /o yig dbus su gzhag 1par bya/ /legs pa'i blo yis rtag tu bsams/ /nam mkha' bsregs pa tsam gyis ni/ /dngos grub ri yi bdud rtsi 'dzag /de yis yang dag byugs tsam gyis/ /byang chub gser ni thob par 2'gyur/ /wa yig kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /gzhan yang yid bzhin nor bu ltar/ /tri yig dbus su yang dag gnas/ /mar khu'i me bzhin 'bar ba yis / /nyon mongs ma lus bsreg —byas nas/ /khams dang dbang po la sogs kyang / /legs zhu he ru ka yi mchog /bla na med pa myur du thob/ /ṇ+ḍa yig 5ra dang yang dag ldan/ /yi ge gsum ni che bar 'bar/ /ko yi yi ge'i phug tu gzhag6 /blo dang ldan pas rang sems bsgom/ /'byung ba mchog tu dga' ba ste/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das ngo ni/ /rab 'jug bral bas dga' ba ste/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i chos ni bsam/ /lhan cig skyes dga' mi g.yo ba/ /lhan cig spyor bas nang du gnas / /bsgom pa brtan par 'gyur ba yin7/ /bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob / /ut+pal sngon po lta bu yi/ /ni yig sngon po'i thig le ni/ /ka yig sgo yi dbus gnas par/ /me shel lta bur bsgom par bya/ /de yi dbus su song ba'i sems/ /bde ba chen pos yongs su gang / /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas / /bla med go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /yi ge nyi ma'i gzugs dang 'dra / /de yi dbus su bde mdzad ma/ /la yig phug tu yang dag gnas/ /dri ma bral ba rtag tu bsgom/ /sems ni de ru song ba la/ /rang rig pa ni 72—563

thob par 'gyur/ /rang rig rnal 'byor pa de yis/ /bla med go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /ba yig glog 'gyu'i rnam pa ni/ /snang ba sgra yi rjes chags skyes/ /ka yig dbus su yang dag blta/ /dus mtshan nyid ni log par byed/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gnas/ /nā da'i mtha' ni ye shes ltar/ /der gnas sems ni yang dag 'gyur/ /phyag rgya chen po mngon par thob/ /me yi sa bon shing rta zhon/ /dz+ra yig ji ltar 'bar ba ni/ /hi yig la gnas gzi brjid che//ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /rtog pa med pa'i sbyin sreg gis/ /yul dang dbang po'i tshogs pa rnams/ /de yis me lha mnyes gyur nas/ /dgyes pas tshodangos grub ster bar byed/ /bai yig thig le'i rang bzhin ni/ /rdza mkhan 'khor lo lta bur 'khor/ /sre yig rtse mor blta bar bya/ /lhan cig skyes dga' mi g.yo bar/ /srid dang mya ngan 1bral bas rgo/ /dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu thob/ /rtag tu goms pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /skye ba 'di la dngos grub thob/ /ro yig 'bar dmar 'jigs pa yi/ /ngu 'bod la sogs 'jigs par byed/ /gri yig bshad pa'i lam la gnas/ /'od ldan thig le bsgom par bya/ /rnam par snang mdzad gzi brjid che/ /bsgrub bya thams cad bsam par bya/ /yun mi ring ba'i dus kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas chen po thob par 'gyur/ /zla ba chu shel lta bu'i 'dra/ /rtsa ri byeyig mdzes par bsam par bya//so yig nang du yang dag gnas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu bsgom/ /bde gshegs go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /bzhi pa'i sku yi mchog gi mchog /rtag tu goms pa'i rnal 'byor gyi4/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni dngos grub 'grub/ /ni yig dri ma med pa nyid/ /sprin bral nam mkha' lta bu yizhe/ /su yig yi ge'i 12—564

nang gnas pa/ /nyin dang mtshan du bsgom par bya/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam grol ba/ /mchog tu zhi ba'i cha dang bral/ /bsam gtan tsam gyis yang dag thob/ /mkha' spyod gnas su khrid par byed/ /yi yig rang bzhin med pa yi—/ /stong nyid phra la rdul med pa/ /na yig gnas pa'i yang dag lha/ /'od ldan rang bzhin dri ma med/ /de yi dbus su sems gzhag shesnapa/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs/ /srid las grol ba blta bar bya/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni grags pa bstan/ /phaṭa yig ser po thig le ni/ /rtse mo rnams la mar lta bu kye/ /sa yig nang du gzhag par bya/ /'dod ldan drang zhing bsam par bya/ /nyon mongs khams ni yang dag bsregs4/ /phung po khams ni zad par 'gro/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /skye ba dang ni 'chi ba spangs/ /sa 'dod rang 'dod rig mar grags/ /yid kyi sprul pas mdzes pa'o ma yig gzhon pa rnam par blta/ /yid la sing ba 5yod snyam byed/ /sgyu ma lta bur yang dag gnas/ /dri za yi ni grong khyer ltar/ /sems kyi 'jug pa tsam gyis ni/ /de la go 'phang bla na med/ /ha yig phal ma yang dag gnas/ /'od zer 'khor lo g.yo zhing 'byung / /ku yi dbus su yang dag blta/ /thig le rang bzhin dri ma med/ /bsgom pa bstan par 'gyur ba yis/ /'chi med nyid du skye bar 'gyur/ /yun mi ring ba'i dus kyis ni/ /go 'phang bla na med pa thob/ /hri 'ubri'i yi ge'i dbus su ni/ /yid du 'ong ba'i sangs rgyas gnas//drag po gsum dang ldan pa la/ /de'i dbus gsal bar bsgom pa'o/ /g.yas na mar me nyi ma'i cha/ /srid dang snying rje sprul pa'o/ /nyin mo rab gnas ye shes grags/ /dus dang thabs kyis 7kun rdzob po/ /lho ru rgyu bab 8'du ba ste//12—565

rtsa nas khrag ni 'bar bar byed/ /'byin pas nyon mongs nges par 'joms /lus ni mya ngan 'das /bsgom bya/ /g.yon gyi hūṃ gi yi ge dkar/ /rnam shes rmi lam zla ba nyid/ /byang du 'gro ba shes rab brjod/ /stong nyid mtshan mo de bzhin du/ /'jug pa'i lam ni longs spyod rdzogs/ /chu ni 'bab par byed pa'i rtsa/ /tshangs pa mya ngan 'das par grags/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs zad byed pa / /mdun du sngon po drag po ste/ /snying la ā 2yig mi g.yo ba/ /gnyis med ye shes zhes brjod pa/ /dmigs med dri ma med pa'o/ /chu shing me tog yang dag 'dra/ /til gyi me mar 5bzhin du 'bar/ /nyon mongs kun ni zad par byed/ /der song sems ni mya ngan 'das/ /chos kyi cholam zhes ye shes ni//yang dag 3ye shes mchog gi mchog /yun mi ring bar thob 'gyur te/ /rdo rje sems dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /sku gsung rang bzhin zhes brjod pa/ /dbus su thig le gzhi med pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /sems can kun la rnam par gnas/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /rab tu mi gnas 'bras thob pas bla na med pa bzhi 6ru 'gro/ /ā li kā li 'gog pa las/ /ri mo de ni nges par sbyar / /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /nā da'i mthar ni 'bar ba che / /phra mor byas pa'i sems nyid ni/ /mi g.yo nyid du 'gro ba yi/ /de yi longs spyod bsams 7pa yi/ /lhun gyis grub pa rtag pa nyid/ /de ltar rnyigus par rgyun mi 'chad/ /bsgom pa yun ring bye rnam par bsam/ /yun ring ༄ bsgoms pa'i yid kyis ni/ /bde ba chen po thob par 'gyur/ /de ni do ha ko ṣar gsungs/ /sa bon gcig la sdong po 1gnyis/ /rgyu mtshan des na 'bras 72—566

bu gcig /dbyer med de ni mngon byas pa/ /de ni srid 'das rnam par grol/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las gsungs/ /jeg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don la rtog pa po/ /jeg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung ba/ /jeg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /nyon mongs khams rnams dag pa'i bdag /las kyi khams rnams zad byed pa/ /chu bo'i rgya mtsho kun las rgalahūṃ/ /sbyor ba'i dgod kyepa las byung ba/ /nyon mongs nye ba kun nyon mongs/ /bag chags bcas pas ༄ gtan spangs pa/ /snying rje chen po shes rab thabs/ /don yod 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /'du shes gsum gyis don spangs pa/ /rnam shes don ni 'gag 4par byed/ /sems can kun yid yul dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rig pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /de ltar de shes rnal 'byor pas/ /gang zhig blo ldan rtag tu slob/ /'grub par 'gyur ba je tshom med/ /bsod nams dman pa'i mi yis kyang / /the tshom med par de yis 'grub/ /gus pas sgrub pa po yis ni/ /gus bcas ston pa mchod bya zhing / /las rnams kun la 5gus par bya/ /ro gcig gis brjod rnam par rmongs pa'i sems kyis bsgom pa yang dag gsal don du/ /rtsa dang khams ni mnyam nyid mkha' 'gro mar ldan gnas la sogs pa'i sa rnams dang / /de nyid re re'i dbye ba byas las dpal ldan rdo rje lha mo'i thugs/ /bde ba ro gcig gang la gsang ba sum cu rtsa gnyis de nyid dri ma med pa ni/ /sngags don nges bstan byas pa la/ /bdag gi dge ba gang bsgrubs 6pa/ /dpal ldan phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang ni/ /des ni 'gro rnams myur du 'grub gyur cig /mchog tu zab pa dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid nges 12—567

par bstan pa/ slob dpon in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa rdzogs so// // lo tsā rmyeb ye shes rdo rjes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //bsdur mchan/56spyo hūṃmatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mja rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags de kho na nyid kyis byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bzhugs so// rngo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 / ke 〈〈pe 〉ra rde sha swā rnyiṣ+ṭha nā/ 〈〈snar 〉lkerde sha swā rnyiṣ+pe na/ rte〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tharlab/ rgya〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tharlag561 te〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra / rnga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngag/ rngo 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ che/〈〈snar〉snga / ‘khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bud—/562 kyi〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dbye/ khya〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7/ kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasgoms/ thu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sa / a+yo〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra zhi/ 6〈〈snar 〉〉gi/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga sgom/ bye〈〈pe 〉ma ga pas/ 〈〈snar 〉〉gi' gas pas/9 〈〈snar 〉〉thob/563 ༷)bhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag she〈〈snar 〉7ni thob par/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉yo / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasregs/cho〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/564 —1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7ra/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zadang 'das/ snye 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tsa/ nga〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉medas/'u〈〈snar 〉stanas/565 she 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhag —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabs/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabazhag cho〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thasregathu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)ma pa/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉med/ dz+wa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/ (3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/566 7〈〈snar 〉sngalas/ rte〈〈pe 〉mos/ zhe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rnamar me/ gye〈〈pe 〉〉〈da ra 〉dkyis/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉giye shes ni/ /yang dag tre7〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉sngagazhi/ kye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra sam/ kye〈〈snar 〉mdod/ kye6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rengs/ 11〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉stong pa/567 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thargal/ du 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagon/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snga / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skoragags/5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉las/ — bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sgrub/568 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lots+tsha/12—568

༄ / /rnal 'byor ma'i grub pa'i thabs/ 1༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ badz+ra yo gi d+dhi 2sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor nang na ma nyid gtso / /khyod ni 'jig rten gsum gyi thig le ste/ /khyod ni sems can kun la phan par byed/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dang por re zhig sngags pas sa phyogs gang yang rung bar bstan nas jegang yang rung bar 'dug nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom pa la brtson par bya ste/ de yang rang gi 5lte bar pad+ma dmar po kha bye bar bsgoms la/ de'i steng du shin tu dmar ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i steng du li khri'i mdog lta bu'i dbus su yi ge hri hri gnas pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas bsgoms so6/ /de la gnas pa'i yi ge tri yongs su gyur pa las/ de'i steng du rje btsun rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ser mo7/ rang gi gri gug gis rang gi mgo bcad nas/ rang gi 12—570

lag pa g.yon pas gyen du brkyang ste/ bzung ba phyag g.yas pa'i —1gri gug dang bcas pa 'og tu brkyang ba/ gcer bu zhabs g.yas pa brkyang ba/ g.yon bskum pa bsgom pa'o/ /mgrin pa bcad 'phro nas khrag gi rgyun 'dzag pa/ rang gi zhal du 'jug cing / gzhan gnyis gyen la log nas gnas pa/ rnal 'byor gnyis kyi zhal du 'bab pa bsgom par bya'o/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i logs na gnas pa'i kha dog sngo bsangs ma badz+ra war+ṇa ni ma dang / kha dog ser mo rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ma'o/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyag gi gri gug dang bcas pa dang / g.yon pa dang g.yas pa'i phyag thod pa dang bcas pa'o/ /g.yas phyogs kyi zhabs g.yas pa brkyang ba/ g.yon phyogs kyi g.yon pa brkyang ba/zhabs gzhan bskum pa/ thod pa dang mgo bos brgyan pa/ yan lag rgyan kun kyis brgyan pa/ skra grol ba bsam par bya'o/ /logs gnyis kyi dbus ma'i rnal 'byor ma shin tu 'jigs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /de ni bsgom pa'o/ /mchod pa brjod par bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal byas nas nyi ma'i gzhi la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas bris pa ni yi ge byāḥdang bcas pa'o/ /de nas sngon du bstan pa'i bsgoms pas rje btsun ma dbus su bsam par bya ste/ oṃ sarba bud+dhā 2ḍā ki be+e ye/zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sngags kyis chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su mchod par bya'o / /phyi nas ar+gha dang / me tog dang / bdug spos dang / dri la sogs pa rnams/ oṃ sarba budhe ḍā ki be+e hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis mchod par bya'o/ /phyis 4nas g.yon phyogs su/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa be+e ye hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis so/ /de nas g.yas phyogs su/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'dis so/ /de nas gzhan yang /12—571

e di ya na su la/ gi ri ka ma ka shi ri ha ha tswa1ta/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis kyang mchod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang dharmā sam+bha dze+eg /nir ma ma hā su kha/zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis kyang mchod par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba budhe ḍā ki nī yarnyi/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig bzlas pa byas na bgegs thams cad sgod par 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag gsum bzlas na grong khyer sgod par 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag bzhi bzlas na grong rdal chosgod par 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag lnga bzlas na gang 'dod pa de 'grub par byed do/ /chu mdo'am/ dur khrod dam/shing gcig gam/ lha'i khang pa'am/ ma mo'i khang pa'am/ yul gyi mthar bsgrub par bya'o/ /skra grol ba/ gcer bur gyur pa/ dogs pa thams cad spangs te smra ba bcad la bsgom par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki nī 3/ oṃ badz+ra war+ṇa m+bi ye/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ gar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe/ ba bo kṛṇ+ḍi ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ dpal lha lcam lat+tha 6ka ras mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //12—572

༄ga /rdo rje rjal 'byor ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ri1 ༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ rak+ta badz+ra yo gi be+e 2sā dha na/ bod skad du/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo / /dang po e'i dkyil du paṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ ram̐ dmar po yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma bsams la/ mchod pa byas te / oṃ badz+ra yo gi byā 4hūṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du shar gyi 'dab ma la oṃ ḍā ki nī 5hūṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tre+ets+tsha swā hā/ lho'i 'dab ma la oṃ lā me hūṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nub kyi 'dab ma la oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro tī 6hūṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ byang gi 'dab ma la oṃ rū bi be+e 7hūṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe pra ṭīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes bya bas mchod la/de nas bsgom pa ni gcer bu sku mdog dmar ba 'od zer 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhal la bdud rtsi 'chang ba/ spyan gsum pa/ spyan 12—577/

zlum zhing dmar la 'gyur ba/ dpral ba'i mdzod sru la khro gnyer yod pa/mche ba gcigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra grol ba/ ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yon bskum pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu ma'i cha byad dang ldan pa/dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng bas zhabs gdub byas shing sgra grags pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa 1phyag g.yon na thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thogs pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug 'chang ba/ drag mo'i gzugs can/dur khrod la sogs par rnal 'byor pa snying rje dang ldan pas bsgom par bya'o/ /bsgom pas skyo na sngags kyi bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ sarba budhe ḍā ki be+e ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hūṃ t+t+waṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ sarba sid+dhi pra ṭīts+tsha dhī hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yo gī nī ye hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki d+dhi ye ho hūṃ/ i rda ba bo greṇ+ḍa kṛt+ta ha ha kha kha dza dza a a hūṃ ma ma sidhi pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /tshes brgyad dang bcu'am bcu bzhi la dur khrod la sogs par nges par mchod par bya'o/ /gdams ngag chen po'i yul du gyur pa/ dpal ri khrod dbang phyug gis bstan pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //12—575

bsdur mchan/574 shestamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnal 'byor ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ni/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bya ste/ bya⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ni / ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉rta/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉〉/575 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉par/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (376)12wa 576

༄/ /rdo rje rjal 'byer ma dkar mo'i grub thabs/sna/༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ su kla badz+ra yo gi byā sā dha dz+wa/ bod skad du / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po re zhig e waṃ gi dbus su paṃ yig las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba la/ saṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor / de'i steng du hūṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dkar mo/ gcer bu rgyan med pa skra grol ba/zhal gcig ma/ phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yon pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 4thogs pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje tho ba thogs pa/ zhabs gcig bteg pas brgya byin dang tshangs pa mnan pa/ zhabs gcig gi 'og tu 5'jigs byed chen po dang dus mtshan mnan pa/ zhal las rtag tu bdud rtsi 'phyang ba/ spyan gsum pa spyan rtsa dmar zhing zlum pa/ 'gyur ba gtum pa'i spyan/ dpral 12—577

ba'i mdzod spur khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ mche ba gadzigs pa/ shin tu gtum pa'i gzugs can/ dur khrod la sogs par bsgom par bya'o/ /skyo na bzlas pa bya ste/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki m+bi ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa be+e ye/badz+ra bai ro tsa byā 1hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags ni —/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ṭī dīḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī —hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ baṃ hūṃ/ snying po'i sngags so/ /de bzhin du gtor ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi dī 4i saṃ ba lo kṛṇ+ḍi kṛṇ+ḍa ru ru kha kha kha kha dze phe phe phe a a a a ma ma sid+dhi pra yats+tsha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ tshes brgyad dang bcu bzhi la nges par mchod pa dang /bsgom par bya'o/ /rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti'i 5gzhung rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //bla ma be+e ro tsa nas bsgyur// //ce12—578

bsdur mchan/577 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rnal 'byor ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ldu 〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉de/ 53〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pas/ ④〈〈snar 〉to/dang thod pa/ (ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ston/578 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ni/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉so// 1 54〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ ge 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bo dhi'i/gye〈〈pe 〉〉 bkra shis/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (377)12wa 579

0451༄ / /dpal rdo rje rnal 'byer ma'i sgrub thabs/rte༄go/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra yo gi be+e sā dha rgo/ bod skad du/dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ /khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid / /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dpal 'dud / /bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ /rtogs pa gcig gi spyod yul te/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ /mdor bsdus bdag gis bshad par bya/ /sngags pas thog mar re zhig bla ma dang sangs rgyas rnams la 2mngon par gus pa'i yid kyis/ byang chub kyi sems brtan por bzung ste/ dbang bskur ba yang dag par thob nas/ chos thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin yin yang / rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa la mngon du phyogs par bya ste/ dur khrod la sogs pa yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i dben 72—580

pa'i gnas su stan 'jam po la rnal 'byor gyi rol pas rab tu bsngags pa'i gnas su bltas te 'dug par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la lus dang ngag dang sems yongs su dag par bya ba ni/ rgun 'brum mam/ bu ram shing ngam/ 'bras las byas pa'i btung ba bzang po ji ltar rnyed snapa'i dam tshig lnga dang ldan par byas la mchod sbyin gyi snod du bzhag ste/ yi ge gsum gyi sngags kyis mngon par bsngags nas/ chu de nyid kyis lag pa g.yon pa nas brtsams nas yan lag dang nying lag thams cad sngags kyi chus khrus bya zhing / de nyid kyis mchod pa'i rdzas kyang bsang gtor bya ba'o / /de'i rjes la/ oṃ baṃ ho oṃ hri mo dzo hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces bya ba'i sngags kyi yi ges lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams la sbyar te/ dag pa gsum brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shudheḥsazla dharmāḥswa bhā ba shuzlo3zhihaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shudhaḥsarba snadharmā badz+ra shusgopho7haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shubyeḥsarba /dharmā yo ga shurnyo39haṃ/ de nas rang gi lus khams gsum po rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas khang du brtags tebye / skad cig tsam gyis lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyag gnyis na gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ skra grol ba thur du 'phyang ba/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa/ phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi dbu rgyan can/ /zla ba nyi ma me dkyil du/ /skyil krung phyed pas gnon mdzad cing / /dza ba sin+t+ra ra dang mtshungs/ /de lta'i gzugs can lha mo ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rtag tu bsgom/ /de yi g.yas ni phag gdong ste/ /de bzhin g.yon pa khro mo nyid/ /kun rdzob don dam rang bzhin gyis/ /zhal gnyis su ni rab tu grags/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /rim pa rgyas par rtogs par bya/ /de yi pad+ma'i 12—581

nang du ni/ /don kun sgrub byed 'khor lo bsgom/ /rim pa gsum gyis mtshan nas su/ /kha dog dmar po'i 'od zer can/ /sngags kyi yi ges yongs rdzogs nas / /rdza mkhan 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor/ /srin po'i zhal ni cung zhig bsdam—/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i rnam par bsgom/ /phag gdong gyen du nye bar blta / /g.yung drung 'khyil ba myur du 'khor/ /phyag rgya gnyis bo'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /khams gsum po yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid skad cig gis/ /'grub 'gyur rnal 'byor pas gzhan min/ /de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /sngags btu ba yi cho ga mchog /gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' ba/ /rdo rje rol pa las byung ba'i/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bshad pa/ /btsun mo'i bha ga nyid kyang de/ /ā li kā li'i dbye bas der//sde tshan brgyad kyi rim pa ni/ /gzugs me mda' dang thub pa dang / /bu ga drag po 'dod pa nyid/ /'khor lo rnams ni rim ju1bzhin du/ /man ngag gis ni dgod par bya/ /dang por 'e.a nas brtsams nas su/ /yi ge ha yi ༄ mthar thug par/ /bskor ba'i tshul gyi jisbyor ba yis/ /bde mchog rgya mtsho gsung bzhin bri/ /dwa 5yi thog ma sum 'gyur bya/ /thig le nā das rnam par brgyan/ /bha thog tsha thog yi ge nyid/ /ṭa yig dzi/thog mas mgo bor brgyan/ /tsa sa'i bar nas 7gzung byas te/ / ṭa yig 8'og ma 'og tu sbyar/ /sha thog ṣa thog 'byel pa ni/ /de bzhin spyor bar shes par bya/ /li yi /1mgo gyur yi ge la/ /nya yi 'og nas gnas pas brgyan/ /pa thog ṭa yig 'og mar ldan/ /pha thog tha yig 'og mas bcings/ /ha ṭa'i bar gnas yi ge la/ /ṇa yig 1thog na gnas pas brgyan/ /ṣa yi 'og na gnas pas gzung / /bha 'og gi stan ṇa 12—582

'og sbyar/ /ha yi steng gnas khyeyi ge nyid/ /ra yig gong ma nyis brtsegs 2 ldan / /ṭa yig zugong ma sbyar bya ste/ /mgo bo ru ni yongs su gragasage / /pha yi thog grun gnas pa la/ /ṭha yig (bye thog na gnas pas brgyan/ /nya thog ṇa thog gis brgyan pa/ /man ngag bzhin du shes par bya/ /tsa sa'i bar na gnas pa blang / /bha 'og gi stan ṇa 'og sbyar/ /de bzhin tsha yi gong ma zung 7 / /de bzhin ta yi 5steng mas brgyan/ /tha yi steng mas na 'og brgyan/ /pha yi 'og gnas yi ge blang / /dha ba bar gnas yi ge las/ /tha yi 'og mas brgyan pa nyid/ /yi ge nya la'i bar gnas pa/ /ṇa yi gong mas brgyan par bya/ /sa'i 9bar gnas yi ge la/ /dṛ yi 'og ma gdags par bya/ /thig le nā da mnyam ldan pa/ /gsum rka'agyur du ni dbye ba nyid/ /na 'og ra yi 'og ma ni/ /snga ma bzhin du sum 'gyur bya/ /sha 'og ṣa yi mgo mas brgyan/ /nya yi 'og na gnas pa sbyar/ /ma wa bar na gnas pa gzung / /dzha 11yig gdong mas rnam par brgyan/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /sngags btu ba ni shes par bya /glegs bam klog pa'i sngags pa yis/ /ji lta'i rim pa spangs pa kiyis/ /gang des bskal pa bye bar byas1 / /dngos grub go 'phang mi thob bo/ /gzhan yang rab tu bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje can gyi mchod pa ni/ /tshes bcu'i dus su khyad par du/ /mchod pa lnga dang ldan gyur cing / /bza' ston de bzhin btung ba dang / /phyi dang gsang bar bcas par ldan/ /snod ni dri med sbyangs pa ru/ /gur kum la sogs sbyar bar bya/ /chu bzang po dang ldan pa la/ /sin+tu ra'i phye ma btsags—/ /gser gyi smyu gu'i sbyor ba yis/ /blo dang ldan pas e dbyibs brisaka / /dbus su sngags kyi rgyal po ni/ /rim pa bzhin du bri bar bya/ /12—583

g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /dge ba'i 'khor lo'i logs la dgod/ /me tog rnam pa sna tshogs nyid/ /chu las hūṃskyes dang thang las skyes/ /mar me tsā ru dam tshig che/ /de bzhin gzhon nu ma yang mchod/ /mchod pa'i khyad par 'di dag ni/ /nges pa nyid du bya ba yin/ /skra grol gcer bur byas nas ni / /2sngar bshad phyogs bcu bltas nas kyang / /shin tu gsang bar bya ba nyid / /mchod pa'i dus su mnyam par gzhag༄ /ma gsang bgegs ni skye 'gyur te/ /dngos grub de bzhin nyams par 'gyur/ /dam tshig nyams par gyur pa na/ /nad rnams sna tshogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /srog ni gtong bar gyur pa yis/ /'chi ba'i dus la bab kyang bla'i/ /gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /dam tshig rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /khams gsum brtan dang g.yo ba yis/ /'gro ba thams cad g.yon nas 'byung / /g.yon pa sngon du bskyod bya ste/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu g.yon pas (spyad/ /mchod pa lag pa g.yon pas te / /bza' btung g.yon pas bya ba nyid/ /rigs lnga la ni kun spyod pa/ /rigs gcig tu ni brtag par bya/ /bza' dang bza' min de bzhin btung / /sme gtsang ngo tsha rnam par spangs/ /rtog pa kun las srenges par gol/ /rtsod pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /sngags ni rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin/ /rnal 'byor ma ni sngags kyi gzugs/ /gal te go 'phang mchog 'dod na/ /de dag tha dad par mi bya/ /mi yis gang dang gang bsgom pa/ /yid dang yang dag ldan byas nas/ /des na de yi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /sna tshogs nor bu ji bzhin no/ /sems dang rjes mthun rnal 'byor gyis/ /gang zhig shin tu goms byed na/ /12—584

mi gang bsod nams dman pa yang / /de ni grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje can/ /'dir ni bla ma bla shemed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yin 3 / /de phyir bla ma bsnyen bkur bya/ /dpal dang ldan pa'i rab tu sngags ༷ /pa'i gnas u rgyan 4nas byung ba'i dgongs pa 5 bla na med pa dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang chen rna ba nas 9rna ba ru zhal nas 7 zhal du brgyud pa'i rim pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po bsod nams 'byung gnas bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba rma bye ban chos 'bar gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/5/༷ 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// 3sna〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gil/5/1 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉snodad/ pya 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgo'o/ —7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉te/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thas/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7྅/ tre〈〈snar 〉miza/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7྅/ 3〈〈snar 〉phrobyu/ tsho 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7lha/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra rtag ste/582 rte 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉rims/ rirte〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉ge / —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyis/ sgo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉da/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tshan/ dz+wa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngaganas/ 3 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ṭā yi/ ju/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag merke1〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉yon/583 )〈〈snar 〉donas/ 3〈〈pe 〉〉 ga 〈〈snar 〉ra rtseg 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉granas/ rme〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sgrags/3〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag ga khu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(4/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung / ༄ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/9 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ya'i/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ma/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉snyo/ 12〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉masang ba/nyu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zod/ rnyi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatsag ka〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉(6/12—585

584 me〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 sngar bshad phyogs bcu bltas nas ni// ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzhag④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsang / khya〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ tshoskye〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉nas/585 nya/〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉wabla/ ge〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsngags/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mi ཿṇa/du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉pa'i/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉warna ba nas/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉stonal nas/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉mtho:/ ngasaḥ//bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud/ (378)12wa 586

༷452sngag /dpal de go na nyid ye shes grub pa/gye sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tatwa dz+nyā na sirnyi/ bod skad du/dpal de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa/ dpal rdo rje phag zhumo la phyag 'tshal lo /rlung gis bskyod pas 'og gi 'khor lo nas bzhengs glog gi zer ltar 'od gsal zhing / /rtsibs gnas gsum du zhubasregs nas 'jig rten gsum kyis mchod gyur bdud rtsi ④rgyun rab 'bab/ /sangs rgyas ye shes bcud dang 'dres shing skyon bral shin tu dga' ba'i tshogs ster ba/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par spyod dang bral ba'i phag mo yis ni khyed la srungs/ /ka sogs yi ger gyebaskor nas sprul pa'i rtsibs can nyid dbang dkyil 'khor las (6bzhugs shing / /'bar ba'i me ltar rab 'bar bdud rtsi rab 'dzag pad+ma'i skud pa ltar phra ba/ /rig ma sangs rgyas tshogs rnams bsreg cing 'khor lo gsum po 'byed pa gang yin pa/ /kun dga' dang bcas rol hūṃpas gyen gshegs phag mo khyed ni phya12—587

sems la gsal gyur cig /rdo rje yi ni rnal 'byorwa ma/ /rdo rje sngon song phag mo la/ /mgos phyag 'tshal nas rang dran phyir/ /bdag gis de nyid shes grub brjod / /yid dang ①mthun pa'i dbe+en gnas su/ /mgon pos mgo mtshan blo ldan zhugs nas ni/ /der ni shin tu 'jam pa'i stan dag la/ /kun nas dag par rnam par bsgom par bya/ /de rjes yi ge gsum gyis sngags grub zhupa/ /rgyal ba rdor 'dzin snying po ming med kyis/ /bris nas me tog dmar pos mchod par bya/ /rdo rje dang po mchog gi snod du ni/ /g.yas pa las gzhan lag pa bcug nas kyang / /nye bar bstan pa 1ji lta ba bzhin du/ /lag pa reg nas rdo rje'i khrus bya'o/ /mthe bong chen po dang ni sor mo rnams/ /yang dag ldan pas lag pas bkod byas nas/ /dpa' bo yi ni dbang phyug drug po yi/ /sngags rnams kyis ni lus la dgod par bya/ /de rjes la yang rdo rje 'chang steng du//tshon bzang sbyar ba las skyes snod snyoms la/ /zha nye las skyes phye ma so ma dag /seng ras bdag tu dal bus btsags la 'gramage/ /der ni gser las byas pa'i thur ma yis/ /rgyal ba'i snying po'i snying po spyo'akhor lo ni/ /gtsug pud can gyis 4zur ldan mngon bris nas/ /de yi snying por sngags kyi phreng ba bri/ /'khor lo'i phyi rol shar gyi cha dang ni/ /byang dang nub dang gzi ldan sras phyogs su—/ /bkra shis dam pa rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ /lag pa g.yon pa yis ni mngon par bri/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ/ zhes ni rab brjod nas/ rdo rje lha mo bkug nas gsang sngags kyi/ /yi ge la ni bcug nas bsdams zupa dang / /cho ga yis ni yongs su mnyes par bya/ /de rjes sngags kyi rang bzhin de la ni/ /bza' dang bca' dang bldag dang 9btung ba dang / /gzhib bya 'dod yon 12—588

lnga dang bcas rnams kyis/ /mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa dag bya/ /sna tshogs stobs ni myos byed dang bcas pa/ /shin tu khyad 'phags mchod pa rnam lnga dang / /glu dang rol mo dang ni gar rnams dang / /bskor ba phyag 'tshal bstod pa rnams kyis ni/ /nyin re bzhin nam zla phyed so so'am/ /zla re bzhin nam tshes ni bcu pa las①/ /dngos grub 'dod pa'i dam pas ji skad du//bshad bzhin mchod pa'i cho ga 'di la bya/ /de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa las/phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga'o// //de nas gtso chen phyi rol mchod pa'i tshul/ /byas pas sprul pa'i rtsibs can pad dbus su/ /dbugs bral snying gar tsha zer can gzugs la/ /sngar brjod pa yi lha mo bsgom bya ste/ /dgongs ka'i thun mtshams dmar thag mdog can 'od shakyedapung tshogs kyis zumadun gyi gzir ④bcom zhing / /dpag med 'od 'phro nyam thag kun gcod pa yi gri gug g.yas kyi phyag na 'dzin/ /rgyal mtshan dang bcas g.yon pas pad snod shin tu dkar ba khrag gis phyebakang 'dzin cing / /thod phreng rdo rje phreng bas dbu bcings mgo skra grol zhing gyen du 'greng gyur pa/ /mgo bo'i /pya phreng bas sku brgyan khrag gis zhal bkang ro yi spyan ldan grol ba'i gdangs/ /skal ldan sa glog thuzhal ni gyen du lta snyezhing rtsa ba'i zhal ni cung zad khro/ /kun dga' dang bcas rjes su chags shing sna tshogs nyams can skyil krung phyed pa'i gar/ /phyag rgya lngas ni rgyas btab bye/na bza' dang bral bcu drug lo tshad sku mchog can/ /ye shes dgug sogs snga ma bzhin du ni/ /cho ga'i rim pa sngags pas byas nas ni/ /bkra shis dpral ba yis ni mngon sgo 12—589

phyogs la/ /myur bar 'khor ba gcig ①ni bsgom par bya/ /de yi rjes la bya lam khams su ni/ /gru gsum ri mo yi ni sul nang du/ /'khor lo dmar po rab tu 'bar ba ni/ /myur bar sngar bshad lta bur 'khor bar dzubasgom/ /lhag pa'i shugs kyis bstan byepa ltar gnas shing / /rlung med mi g.yo mar me ltar gsal des/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo bzhu byas nas/ /bdud rtsi'i thig le zags pas khrus byas shing / /sku gsum ngo bo mchog tu lhan cig tu/ /skyes pa'i bdag nyid 'gro la khyab byed cing / /bde ba dpag tu med pa'i rgyur 'phro ba/ /nub tu bltas nas phyi nas blta bar bya/ /nyi ma re re bzhin du thun re'am / /ji ltar khom bzhin 'di ni ji srid du/ /dngos grub mtshan ma mthong ba de srid par/ /bsgom bya de yang gsal bar brjod par bya/ /'bad med skyes pa dga' ma'i gyeshugs dang rjes 'byel bas/ /gang tshe rnam par bsgoms pa gye'adi ni gsal gyur cing / /lcags kyis /7bzhu ba la sogs gnod pa mi tshor ba/ /de tshe grub pa nye bar gnas par gyur pa yin/ /rnga bo che sogs rab tu brdungs pa rnams kyi sgra/ /gsal por nyan pa'i spyod yul du ni mi 'gyur zhing / /gang tshe rmi lam du ni bla med byang chub mchog /thob na 3ring por mi thogs bsam gtan pas mchog 'grub/ /grub pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas 'dre gnas dang / /ri ljongs ljon pa'i rtsa ba la sogs su/ /gnas nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i bhernal 'byor ni/ /blo bzangs kyis 97ni rgyun mi chad snapar bsgom/ /grub nas nor 'dzin la sogs rim pa yis/ /gong nas gong du rab tu thim 'gyur zhing / /de tshe nam mkha' lta bur snang ba yis 17 'od gsal ba yi ye shes tsam du 'gyur/ /de dag mtshan mar shes bya mtshan ma yang / /12—590

rnam pa lngar ni de shes pas rig bya/ /de nyid 1phyir na de dag rnal 'byor pas/ /mnyam par gzhag 4pa'i sems kyis rtogs par bya/ /dang po ri dwags sred bzhin snang ba ste/ /mtshan ma gnyis pa dud pa'i rnam pa can/ /gsum pa me khyer dang 'dra chobazhi pa de5/ /sgon ma 'bar ba lta bur gsal ba yin/ /mtshan ma lnga pa rnam par mi rtog pa/ /sprin bral nam mkha' lta bur snang ba yin/ /de lta bu yi mtshan ma mthong nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po 'thob ‘par 'gyur ba yin7//ldang bar 'dod pa rnal 'byor ma dang mgor gnas pa'i/ /mgon la 'dud sdo nas yi ge muḥni rab tu brjod/ /langs nas de nyid blo yin bya ba bsgrub bya zhing / /rnal 'byor rigs — pas rtag tu rnal 'byor ldan par gnas/ /de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa las/ /bsgom pa'i cho ga'o// //slob mas maṇ+ḍal byas shing zhabs pad la/ /'dod pas gsol ba mang du btab gyur pa'i/ /sngags pa yis ni tshes bcu pa dag la/ /de dag rnams ni rjes su gzung bar bya/ /rnal 'byor byas pa sngags kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /lha mo 'khor lo'i bdag nyid can mchod cing / / bzlas pa byas par gyur pa'i dang po kimachog /kun du blangs te de las 'da' bar bya/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal lnga ni byas gyur cing / /yon phul nas ni mdun du 'grang gyur pa'i/ /me tog phreng 'dzin slob ma'i mgo bo la/ /mgon po bsgoms —la bla mas blta bar bya/ /de murjes ji skad bshad pa'i lha mo dang / /'od zer 'bar ba'i 'khor lo'i shugs ldan pa/ /nye bar gnas pa'i lus la bsams nas ni/ /de la rdo rje 'dzin pa sbyin par bya/ /mthar gyis de ltar babs pa de la ni/ / sru 12—591

ldang ba tshodang rab tu 'dar ba dang / /mchi ma byung 3ba dang ni 'gyel ba dang / /ye shes skyes pa'i rang bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de rjes dang ldan yon tan dang bcas shing / /bla mas sangs rgyas gnyis med gus pa la/ /rdo rje yi ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ /ting 'dzin mchod dang sngags rnams brjod par bya/ /dad pa dang ni rnam par bral ba yi/ /gus pa rnam par nyams pa'i slob ma la/ /yid ches 'phral bskyed shin tu rnam dag pa'i/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni brjod par mi bya'o/ /gang zhig sngags dang bcas par gyur pa yi/ /lha mo'i 'khor lo la ni mchod byed pa/ /de la 'jigs pa brgyad po rnams dang ni/ /sdig pa chen po rnams dang skal ngan dang / /dbul ba dang ni nad dang rgas pa dang / /sdug bsngal yid mi bde ba rnams dang ni/ / 'khrug dang 'thab 4rtsod nyes skyon nyon mongs dang / /gdung ba sna tshogs rnams kyang 'jig par 'gyur/ /gang zhig snying gar 'khor lo'i gsang sngags ni/ /bsgoms nas 'gog pa'i tshig gis zlos byed des/ /dngos grub brgyad po rnams dang mngon shes lnga/ /de bzhin yon tan brgyad po thob par 'gyur/ /nyin re bzhin du thun bzhir 'bad nas su / /sa rlog zhal ni bsgom pa gang yin la/ /seng ge 'phrog byed dbyig gi snying po yis/ /thub par dka' ba'i dran pa skye bar 'gyur/ /'khor lo dang bcas phag zhal can 'di gang zhig sgom byed pa/ /de la bud med rnams dang rigs 5pa sna tshogs gos dang ni/ /bza' btung sna tshogs nor 'bru sa gzhi dang ni khang bzangs 6dang / /lha rdzas kyi ni mal stan dag dang sgrub byed rnams kyang 'byung / /de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa las phan yon dang slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga'o// //12—592

rna nas rna dang de bzhin du/ /zhal nas zhal du 'ongs 1'di brjod/ /sngar brjod lta bu'i 'khor lo lha'i/ /tshogs kyi gnas dang ldan pa bri/ /a phreng ka phreng de bzhin der/ /gcig ma tshang ba — rim gyis bri/ /dzha 'og dang steng gnas sbyar ba/ /ha 'og bsten thupas rnam brgyan pa'i/ /yig mchog de nyid gsal byed ni/ /dang po nyid du gsum bri bya/ /bha steng rten dang tsha steng yeganas pa ni/ /ṭa steng gnas dang 'byel pa de rjes bri/ /ṣa 'og rten 6pa ḍa 'og mar bcas dang / /sha steng rten 7snapa ṣa steng gnas dang bcas/ /li 'og gnas pa nya 'og dang ldan pa/ /pa steng ṭa 'og ldan pa de rjes bri/ /pha steng son pa ṭha ༄ 'og dang ldan pa/ /ha ṭa'i bar gnas i g.yon dang bcas te/ /tsa sa'i dbus gnas pa dang bha 'og dang / /gnas pa tha g.yas dang 'brel de rjes la/ /ha tha'i dbus son pa dang ta g.yon rten/ /ṭha la'i dbus dang 'byel pa phyi nas britsu/ /cha kun gyi rnguni mtha' dang pha yi bar/ /de nyu gsum pa yi dang po'i g.yon nas 'byel/ /la yi 'og na 7ṇa steng pa dang ldan/ /tsha steng gnas dang dha 4 'og ṭha g.yas ldan/ /ṣa 'og gnas pa ta steng ba dang ldan/ /ṇa 'og tha steng dang ldan phyi nas yin/ /pha sgo'og rten dang pha steng tha 'og mar/ /ldan dang la 'og ṇa steng da saldan no/ /wa 'og gnas pa dzā 'og stong pa can/ /gsum dang tsa ⑩steng ra 'og gnas bcas gsum/ /sha 'og gnas pa tha 'og dang ldan zhing / /nya yi 'og ma dang yang ldan pa yin/ /sa yi 7bar gnas dzha 8yi g.yon bcas te/ /gsang chen yi ge'i rnam pa brjod gyur pa/ /rdo rje lha mo 12—393

rnams kyi sngags 'di ni/ /bri zhing bsgom pa brjod par bya ba yin/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing dang bum pa mchog /dpal ldan 'dod pa'i 'o 1ma'i ba yang rab tu bsngagasarngu/ /de dag bsgrub byas thu'adir ni nor ster tsam 'gyur te/ /'dis ceni bde dang bcas pa'i nor rnams ster bar byed/ /de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa las sngags btu ba'i cho ga'o// //mchod pa'i gyur she7ni cho ga mkhas pa yis/ /snod la brten pa gang la 'di bris pa/ /des ni mgo dang mgul pa dpung pa la/ /brtags /'u pas byis pa'i tshul bzhin bsrung bar bya/ /bsrung bcas byis pa mthong nas lto 'phye 'byung po dang / /gdon tsudang mtshan mo rgyu dang sha za'i tshogs bcas dang / /byes pa 'jigs pas nyam thag byed pa'i rab 'jigs gzhan/ /stobs ldan seng ges nags su skrag la 'dar bzhin 'byer3/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni man ngag dam pa thob cing yid ches mthong gyur nas/ /bdag gis gsal ba'i ye shes dri med yang dag grub pa 'di bris te/ /des na de thob don du gus smra bab tsotu sbyin pa'i tshul rnams dang / /lus ngal ba dang rab 'dud rnams kyis )bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad bsten11/ /'jig rten dag na ma bzhin phan pa mang po skyed skru byed de nyid mchog grub gang yin pa/ /de byas dge ba skyon bral zla ba nya ba'i 'od ltar dkar ba yang dag gang thob pa/ /des muni 'jig rten rtsod pa'i dri bral rdzogs pa'i byang chub dag pa yi ni snod gyur cig /phyag rgya rgya chen srid dang zhi ba mnyam gyur sems can kun don byed pa thob par shog /de kho na nyid ye shes yang dag par grub pa zhes bya ba bdag ⑩byen gyis brlab 7pa'i rim pa dpal 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa mkhas pa chen po ting nge 12—594

'dzin rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa paṇ+ḍi ta stong nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po'i ā tsār+ya bha ren+d+ra ru tsi ri1dang / lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bas zang bam ༷ 'gro kun sangs rgyas myur thob shog/ //ge bsdur mchan/587 7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanapal de kho na nyid ye shes grub pa bzhugs so// — 〈〈snar 〉〉baphag spre 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉po/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉byu'i/cho〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉dges/ — —〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ —〈〈snar 〉〉ngal/ 〈〈be+e 〉〉〈〈snar 〉dkyi/588 7 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7rjes su/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanag 〈〈snar 〉thar/ 〈〈snar 〉〉ngal 1〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagram/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ge sa snying po'i/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sdam/(1 〈〈snar 〉rgabaldag dang / —sna〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉mizhib/5/9 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉la/ 3 〈〈snar 〉〉ngadod/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉med/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagazi/ zhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mego/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bos/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sgog 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga lta/ 1 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sngagadab/ — 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan ni sngon/59spyo 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ceg gru〈〈snar 〉〉lor/ —〈〈pe 〉〉〈po ra 〉mirtan/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉tha'i/ 5〈〈pe 〉〉bsgoms pas/ 〈〈snar 〉ra sgom pas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉donas/ de〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉girim pa'i/ khye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rabazang gis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skarachad/ chi 1〈〈pe 〉stan/ 〈〈snar 〉ye na/591 77〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazhin/ — 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉razhag 〈〈pe 〉rangos/ 〈〈snar 〉byedangs/ 〈〈snar 〉maradra dang / 5〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lke/ 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thob/ 7〈〈snar 〉7ba yin/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thatud/ khe 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanas/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉reg tsu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazla ba/ sa〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gidang po/ 7 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanagreng / mu〈〈snar 〉thasgom/ mu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉mja/592 she〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉sprul ldan pa/ sne〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉skorabyung / 〈〈snar 〉7/ 4〈〈pe 〉sngarakhrul dang 'thab/〈〈snar 〉skorakhrul dang thabs/ 5bhe〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'ag 6〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazang /12—595

༄rgya/ /don thams cad grub pa jes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ sarba arja sid+dhi sā dha ṭaṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ don thams cad grub pa zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don kun grub pa'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /bla ma nye bar bsten pas brjod/ /man ngag gsang phyir rnal 'byor 'di/ / skal ba 2can rnams nyid la 'os/ /de la dang por re zhig sngags pas skye bos dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ dam tshig dang bcas pas gnas dang / bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba'i don du/ bgegs thams cad nye bar zhi bar byed pa'i sngags brjod par bya ba be+e/ oṃ dhīḥ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya 4sat+tha duṣ+ṭhan t+t+waṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyis bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rang gi lte ba'i dbus su 'khor lo gru gsum dmar po bsgoms nas/ de'i dbus su 12—597

pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar ro dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge dhī 1dmar po bskal pa'i me 'bar 2ba blta bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la sa bon de yongs su gyur pa las skyes pa'i rdo rje phag mo li khri ltar dmar ba'i mdog can / pad+ma dang yi dwags dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas brkyang pa'i zhabs kyis bzhugs pa/ skra dang ba sru dang spo gzhung gi spu gyen du langs pa/thod pa lngas dpral bar brgyan par byas la/ mgo bo'i phreng bas sku la brgyan pa/phyag rgya lngas mdzes par byas pa/ zhal gcig pa spyan gsum pa/ zhal khro gnyer bsnyer ba rdo rje'i 'od mnga' zhing ljags 'dril ba/ gcer bu phyag bzhi pa/g.yas na rdo rje dang / rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yon na thod pa dang /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang / sdigs mdzub dang / zhags pa bsnams pa/ thung zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ gdug pa can thams cad kyis zubazod par dka' ba'i gad mo dgod pa/ khro mo'i rang bzhin can de lta bur gyur par bsgom par bya'o//de nas ye shes kyi lha mo bkug nas cho ga bzhin du btsug ste/ yang dag par mchod nas/ mnyam par gzhag 5pa'i sems kyis bsnyen pa'i dus su sngags kyi bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bā rā tī 5ā be+e sha ya sar+bha dubye twe 7swā hā/ 'khor lo gru gsum la gnas pa'i gsang sngags bzlas pa dang / mchod pa dang /bsgom pa'i cho ga 'bum bzlas pas 'grub ste 'di la the tshom mi bya'o/ /thang kha la sogs pa'i mdun du sha chen kyi phye ma'i bdug pa sngags 'dis mnyam par gzhag 8pas dbul lo/ /oṃ ā dz+rī hūṃ hūṃ haḥhaḥzhes pa 9la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pa dang bcas pas bdug pa dbul te gzhan du ma yin no/ /oṃ dz+rī haṃ haṃ/he he/ ha ha/ hi hi/ pho phe phe/ zhes bya ba'i sngags sgra dang bcas pa 72—598

brjod cing / mchod pa'i yo byad lnga dang bcas pa'i gtor ma mtshan phyed na dbul bar bya ste/ gtor ma byin pa 'di yis ni/ /rtag tu bdud sogs zhi bar byed/ /nye bar bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin du gsang 1nas mchod pa byas na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bsnyen pa byas nas dngos grub grub pa'i dus su ni tshogs pa tshang ba can gyis 2nye bar bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin du thams cad byas na de la rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlab kyi gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /don thams cad grub pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon mkhas pa grub pa brnyes pa a ba dhū t+t+waṃ pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po'i ā tsār+ya bha ren+d+ra ru tsi dang / lo tsā 4ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/597 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 rje don thams cad grub pa bzhugs so// 〈〈snar 〉ra skal pa/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉ghaḥghaḥ/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gighā taya/598 —1〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉 ཿ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉star snang / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gizhal/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7)/5〈〈pe 〉ra zhag 4〈〈snar 〉(mi/ 7〈〈pe 〉(2ཿ/ 〈〈snar 〉〉hriḥ/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snga zhag 9〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ba/ 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dud/599 sna〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉ra sangs/ 2〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tshangs can gyi/ 〈〈snar 〉tharlabs/ 4〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lots+tsha—/12—599

༄khya/ /ye shes 'pho ba zhes bya ba/1༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ dz+nyā nā 2be sha nā ma/ bod skad du/ ye shes 'pho ba zhes bya ba/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu tig gis spras byi ru'i chun po ltar gsal skar bcas dgongs ka'i thun mtshams 'dra/ /me stag 4rab 'phro 'jigs byed me 'bar lta bur phyogs dang nam mkha' gsal byed cing / /me tog dkar po dang ldan ki shu ka yi me tog 'bar 5ba'i tshogs 'dra ba/ /gzi brjid du mas rnam brgyan dmar ba'i sku mnga' rdo rje phag mo khyed la bsrungs/ /nyes mtsho'i chu rnams ma lus pa las rgal 6gyur ye shes dam pas yang dag brgyan/ /gzhan don la brtson bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'jigs ma la btud nas/ /shin tu gting zab dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las yang dag blangs gyur pa/ /ye shes dbab pa'i cho gas gsang ba yid ches skyed byed tshul bzhin brjod par bya/ /bsam gtan khang pa yid 7'ong skye 72—60/

bo dang bral dri zhim chus brlan sar tsozhugs te/ /shin tu 'jam zhing mtho ba'i stan la 'dug nas phyir la 'jigs pa sel byed pa'i/ /gsang sngags brjod nas de 'og mdun du me tog gis ni byugs gyur dkyil 'khor dag /cho ga bzang po byas nas bzlas pa byas pa'i rdo rje'i chu yis khrus byas te/ /'byung po'i tshogs la gtan pa'i gtor ma btang nas 'bad pa dam pas thang ka dag /mdun du bkram nas spos kyis bdugs shing mchod nas blo bzangs kyis ni bsam gtan bya/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor 2nyi ma'i sa bon las gyur me gzugs dmar po gru gsum la/ /chu skyes dmar po dus kyi 'dab ma dang ldan rab tu 'bar zhing rgyas pa bsgom/ /der ni ro yi snying gar 'od drod can steng shin tu g.yon brkyang zhabs bzhugs pa/ /bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo phag pa'i zhal mnga' rab tu khro mo ni/ /phyag rgya lnga pos brgyan cing spyan gsum dang ldan rgyas shing gsus pa shin tu grims/ /khro gnyer rab tu bsnyer zhing ljags g.yug tweḥyi sgra yis zhal ni gang gyur cing / /'jigs ma 'od tshogs 'phro ba las skyes rgyal bas sems can don rnams mdzad/ /gcer bu thod phreng 4rdo rjes brgyus pas dbu skra kham pa gyen badze+es ma/ /rdo rje 5lcags kyu rgyal mtshan thod bcas sdigs mdzub bcas pa'i zhags pa dag /rig byed tshad kyis phyag mchog rnams kyis bsnams shing spyang mo 'gying bag dang ldan ma/ /rgya skyegs ki shu ban+d+ra dzi ba ka dang ki li'i me tog ltar dmar ba/ /sku la mgo phreng 6las byas do shal gyis brgyan rgyas shing mkhregs pa'i nu 'bur can/ /'od bdun pa dang dpal mo zla tshes mkha' bcas sa mtha' las skyes mchog 7gyur ma/ /kun dga' dang bcas thugs rje'i chus brlan thugs can ye shes mngon rtogs sabaskyed mdzad blta/ /12—602

de nas ye shes 'bar ba dam tshig chud cing lus la drug po bkod byas nas/ /de la sems las byung ba'i cho ga dag dang phyi nang shin tu gsang rnams dang / /bstod pa sna tshogs dag dang glu dbyangs mchog rnams kyis ni rab tu mchod bya zhing / /thal mo sbyar nas gus dang bcas pa'i sems kyis de la mgo bos phyag bya'o / /de la sprul 'khor la gnas rgyal ba'i —1pho brang le brgan rtsi ltar dmar ba la/ /steng zur 'og tu rig byed sgo dang drag po nyi ma lta bu dag dang ni/ /'og zur steng du bsil zer can dang mkha' ldan yi ge tha ma'i gong ma dang / /dbus su 'od zer dmar po mtha' yas rnams kyis phyogs mthar snang byed sa bon bsgom/ /de nas rgyal ba'i bzhugs gnas rab mdzes 'khor lo lta bur 'khor bar bsgoms nas ni/ /sngags kyang bzlas te stobs bzangs las byas bdug pa sngags ldan blo dang ldan pas bsregs4/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i sgu ldan lha mo 'bod pa'i de ma thag tu ā be+e sha ya dang / /de nas skul byed de rjes rang gi sa bon de 'og me yi btsun mo yin/ /sku dang 5cha kun tha ma'i rjes la mchog gi sa bon de nas glang po ste/ /de rjes dran yig brten pa'i k+ṣa ltag nam mkha' zur ldan rjes la'ang de nyid yin/ /oṃ dz+rī haṃ dang de yi rjes la'ang 6bde ba'i yi ge gsum dang ni/ /hi hi dze gsum de dag rim bzhin bzlas dang bsreg dang mtshan mo'i gtor ma'i yin/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi bcu pa nas brtsams nyi ma so sor cho ga yi7/ /bzlas pa gtor ma mchod par ldan pa'i bsam gtan dam pa bsgrubs 9byas na/ /shin tu rgya chen mi mnyam mnyam pa'i rang bzhin dngos grub blang ba yis/ /thod pa 'di la legs pa la ston blo chen rnams kyis 'khrul mi bya/ /ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga las bsgom pa'i cho ga'o// //12—603

ma yis/ /nag po'i tshes mchog ji skad brjod pa de dag legs pa kho nar yang dag gzung / /de 'og 'khor lor cho ga bzang pos ji skad brjod pa'i lha mo mchog bsgoms nas/ /de yi rtsibs ldan 'og mar sngar bzhin 'khor lo mdzes pa 'khor bar bsgoms nas ni/ /de 'og lag nas rdor 'dzin phul te ji srid mgo la mgon ldan me tog can/ /de dag ma lus shin tu babs gyur bar du yang dag bdug cing gsang sngags brjod/ /phebs par gyur tshe grang 4dang tshad pa chen po la gnas lta bur spu ldang 5zhing / /mig nas mchi ma 'dzag cing 'dar la 'gyel zhing ye shes dag ni skye bar 'gyur/ /de dag rnam 6gnas gyur pa rnams la rnal 'byor chen po mchod pa'i cho ga dang / /bsgom bya bzlas bya bdug par ldan pa'i gsang sngags don kun sgrub byed rnams kyang brjod/ /gang dag dang dang bral ba'i sems ldan blun zhing sdig pa'i las la brtson gyur pa//gus pas bkur ste byed pa'i ngor ni mi de rnams la 'di ni brjod mi bya/ /ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga las slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i cho ga'o// //yang dag grub dang slob ma bzang 'dzin byed pas phyi rol mchod pa byed gyur pas/ /mdun du khu ba dmar pos me tog dmar po dang ldan maṇ+ḍal byas nas ni/ /rdo rjes mtshan pa'i 'khor snod la brten snod chen mnyam pa de la lag g.yon gyis/ /'khor lo zur gsum mdzes pa sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas mngon par bris nas ni/ /de la sngar bshad yi ge bzhi po bgegs bdag dbang po'i 72—60/

mgo rgyan phye ba 1yis/ /nub tu kha bltas gsang sngags rig pas lag pa g.yon gyis snga ma bzhin du bri/ /de nas cho ga'i rim pas ye shes bkug nas myur du dam tshig la gzhug bya/ /de la dri dang spos mchog me tog dri zhim mar me lha bshos rnams dang ni/ /'dod pa lnga dang mchog gyur bdud rtsi stobs dang thug pa gzhib 27pa bzang po dang / /bcas dang bza' ba bde gshegs drug pa dang ni khar ba'i sil khrol bcas glu dang / /pi wang gling bu'i rnga rim 4rdza rnga pa ṭa ha rnams dang ni dung dag dang / /zangs dung rnams kyi sgra snyan gar bcas dge legs kyis ni mchod cing bstod pa ste/ /mchod pa'i tshul mchog legs pa sna tshogs rnams kyis rnam pa kun du mchod bya zhing / /gus pas 5thal sbyar zhe sa bcas pas dpe med phyag ni rab tu btsal bar bya/ /sngags rnam 6so sor cho ga bzang pos bzlas pa yis ni 'bum du longs byas te/ /rdo rje la sogs dbye bas 'dis 7ni bzlas na gsum du nges par 'gyur ba yin/ /gang tshe lta bar 'dod pa skyes na de tshe yi ge 9dang bcas pa'i/ /'khor lo mdzes pa de dag 7bzhugs pa'i bla ma la yang rab btud nas/ /muḥyig bcas sngags cho ga ldan par 'dug pa rab tu brjod nas ni/ /skyes bu don mchog la brtson blo yis bsam gtan las ni yang dag ldang / /ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga las ni phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga'o / / gang zhig bshad zin cho ga mchog gis nyin re bzhin du 'khor lo mchod byed cing / /cho ga ji bzhin thang ka'i mdun du lha mo'i sngags kyi bzlas pa yang byed pa/ /des ni 'gro don sna tshogs skyed ཿpa'i yang dag grub pa nges par thob 72—60pya

'gyur zhing / /'jig rten dag na mdangs 'bar lha mo lta bur shin tu mchod pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rjes chags snying ldan gos dmar can gyi bsgrub bya gang yin mdun du bltas byas nas/ /rdo rje zhags pas mgul nas legs par bcings shing brang nas lcags kyus phug nas ni/ /thal sbyar gcer bur drangs nas rang gi rkang gnyis la ni 'gyel bar gar byed pa/ /ḍom bis ra ḍa'i skye bo lta bur des ni shin tu byed par 'gyur/ /gang gi 3mgo la rdo rje'i rtse mos bsnun cing thod gnas khrag gis mig bkang ba/ /de ni rdo rje'i lus can yin du zin kyang myur bar gshin rje'i gnas su 'gro/ /sa bon 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin tshogs kyis 2shi ba gang gi rma bkrus shing / /kha ṭ+wāṃ la gnas sgra dang bcas pa'i 4dril bus des ni yang dag 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga las phan yon sbyor ba dang bcas pa'i cho ga'o// //ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin brjod pas bsod nams zla ba nya ba yi//'od ltar dkar zhing nyes pa ma lus sel ba bdag gis bsgrubs gyur gang yin pa//des ni 'gro rnams nyon mongs ma lus dang bral yon tan rnams kyi gter gyur pa//bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'i ye shes snang bas rab tu 'bar bar 'gyur/ /ye shes dbab pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor gyi cho ga'i mchog dpal stong nyid ting 5'dzin gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bal po'i ā tsār+ya bha ren+d+ra ru tsi 6dang / lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //72byed606
